jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Graphic Designer to join our Monetisation design team.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Graphic Designer to join our Monetisation design team. Our monetisation funnels - paywalls, upsells, promotional campaigns and store assets - are one of the main growth levers of the product, and they need a steady flow of high-quality visuals to keep testing and iterating.

In this role you will work side by side with a senior designer and the PMM team, producing graphics within an existing design system and visual style. This is a production-focused role rather than an ownership-of-strategy one, so it is a good fit for a junior designer who wants to grow inside monetisation and growth tasks, get regular feedback from a strong design lead and see the direct impact of their work on product metrics.

Role responsibilities

  • Create graphic assets for monetisation funnels: paywall screens, upsell elements and promotional banners
  • Create and adapt vector illustrations and UI graphics within the existing visual style
  • Design banners and visual assets for email marketing campaigns
  • Prepare screenshots and visual assets for the App Store and Google Play, including updates and localisations
  • Adapt existing creatives to different formats, sizes and A/B test variations
  • Create Lottie animations for monetisation funnels
  • Maintain visual consistency and high quality across all monetisation-related materials
  • Work closely with the senior designer and the PMM team
  • Keep source files well organised and follow internal naming and handoff guidelines

Requirements

  • Junior-level commercial experience in graphic design
  • Experience generating images with AI tools like Midjourney, Krea or similar AI image tools
  • Portfolio with examples of graphic design, vector illustrations or marketing visuals
  • Confident daily use of Figma, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong ability to create vector illustrations independently
  • Solid understanding of design fundamentals: colour theory, composition and visual hierarchy
  • Ability to work with feedback and iterate on designs without losing quality or missing deadlines
  • Attention to detail and high standards for visual quality
  • Location within Europe, with a working schedule overlapping CET plus or minus 3 hours

Will be a plus

  • Hands-on experience with Lottie animations
  • Formal art or design education
  • Strong illustration skills and visual fundamentals
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to suggest improvements

What we offer

  • Innovative Environment: we're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech.
  • We are global remote.
  • Collaborative Culture: work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are.

Hiring process

1. Intro Call with Recruiter

2. Test Task

3. Final Interview

If this sounds like your next step, send us your CV together with a portfolio - we would be glad to look at your work and talk about the role in more detail.

jobs.description:
Group Finance Director – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Group Finance Director is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the Group's financial management, planning, reporting, controls, treasury, and performance across its insurance, investment, asset management, and other financial services businesses.

The role provides strategic financial leadership across subsidiaries and business units, ensuring strong financial performance, regulatory compliance, capital discipline, effective risk management, and high-quality decision support for the Group CFO, CEO, Board, and shareholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Group-wide financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Oversee consolidated financial reporting, management accounts, statutory accounts, and financial analysis across subsidiaries.

Drive FP&A, profitability analysis, cost optimization, and financial performance improvement.

Monitor financial performance across insurance, investments, asset management, and other Group businesses.

Oversee insurance finance, including premium revenue, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability analysis.

Lead financial reporting and accounting oversight for investment and asset management portfolios, including valuation, income, performance, and reporting.

Support Group-level capital planning, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet management.

Oversee treasury, cash management, funding requirements, and working-capital optimization.

Strengthen Group-wide financial controls, governance, policies, and risk management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting obligations.

Provide financial analysis for M&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and capital allocation decisions.

Partner with senior executives to improve business-unit profitability, operating efficiency, and return on capital.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP, automation, management reporting, analytics, and digital finance initiatives.

Develop and mentor Finance Directors, Controllers, Heads of Finance, and senior finance teams across the Group.

Act as a key financial advisor to the Group CFO, CEO, Executive Committee, Board, auditors, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Group revenue, EBITDA/profitability, and earnings growth

ROE / ROIC and return on capital

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Insurance underwriting and investment profitability

Capital adequacy and solvency position

Liquidity and treasury efficiency

Investment portfolio financial performance

Quality and timeliness of Group reporting

Regulatory and statutory compliance

Strength of internal controls and audit outcomes

Successful finance transformation and process automation

Value creation across subsidiaries and business units

Candidate Profile

15–20+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience operating at Group / regional / multi-entity level.

Previous experience as Group Finance Director, Finance Director, Group Financial Controller, Deputy Group CFO, Financial Controller, or senior finance executive.

Strong understanding of insurance accounting, investment accounting, financial reporting, capital management, treasury, and regulatory finance.

Demonstrated experience managing complex consolidated reporting structures and multiple subsidiaries.

Strong commercial understanding of investment portfolios, financial markets, capital allocation, and business performance.

Experience supporting M&A, corporate transactions, strategic investments, or restructuring is highly desirable.

Strong leadership experience managing geographically dispersed finance teams.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investment management, or financial risk are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Finance | Group Consolidation | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Management | Treasury | Solvency | Financial Controls | Regulatory Reporting | M&A | Risk Management | Tax | Finance Transformation | Investor & Board Reporting

Leadership Characteristics

Strategic and commercially minded

Strong analytical and financial judgment

High integrity and governance orientation

Excellent stakeholder and Board communication

Results-driven and performance-focused

Strong people leadership and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multi-entity environments

Reporting Line

Reports to: Group CFO / Group CEO

Key Stakeholders: Board of Directors, Executive Committee, Group CFO, CEOs/MDs of subsidiaries, Investment & Risk teams, Regulators, Auditors, Investors, and Shareholders.

Target Sourcing Titles

Group Finance Director | Group Financial Director | Group CFO | Deputy Group CFO | Finance Director | Group Financial Controller | Financial Controller | Regional Finance Director | Director of Finance | Head of Group Finance | Head of Finance | VP Finance | Deputy CFO | Finance Executive Director | Group Finance Controller

  • Strong knowledge of control and risk frameworks

  • Ability to adapt to change quickly; easily shift priorities with a can-do attitude in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

  • Ability to interface effectively and build and maintain strong relationships externally and internally across business functions

  • Possess exceptional intellect, with decisive analytical skills and the capacity to think out-of-the-box, bringing novel solutions to overcome barriers to success

  • Superior written and oral communication skills; ability to persuasively present and communicate

  • Exceptional professionalism; comfortable working with C-level executives

We are looking for a Machine Learning Systems Engineer to join our ML Acceleration team.   • Kernel Development: Design and maintain high-performance GPU kernels in Triton or CUDA for state-of-the-art ML workloads.
  • Data Pipeline Engineering: Optimize robust data loading pipelines that maximize training throughput.

What we're looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s degree, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python.
  • ML Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • ML Knowledge: Experience optimizing machine learning model execution during training and inference, alongside a strong understanding of fundamental machine learning concepts, architectures, and processes.
  • Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and a data-driven approach to technical challenges.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

This position supports operational continuity, risk reduction, regulatory compliance, capital projects, emergency preparedness, and protection of employees, communities, assets, and the Avantor brand.

The roles directly support compliance with numerous regulatory frameworks and industry standards, including OSHA Process Safety Management (29 CFR 1910.119), EPA Risk Management Program (40 CFR Part 68), hazardous materials regulations, transportation requirements, fire and building code requirements, occupational safety legislation, and recognized industry best practices established by the Center for Chemical Process Safety (CCPS), American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE), NFPA, and industry insurers. The positions also provide technical oversight for process hazards, Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), Management of Change (MOC), incident investigations, contractor management, functional safety, and major accident prevention programs.

This position is fully REMOTE.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline preferred
  • Certifications (Preferred)
    • Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
    • Certified Process Safety Professional (CCPSC)
    • Professional Engineer (PE)
    • Incident Investigation or Root Cause Analysis certification/training
  • Experience: Minimum of 5-8 years of progressive EHS and/or Process Safety experience within chemical manufacturing, life sciences, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, industrial manufacturing, oil & gas, or related high-hazard industries
    • Demonstrated experience managing OSHA PSM and EPA RMP-covered processes.
    • Experience facilitating Process Hazard Analyses (PHA) and HAZOP studies.
    • Experience leading Management of Change (MOC) programs and incident investigations.
    • Proven ability to partner effectively with operations, engineering, maintenance, and leadership teams.
    • Experience supporting multiple facilities and geographically dispersed operations preferred.
    • Experience working in a corporate or regional process safety role preferred.

Who you are:

  • Expert knowledge of OSHA Process Safety Management (29 CFR 1910.119).
  • Strong knowledge of EPA Risk Management Program (40 CFR Part 68).
  • Understanding of CCPS risk-based process safety principles and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of NFPA standards, hazardous materials management, fire protection systems, and process safety engineering principles.
  • Proficiency in risk assessment tools including HAZOP, What-If Analysis, FMEA, LOPA, Bow-Tie Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis methodologies.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, process flow diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive change without direct authority.
  • Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across numerous facilities simultaneously.
  • Strong facilitation and leadership skills for cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and process safety or EHS management systems.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining high levels of collaboration and engagement.

How you will thrive and create and impact:

Process Safety Program Leadership

  • Lead the development, implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement of the company's Process Safety Management and Risk Management programs.
  • Establish corporate process safety standards, procedures, governance processes, and performance expectations.
  • Ensure process safety programs align with regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and corporate objectives.
  • Act as the primary technical resource for process safety-related matters throughout North America operations.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, NFPA standards, hazardous materials regulations, and other applicable requirements.
  • Interpret regulatory changes and translate requirements into actionable compliance programs.
  • Conduct compliance assessments and identify opportunities for risk reduction and program enhancement.
  • Support interactions with regulatory agencies, insurance representatives, and third-party auditors.

Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) and Risk Assessment

  • Plan, facilitate, and document Process Hazard Analyses including HAZOP, What-If, Checklist, FMEA, Layer of Protection Analysis (LOPA), and other risk assessment methodologies.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams in identifying process hazards, evaluating safeguards, and recommending risk reduction measures.
  • Track and verify completion of PHA recommendations and corrective actions.
  • Support facility siting studies, chemical hazard evaluations, and major accident prevention initiatives.

Management of Change (MOC)

  • Lead and maintain formal MOC processes for equipment, technology, procedures, chemicals, and organizational changes.
  • Review proposed modifications to ensure safety, environmental, operational, and regulatory risks are appropriately evaluated and controlled.
  • Verify implementation of required safeguards prior to startup.

Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis

  • Lead or support investigations involving process safety incidents, near-misses, releases, fires, explosions, and significant operational events.
  • Utilize recognized root cause analysis methodologies to identify underlying causes and systemic improvements.
  • Ensure corrective actions are developed, implemented, and verified for effectiveness.
  • Share lessons learned across the organization to prevent recurrence.

Mechanical Integrity and Asset Reliability Support

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Maintenance teams to strengthen mechanical integrity programs and inspection strategies.
  • Support risk-based inspection programs and reliability initiatives for critical process equipment.
  • Evaluate deficiencies impacting process safety and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist in the development of preventive maintenance and inspection requirements.

Capital Projects and New Product Introductions

  • Provide process safety oversight for facility expansions, process modifications, new technologies, and capital projects.
  • Conduct design reviews and hazard assessments during project development and implementation phases.
  • Participate in Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR) and startup readiness evaluations.
  • Support safe introduction of new products, raw materials, and manufacturing processes.

Auditing, Assessments, and Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct process safety audits, compliance assessments, gap analyses, and site evaluations.
  • Monitor closure of corrective actions resulting from audits, inspections, incident investigations, and insurance recommendations.
  • Develop and track process safety performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and risk reduction efforts.

Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity

  • Support emergency response planning, crisis management, and major incident preparedness activities.
  • Assess facility emergency response capabilities related to hazardous materials and process safety events.
  • Participate in drills, exercises, and emergency response evaluations.
  • Provide technical guidance during safety emergencies when needed.

Training, Coaching, and Organizational Development

  • Develop and deliver process safety training programs for leadership, engineers, operators, maintenance personnel, and EHS professionals.
  • Promote a proactive process safety culture across all operational sites.
  • Mentor facility teams process hazard recognition and risk management practices.
  • Build organizational process safety competency and knowledge sharing programs.

About WellQor:

WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.
Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for ensuring each patient is achieving the best possible outcomes. We're not a directory service, we're a full service psychology practice. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team, and our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
The WellQor organization was founded to serve the needs of specialized populations. WellQor serves the needs of mature adults, and Wellfam serves the needs of teens and adolescents. Our providers understand the unique situational issues and clinical mental health challenges of each population.
Our practice is growing rapidly, and we owe our success to a family-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor.

Your Role as a Remote Clinical Therapist:

At WellQor, you’ll help your clients overcome anxiety, deal with grief, forge better relationships with their families, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference in the lives of others, and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.
And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback. Clinicians collaborate with our Clinical Directors to develop treatment plans and obtain valuable feedback to ensure the best possible patient outcomes.

You will define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.

Why WellQor?

  • You’ll develop long-term relationships with patients via teletherapy.
  • Have access to the full support and camaraderie of a clinical team.
  • Select how much and when you work.
  • Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.
  • Receive credentialing, billing, and administrative services so you can do what you do best, therapy!

Join the WellQor Family and let us build a caseload for you that fits your lifestyle.

WellQor Telehealth Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they're interested in carrying at any given time.

jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As an E-Commerce Manager (Shopify), you will play a critical role in supporting the day-to-day operations and optimization of a growing direct-to-consumer e-commerce business operating across multiple international markets. You'll take ownership of the Shopify storefront, ensuring promotions, merchandising, landing pages, apps, and customer journeys are managed effectively and consistently.

This role is ideal for someone with extensive Shopify experience who combines strong operational ownership with a practical understanding of conversion optimization. You'll work across Shopify Markets, third-party apps, storefront merchandising, landing page execution, and post-purchase tools, while coordinating closely with Customer Experience, Operations, Development, and Growth teams.

This is not a pure development role. Instead, you'll be expected to independently manage and optimize a complex Shopify ecosystem, troubleshoot operational issues, identify opportunities to improve the storefront, and coordinate technical escalations when deeper development support is required.

Accountability

Your success as the E-Commerce Manager (Shopify) will be defined by your ability to keep the Shopify ecosystem running smoothly, execute high-quality storefront updates, and continuously improve the customer journey and conversion experience.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Shopify Storefront Management

  • Manage Shopify promotions, pricing updates, merchandising changes, and routine site maintenance.
  • Support operational management of the storefront across multiple international markets.
  • Maintain accuracy and consistency across Shopify Markets.
  • Ensure the storefront is operationally ready for campaigns, promotions, and product launches.

Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization

  • Design and build high-converting Shopify landing pages.
  • Manage and optimize post-purchase survey tools.
  • Support conversion rate optimization through landing page improvements and customer journey optimization.
  • Analyze behavioral insights to identify opportunities to improve the storefront experience.
  • Identify and address friction points throughout the customer journey.

Shopify Apps & Platform Operations

  • Manage third-party Shopify apps and integrations.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of new tools and plugins.
  • Maintain an effective and well-organized Shopify technology ecosystem.
  • Coordinate with development stakeholders on technical escalations and implementation.

Website Operations & Issue Management

  • Act as the first point of contact for website issues raised by Customer Experience.
  • Troubleshoot operational storefront issues before escalating.
  • Identify the root cause of issues and coordinate the appropriate stakeholders to resolve blockers.
  • Ensure website issues are resolved efficiently with minimal disruption to customers.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with Customer Experience, Operations, Development, and Growth/Marketing teams.
  • Coordinate stock-related site adjustments and promotional rollouts.
  • Ensure storefront updates are aligned with broader marketing and operational initiatives.
  • Support campaign and product launch readiness across relevant markets.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with Customer Experience, Operations, Development, and Growth/Marketing stakeholders, acting as the operational owner of the Shopify storefront and helping ensure that e-commerce initiatives are executed accurately and efficiently.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the E-Commerce Manager (Shopify), your vertical focus will be on Shopify operations, storefront management, and e-commerce optimization, while your horizontal focus will include conversion optimization, customer journey analysis, platform operations, and cross-functional coordination.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Shopify e-commerce operations, with strong experience across Shopify Markets, storefront merchandising, apps/integrations, and conversion optimization.
  • Shopify Markets: Strong experience working with Shopify Markets and managing storefront operations across multiple international markets.
  • Apps & Integrations: Strong understanding of third-party Shopify apps, integrations, and the operational considerations involved in managing them.
  • Merchandising & Promotions: Experience managing storefront merchandising, promotions, pricing updates, and other e-commerce workflows.
  • Landing Pages & CRO: Experience designing or optimizing landing pages and improving storefront conversion through customer journey and UX improvements.
  • E-Commerce Operations: Demonstrated ability to independently own operational Shopify workflows rather than focusing solely on development.
  • Behavioral Analytics: Familiarity with tools such as post-purchase surveys and screen recording platforms to understand customer behavior and identify optimization opportunities.
  • DTC Experience: Experience working within a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce brand environment is strongly preferred.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy and consistency across a complex, multi-market storefront.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to coordinate effectively with CX, Operations, Development, and Marketing/Growth stakeholders.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Shopify Operations: How you manage and optimize a complex Shopify storefront across multiple markets.
  • E-Commerce Merchandising: How you manage promotions, pricing, merchandising, and storefront updates.
  • Conversion Optimization: How you approach landing pages, customer journeys, and storefront improvements to increase conversion.
  • Platform & App Management: How you evaluate, manage, and troubleshoot Shopify apps and integrations.
  • Problem Solving & Ownership: How you diagnose operational website issues, resolve problems independently, and determine when technical escalation is required.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: How you work with CX, Operations, Development, and Marketing/Growth teams to execute e-commerce initiatives.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role where you'll be expected to work with full UK timezone overlap. You will also be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us.

During the offer process, we'll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Billing organization at Stripe builds and operates Stripe Billing, a growing product vertical inside of Stripe. Hundreds of thousands of businesses of all sizes and types use Stripe Billing to collect revenue for recurring and one-time payments across a variety of different pricing models—from selling SaaS subscriptions, to orchestrating multi-stage contracts, delivering business analytics, and providing recovery and retention tools to prevent customer churn.

To support even the most unique and complex business models, our technology and products must be configurable and programmable. This requires our team to innovate in how we model different types of businesses, and how we use technology to enable customers to piece together Stripe’s Billing’s platform primitives into holistic solutions that support any type of business. Through this work, Stripe Billing allows worry-free innovation and evolution of any customer’s business model. Stripe is defining the industry’s approach to Billing solutions; we’re looking for innovators to join us.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a team within the Stripe Billing organization. In this role, you will manage a high-performing team of engineers and partner closely with product managers and other cross-functional leaders to shape the team’s strategy and roadmap. You will excel in this role if you’re a product-focused engineering manager who can collaborate effectively across multiple teams and functions to deliver results. If you enjoy building and nurturing high-performing engineering teams, helping guide the direction of product development, and engaging directly with users of the platform, this will be a great opportunity for your career.

You will:

  • Partner closely with engineering leaders, product managers, and designers to shape the team’s strategy and roadmap
  • Demonstrate strong first principles thinking when approaching complex problems and system design

Minimum requirements

  • You have experience building extensible, leveraged software solutions that scale to different kinds of user needs.

Preferred qualifications

  • You have a strong product and design sense, and enjoy finding elegant solutions to complex problems

About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

The Senior Software Engineer will be a technical leader on the Fleet Enablement & Insights team, responsible for architecting and building systems that span two critical pipelines for Torc's autonomous truck platform: the map validation and simulation pipelines and the annotation platform. This role owns hard engineering problems behind both, designing scalable services and data pipelines that package maps for simulation, validate mapping updates before release, and the systems required for scalable web-based annotation tooling. The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend or full-stack engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, sets the technical bar for others, and is energized by complex data engineering, distributed systems, and geospatial simulation challenges. This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, autonomous systems, and large-scale data operations, with a direct line of sight to the data that trains and validates the AV stack.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, build, and own backend services and data pipelines that power the map validation and simulation pipelines for the autonomous trucking platform.
  • Provide technical leadership to the annotation platform building scalable web-based annotation tooling including cuboid and polygon editing, cross-frame interpolation and track propagation, attribute editing, and review-first (accept/reject) workflows.
  • Design robust data models and storage architectures across relational, spatial, and large-scale object stores, ensuring data integrity, lineage, and performance from ingest through delivery.
  • Build high-performance point cloud and image rendering with three.js/WebGL: octree/LOD-based streaming formats, predictive prefetching for smooth frame scrubbing, camera-LiDAR projection, and multi-sensor overlays across a high camera count.
  • Leverage AWS cloud services (e.g., S3, Lambda, ECS, RDS) to build and deploy scalable, reliable pipelines and services, and set the standards for how the team builds on them.
  • Drive technical design and architecture decisions across the map validation and annotation platform domains, weighing tradeoffs, documenting direction, and aligning stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Mapping, Simulation, Annotation, and Perception to align capabilities with upstream and downstream requirements.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing, and raise the bar for engineering excellence, documentation, and operational rigor across the team.
  • Identify and drive down technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability gaps across the map validation and annotation stacks, and lead the response when they surface in production.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Strong experience (5+ years) building and operating production backend services at scale.
  • Expertise in Python, with a track record of designing and shipping production-quality services and tools.
  • Strong proficiency with SQL for querying, transforming, and analyzing relational and analytical data.
  • Experience designing and building web services and APIs that support web-based tooling, with strong knowledge of TypeScript and modern web frameworks (backend depth required; full-stack a strong plus).
  • Working knowledge of C++, or the ability to ramp into it.
  • Strong database and data-modeling expertise, including hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or similar, and designing schemas for integrity, lineage, and performance.
  • Demonstrated ownership of system design and architecture for complex, multi-service or multi-pipeline systems.
  • Proficiency with Git and GitHub for version control, branching strategies, and collaborative code workflows.
  • Familiarity with JIRA or similar project management tools for tracking tasks, bugs, and sprint deliverables.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and reliability engineering.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing data annotation, labeling, or data-delivery platforms and the web tooling behind them.
  • Familiarity with PostGIS for advanced spatial queries, geometry operations, and geospatial data management.
  • Experience working with large binary or sensor datasets (point clouds, imagery, video) and optimizing data-heavy user interfaces for performance.
  • Experience with point cloud rendering and streaming formats (octree/LOD structures such as Potree or COPC, 3D Tiles, LAS/LAZ) or large-scale spatial data structures.
  • Experience with browser-based 3D graphics (three.js, WebGL, or similar), or strong graphics fundamentals and a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly.
  • Prior experience working with High-Definition (HD) maps, map formats (e.g. OpenDRIVE, NDS, Lanelet2), or map production pipelines.
  • Familiarity with robotics data and visualization ecosystems (e.g., Rerun, Foxglove, MCAP, ROS bags).
  • Background in autonomous trucking or autonomous vehicles, with an understanding of how map and annotation data feed the AV stack.
  • Contributions to open-source geospatial, data engineering, simulation, robotics, or annotation projects.

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

Keller Executive Search is partnering with a leading supply-chain services company in the utility-scale solar and renewable-energy sector to hire an Enterprise Sales Manager. You are a commercially minded, self-driven enterprise hunter who thrives without an SDR team or a local office behind you. Are you an experienced security engineer / architect looking to apply your strategic mindset to help customers securely adopt enterprise AI tools, modernize security architectures and govern the risks introduced by generative AI platforms, AI assistants, coding copilots and LLM-enabled applications?

Aimpoint Digital is a fully remote, rapidly growing AI and Data Engineering consultancy; specializing in enabling tangible business outcomes and ROI for organizations around the globe. AI is fundamentally changes how the world works, and our philosophy toward AI security is a combination of mitigating risk without slowing innovation. What sets us apart is our track record of providing strategic advisory services alongside unmatched delivery expertise.

What you will do

In this position, you will be a crucial member in shaping the future of AI; specifically, by enabling designing scalable security architectures that enable organizations to innovate both quickly, and securely. You will design and implement security solutions enable customers to securely deploy, and govern, Claude Enterprise.

You will: 

  • Assess existing security, identity, data, cloud and SaaS architectures and advise on best-in-class solutions for securing enterprise AI tooling across customers in a wide range of industries
  • Conduct comprehensive evaluations of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Claude Enterprise), platform configurations, data access patterns, connector usage, security controls, processes and personnel to deliver informed recommendations leveraging your expertise in security engineering and AI governance
  • Design and implement security controls for enterprise AI platforms, including SSO, SCIM, RBAC, MFA, conditional access, admin roles, user lifecycle management, retention policies, audit logging, workspace controls, DLP, and acceptable-use enforcement
  • Assess and govern AI platform features such as file uploads, custom assistants, projects, GPTs, connectors, browsing, code execution, data analysis, plugins, agents, API access, and external sharing
  • Review and secure AI integrations with enterprise repositories and collaboration platforms, including Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Slack, Teams, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, and BI platforms
  • Manage and lead end-to-end AI Security Implementation efforts as part of a project team; including activities such as identity integration, access control design, data protection controls, AI platform configurations, connector governance, monitoring / logging and incident response workflows

Who you are 

We are building a diverse team of talented and motivated people who deeply understand business problems and enjoy solving them. You are a self-starter who is passionate about responsibly deploying AI solutions. You understand that AI Security isn’t a nice to have, it’s a pre-requisite for enabling AI solutions at scale. Specifically, scale that enables business value without exposing organizations to unnecessary risk.

As an AI Security Architect, you will be expected to own and manage client engagements, take part in the development of our AI Security practice, aid in business development and contribute innovative ideas and initiatives to Aimpoint Digital.

Baseline skills requirements include, though are not limited to:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Strong written and verbal skills; specifically with respect to C-Suite / Executive communication
  • Experience designing and delivering enterprise security architectures (projects or otherwise), particularly across Cloud, SaaS, data, application or security operations
  • Experience securing SaaS platforms using SSO, SCIM, RBAC, MFA, conditional access, logging DLP, lifecycle management and administrative controls
  • Experience working with identity providers and collaboration platforms like Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub and/or GitLab
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms such as AWS, Azure and/or GCP
  • Experience with secure SDLC, application security testing, API security, secrets management, vulnerability management and software supply chain (this is a must-have)
  • Experience performing threat modelling and translating risk into practical technical and operational controls
  • Experience integrating security telemetry into SIEM/SOAR platforms such as Splunk, Sentinel, Datadog or similar technologies
  • 5+ years experience in security engineering, cloud security, application security, data security, IAM, security architecture or security operations
  • 5+ years experience working with cloud / enterprise SaaS platforms or modern data platforms (specifically Databricks / Snowflake / Fabric / Big Query)
  • Experience with generative AI platforms; Claude Enterprise specifically
  • Familiarity with LLM security risks such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, retrieval abuse and software supply chain risk
  • Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or similar frameworks is desirable
  • Experience with Python, APIs, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, container technologies, or infrastructure-as-code security is desirable
  • Experience conducting AI red teaming, adversarial testing, abuse-case analysis, or model-integrated application security reviews is desirable
  • Advanced certification in one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, is desirable
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GIAC, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or similar credentials are desirable

This position is fully-remote; however, Atlanta-based applicants will have the opportunity to work in our headquarters in Sandy Springs, GA.

About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open-source systems projects is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help connect exceptional talent with exciting career opportunities across multiple industries and client organizations.

This is a full-cycle recruiting role where you’ll own the hiring process from sourcing and screening through candidate presentation and interview coordination. You’ll work closely with clients, hiring managers, and candidates to ensure an efficient hiring process while delivering an exceptional experience at every stage.

If you’re passionate about recruiting, enjoy building talent pipelines, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Candidate Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Management

  • Create and publish engaging job postings across multiple hiring platforms.
  • Source top talent through:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Networking
    • Employee referrals
    • Boolean search
    • Passive candidate outreach
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and candidate response rates.

Candidate Screening & Assessment

  • Conduct structured phone and video interviews.
  • Evaluate candidates based on:
    • Technical qualifications
    • Professional experience
    • Communication skills

  • Prepare detailed interview evaluations and hiring recommendations.

  • Share hiring market insights and recruitment recommendations.

Recruitment Operations

  • Keep recruitment pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Track hiring progress and recruitment metrics.
  • Support onboarding activities to ensure a smooth candidate transition.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and operational efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Passionate about connecting great people with meaningful career opportunities.
  • Excellent relationship-builder with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and ownership-driven.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Previous experience in:
    • Talent Acquisition
    • Recruitment
    • Staffing
    • Full-cycle hiring

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience sourcing candidates using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Referrals
    • Networking
    • Boolean search techniques
  • Experience conducting structured interviews.
  • Strong candidate evaluation and assessment skills.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
  • Experience coordinating multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with video conferencing platforms for remote interviews.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience recruiting for remote or international positions.
  • Agency or staffing firm recruitment experience.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple industries and functional roles.
  • Advanced sourcing and Boolean search expertise.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review hiring priorities and active requisitions.
  • Source candidates across LinkedIn Recruiter and multiple recruiting platforms.
  • Screen resumes and conduct structured interviews.
  • Coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
  • Present shortlisted candidates with detailed evaluations.
  • Maintain ATS records and recruitment pipelines.
  • Support onboarding and candidate communications.
  • Continuously strengthen talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

In short: You’ll identify, engage, and hire exceptional talent while providing an outstanding recruitment experience for both candidates and clients.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Fill
  • Quality of Candidates Submitted
  • Interview-to-Offer Ratio
  • Candidate Response Rate
  • Client Satisfaction
  • ATS Accuracy
  • Candidate Experience
  • Offer Acceptance Rate

Why Join Us?

  • Own the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing through onboarding.
  • Recruit across diverse industries and functional roles.
  • High-impact role directly supporting client growth.
  • Collaborative, remote-first work environment.

    • Lead Recruiter
    • Talent Acquisition Manager
    • Recruitment Manager

Interview Process

  1. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer & Onboarding

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about recruiting, enjoy building strong talent pipelines, and want to make a direct impact by helping companies hire exceptional people, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team dedicated to delivering outstanding hiring experiences.

Synera is on a mission to accelerate engineering with AI. We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany, France and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us.

👉 Your Role

Joining us as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) in France you’ll be the first voice our future customers hear — C-level deciders, engineering leaders, innovation teams, and thought leaders at forward-thinking deep-tech companies.

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities.

Let’s be real: this role is hands-on. You’ll spend a lot of time picking up the phone, sending messages, following up, and getting through to tough prospects. Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. If you are hungry to take the first step towards a sales career in one of the most exciting fields there is, you have come to the right place.

👉 Your main focus areas:

  • Pipeline Building: You qualify leads and set up meetings for the Account Executive team.

  • Prospect & Qualify: You engage senior leaders and decision-makers via cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls, reaching 60+ activities per day).

  • Outbound Excellence: You shape and manage targeted outbound campaigns, working with the Marketing team to optimize messaging.

  • Engage & tell great stories: You spark interest in Synera’s Agentic AI solutions through compelling storytelling and value-driven conversations. You experiment and find creative ways to engage with senior leaders and build trustful relationships

  • Iterate & Improve: You analyze outreach performance, test new approaches, and refine our SDR playbook.

  • You know our domain inside out: who our ideal customers are, what keeps them up at night, and how Synera solves their biggest challenges. You have become an AI native, and curiosity is what drives you daily.

  • You routinely create great Discovery Calls, proving you can turn outreach into meaningful conversations for our Sales team. You have gained great confidence in explaining and pitching a complex tech product.

  • You are a power user of our tools and workflows - from prospecting platforms to CRM systems. Giving and receiving feedback has become a normal part of your day.

  • You understand what makes our product special and be able to speak authentically about the value we bring to teams who want to transform what they do with AI. You love to share knowledge and good practices in an international team.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 What’s in it for you?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Mid-level (OTE): 51.900€ - 60.400€

  • Senior (OTE): 42.800€ - 87.400€

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • Flexible working: you decide when and where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of $2,500. You’ll also have the chance to grow together with us!

  • We don't count your vacation days as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Access to the mental health platform nilo to support your well-being.

  • We support you with health insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan.

  • Regular team events, in the US or abroad (Germany)🌈

Requirements

🌱 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You have proven experience in outbound B2B SaaS sales.

  • You are proficient with CRM systems and modern outbound tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, and Aircall.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Sales Development team.

Job Description: Chief Anti-Money Laundering Officer (Chief AML Officer / CAMLO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

The Chief AML Officer (CAMLO) is responsible for leading the organization's Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), and financial crime prevention programs. This role ensures compliance with all applicable AML/CFT regulations and protects the organization from financial crime risks, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions violations.

The CAMLO serves as the primary authority on AML matters, overseeing policies, systems, investigations, and regulatory engagement to maintain a strong compliance and risk management framework.

Key Responsibilities

1. AML/CFT Strategy & Program Management

Develop and implement enterprise-wide AML/CFT strategies and frameworks

Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and international standards (e.g., FATF guidelines)

Continuously enhance AML programs to address emerging risks

Promote a strong financial crime compliance culture

2. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with AML/CFT laws, regulations, and regulatory expectations

Oversee timely and accurate regulatory reporting (e.g., suspicious transaction reports – STRs)

Act as the primary liaison with regulators and financial intelligence units (FIUs)

Manage regulatory inspections, audits, and reviews

3. Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC)

Oversee KYC, CDD, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) processes

Ensure proper onboarding and monitoring of customers

Implement risk-based customer profiling and segmentation

Monitor high-risk customers and politically exposed persons (PEPs)

4. Transaction Monitoring & Investigations

Oversee transaction monitoring systems and suspicious activity detection

Lead investigations into suspicious transactions and financial crime risks

Ensure timely escalation and reporting of suspicious activities

Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory bodies when required

5. Sanctions & Financial Crime Risk Management

Manage sanctions screening and compliance programs

Ensure adherence to international sanctions regimes

Identify and mitigate financial crime risks across the organization

Implement controls to prevent fraud, bribery, and corruption

6. Policies, Controls & Governance

Develop and maintain AML policies, procedures, and internal controls

Ensure audit readiness and documentation standards

Conduct regular AML risk assessments

Align AML programs with enterprise risk and compliance frameworks

7. Training & Awareness

Develop AML training programs for employees

Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and risks

Ensure staff understand policies and reporting requirements

Foster a culture of vigilance and compliance

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop AML and financial crime compliance teams

Establish performance standards and accountability

Drive continuous improvement and innovation in AML practices

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in AML, compliance, financial crime, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior AML leadership roles (e.g., Chief AML Officer, Head of AML, Financial Crime Leader)

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and frameworks (e.g., FATF, local regulations)

Expertise in KYC, transaction monitoring, and investigations

Strong analytical and risk assessment skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High ethical standards and attention to detail

Ability to manage complex regulatory environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Compliance with AML/CFT regulations

Timeliness and accuracy of STR/SAR filings

Effectiveness of transaction monitoring systems

Reduction in financial crime risks and incidents

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Employee AML training completion and awareness

jobs.description:
Job Title: Global Study Delivery Lead

Location: Remote-Flexible/Global

Job Type: Full-Time, exempt

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

SUMMARY

To lead and be accountable for Civia's global study delivery function, setting the standard for operational excellence, building high-performing delivery capability, and ensuring the successful delivery of all studies to time, cost, quality, and client expectations.

SCOPE

This is a hands-on, operational delivery role — not advisory and not a back-office systems function. The Global Study Delivery Lead is the global delivery authority for Civia’s studies, accountable for delivering them to time, cost, and quality, acting as a primary client point of contact, and owning project-management excellence across the organisation. Its defining way of working is close, day-to-day partnership with in-country delivery teams — enabling them and holding a single, high standard everywhere — and it is the single accountable owner of how delivery performance is reported. Where study-level delivery is managed at country level, this role owns delivery across the entire global portfolio, together with the methodology, baselines, and KPIs that make it repeatable.

The role operates at enterprise level within the study delivery leadership structure and holds no responsibility for strategic partners. The methodology, documentation, and reporting it builds are a means to an end: consistently delivering studies and exceeding client expectations.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Accountability for delivering Civia’s study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, globally
• Partnering closely with in-country delivery teams to raise and hold a single, high standard across every study and geography
• Acting as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, building trust and ensuring every commitment is met
• Ownership of project-management excellence across Civia, holding internal functions to account for delivery
• Direct, decisive intervention whenever delivery performance is at risk
• Identification, creation, and implementation of the methodology, documentation, baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that make delivery repeatable
• Sole ownership of study-performance reporting — ensuring delivery is represented accurately, currently, and in KPI terms always
• Sustained client confidence through delivery that consistently meets and exceeds expectations
• The accountable leader in Civia for setting the tone and expectations for study management, fostering excellence, and a mentor who develops less experienced delivery colleagues.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Study Delivery — Time, Cost & Quality

• Own delivery of the global study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, end to end across start-up, recruitment, execution, and close-out
• Maintain a forward-looking view of delivery health and forecast accuracy, and intervene directly and decisively when any study is at risk
• Drive the trade-offs and recovery actions that keep studies on schedule, on budget, and at the required quality
• Protect delivery quality, timelines, and cost discipline through proactive risk identification and resolution

Client Leadership & Point of Contact

• Act as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, owning the relationship and representing Civia’s delivery performance
• Provide transparent, forward-looking delivery communication — progress, risks, variance, and recovery actions
• Build trust through reliability and consistency, ensuring every commitment made to a client is met
• Enable repeat work by making Civia predictable and exceptional to deliver with

Project-Management Excellence Across Civia

• Own the standard of project-management excellence across Civia, leading the study delivery and project-management methodology
• Set clear ownership, decision rights, governance routines, and escalation pathways for study delivery
• Coach and uplift delivery and project-management capability so studies are run to a consistently high standard everywhere
• Hold internal functions accountable for their contribution to delivery commitments
• Mentor and develop more less experienced delivery and project-management colleagues, actively building the next generation of delivery talent

Global Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Work closely and continuously with in-country delivery teams— the primary partnership through which studies are delivered — enabling them, aligning on priorities, and holding a single, high standard everywhere
• Align Site Operations, Recruitment, Regulatory, Data, Quality, and Safety with country teams to deliver each study to plan
• Facilitate portfolio- and study-level delivery reviews and drive timely resolution of bottlenecks
• Establish clear accountability so every country team and function knows what it owns and by when
• Escalate constructively and act decisively when delivery performance deviates from plan

Methodology, Baselines, Forecasts & KPIs

• Identify, create, and implement Civia’s study delivery methodology, documentation, and processes — the means by which studies are delivered reliably
• Define the reporting baselines and forecasting models against which all study delivery is planned and measured
• Design, implement, and own the KPI framework for study delivery, ensuring metrics are meaningful, comparable, and acted upon globally
• Act as the single source of truth for study-performance reporting — owning the accuracy, currency, and integrity of every system, report, and KPI
• Embed a single, repeatable way of working that removes delivery variability across studies, sites, and geographies

Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement

• Establish disciplined governance routines and a performance cadence across the portfolio
• Ensure continuous audit and inspection readiness is built into delivery
• Lead corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives, closing the loop from insight to embedded change
• Continuously refine methodology based on delivery data, lessons learned, and evolving client and regulatory expectations

Performance Measures (KPIs)

• On-time delivery: Studies delivered to agreed timelines across the global portfolio
• On-budget delivery: Delivery to cost and margin protection across the portfolio
• Quality: Delivery to required quality, with continuous audit and inspection readiness sustained
• Portfolio delivery vs commitment: ≥100% of study commitments met across the global portfolio
• Client satisfaction: Strong sponsor feedback on delivery and repeat awards
• Country-team partnership: Strength of collaboration with in-country delivery teams, evidenced by consistent, high-quality delivery and expectations exceeded across geographies
• Forecast accuracy: Delivery performance tracking on or ahead of approved baselines and forecasts
• Reporting integrity: Study performance always represented accurately and current, with systems, reports, and KPIs trusted as the single source of truth
• Delivery variability: Year-on-year reduction in delivery variance and avoidable slippage
• Project-management maturity: Consistent, high-standard application of delivery methodology and KPIs across all studies and geographies

Experience & Qualifications:

Required Experience

• 10-15 years of relevant experience with deep operational understanding of clinical trial delivery and its dependencies
• Track record of delivering strategic and operational outcomes
• Proven ability to design, document, implement, and scale delivery and project-management systems
• Strong regulatory, GCP, GDPR and operational literacy
• Strong analytical and financial literacy — builds baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that hold up
• Platform experience with CRIO, HubSpot, and Monday.com

Mindset

• Deeply focused on delivery — driven to complete studies to time, cost, and quality
• Client-first and self-starting; takes ownership of the relationship and closes delivery gaps on their own initiative
• Uncompromising on delivery standards and determined to exceed client expectations

Behavior

• Brings structure, clarity, and a single way of working to complex, multi-geography delivery
• Operates hands-on and close to the work, building strong, trusting partnerships with in-country delivery teams to raise the standard everywhere
• Acts decisively when delivery is at risk; closes the loop from insight to embedded change
• Communicates with authority, transparency, and credibility at leadership level
• Focuses on practical solutions and supports others in learning and improving through challenges.

Personal Traits

• Highly accountable, resilient, and composed under pressure
• Self-directed, organised, and adaptive — treats being a self-starter as the baseline, not the goal
• Builds confidence with teams and stakeholders through follow-through and reliability
• Takes pride in honest, current reporting — owns delivery issues as a reflection of the function and moves quickly to put them right

Qualifications:

  • ​B.S. or B.A.; MBA or equivalent advantageous. Science related degree preferred.

We help clients plan, assess, improve and, where required, manage their datacentreoperations, providing objective advice and promoting best practice across mechanical, electrical, operational and commercial areas.

The Technical Manager operates in an advisory, governance and operational leadership capacity, ensuring the technical integrity, performance, compliance and effective day-to-day management of mechanical and electrical infrastructure within client datacentres.

The role provides technical oversight, due diligence and best-practice guidance, ensuring that engineering and operational activities—includingmobilisation, upgrades, new builds, ongoing site management and client service delivery—are delivered safely, efficiently and in line with client requirements, international standards, operational best practice and regulatory compliance.

A key part of the role is promoting and managing electrical safety governance. Acting as the High VoltageAuthorisedPerson (HVAP), the Technical Manager manages the appointment,authorisationand competency of personnel involved in HV and MV operations. The position ensures safe systems of work are applied, switching operations are controlled, and all activities comply with statutory and electrical safety requirements.

Alongside technical delivery, you will provide operational leadership for assigned sites and accounts. This includes leading and developing operational teams; managing client and vendor relationships; liaising with HR, finance and payroll teams; supporting billing and cost control; and contributing to the strategic development and growth of client accounts.

The role will also include structured development to become a subject-matter expert in artificial intelligence and its practical application within datacentreoperations. You will identify opportunities to use AI,automationand data-led insight to improve operational decision-making, reporting, maintenance planning, riskmanagementand service delivery.

To Be Successful in This Role, You Will Need To

  • Demonstrate experience in technical due diligence, operational readiness,mobilisationand performance evaluation for new and existing facilities.
  • Possess knowledge of colocation operations, lifecyclemanagementand industry best-practice frameworks.

  • Demonstrate commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, billing, financial controls, vendorperformanceand account development.
  • Be interested in the use of AI,automationand operational data to improve datacentreperformance and service delivery.
  • Communicate effectively with clients,consultantsand internal stakeholders at all levels.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Advisory, Governance and Site Operations

  • Provide technical governance and assurance across client datacentreenvironments.
  • Lead or support the day-to-day operational management of assigned sites and client accounts.
  • Support clients with due diligence reviews for acquisitions, newbuildsand upgrades.
  • Conduct technical and operational performance assessments to benchmark maturity,resilienceand compliance.
  • Develop recommendations and action plans to address risks, inefficiencies and resilience gaps.
  • Oversee operational processes including maintenance delivery, change control, incident response, emergencypreparednessand documentation management.

Operational Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead,developand support operational and engineering teams across assigned sites or accounts.
  • Establish clear expectations,accountabilities, performancemeasuresand development plans for team members.
  • Work with HR on recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, successionplanningand retention.
