jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior MarTech Manager to set the technology and operational strategy behind our marketing programs. This person will define how marketing strategy, data, systems, and execution connect, ensuring our tools work together, data is trustworthy, and teams can scale their use of technology to acquire, engage, and retain customers.

The ideal candidate operates at both altitudes: setting a multi-year MarTech strategy and architecture direction, while staying close enough to the stack to make sound build-vs-buy and integration calls. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over cross-functional priorities, vendor spend, and technical direction, partnering closely with Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Set strategy and own architecture decisions for the MarTech stack, including build-vs-buy calls and vendor relationships.
  • Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for marketing technology, automation, analytics, and personalization.
  • Direct the platform strategy for CRM, marketing automation, CDP, analytics, attribution, experimentation, and customer engagement tools.
  • Architect data flows between marketing systems, product systems, CRM, and the data warehouse, and set the standards other teams build against.
  • Establish and enforce governance standards for tracking, campaign setup, lifecycle management, and data quality across the org.
  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Data, Product and Engineering leadership (Director/VP level) to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
  • Identify and lead automation initiatives that materially reduce manual campaign operations.
  • Own the technical foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and reporting.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and contract negotiation; own implementation and adoption outcomes.
  • Build documentation, governance frameworks, and processes that make the MarTech ecosystem scalable and auditable.
  • Monitor system performance, data quality, and operational risk, and escalate/resolve complex issues before they become team-wide blockers.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to marketing ops or MarTech staff, even without formal reporting lines.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8-12 years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, growth operations, or a related field, with a track record of owning strategy, not just execution.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and influencing decisions at the Director/VP level.
  • Deep expertise across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, analytics, and integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce/HubSpot, Braze/Iterable, Segment, GA4, GTM, Snowflake/BigQuery, Zapier, Workato, OneTrust, and related platforms.
  • Strong SQL, API, and data integration fluency, with the judgment to know when to build vs. delegate.
  • Track record managing cross-functional projects, external vendors, and budget/spend decisions.
  • Executive-level communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical leadership.
  • Comfortable setting direction in ambiguity, without waiting for complete information.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building or modernizing a MarTech stack from the ground up, ideally at more than one company.
  • Experience in healthcare, consumer technology, subscription, or other data-rich, regulated environments.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, attribution, lifecycle marketing, or personalization strategy.
  • Strong grasp of privacy, consent, and data governance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA if healthcare).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $135,000-$150,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner closely with leaders across our Software and Firmware Engineering teams to manage Cloud, Cellular, and AI vendor spend
  • Analyze financial results, prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting, and support financial review meetings with R&D and Finance leadership
  • Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities, cost classification, and reporting requests
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to drive AOP planning
  • Improve the accuracy and scalability of existing financial reporting and forecasting models
  • Develop new mechanisms, analysis, or KPIs to inspect business performance
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analysis workflows
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Experience at a high-growth tech company
  • Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally in a fast-paced, often changing environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to senior management
  • Proactive and highly organized self-starter, able to work independently under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with AWS cloud cost and general SaaS cost management
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Glean, Cursor, etc.), Databricks, and FP&A tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar planning systems) and NetSuite

  • Passion for building new models, processes, and mechanisms

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$83,300—$140,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. You

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. About the role

Our security teams pull data from a lot of separate systems. Asset inventory, identity governance, detection tooling, and threat intel all live in different places, so answering a basic question like which systems an attacker could reach from a compromised account can take a security analyst most of a day.

We're building a platform that connects those systems behind a shared API and knowledge layer so those questions can be answered in seconds. We are not replacing the source systems or copying their data.

You would be a senior individual contributor on a small team, responsible for whole areas of the platform: designing the API contracts, building the services behind them, getting them into production, and working with partner teams to actually adopt them.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code, define interfaces other teams build against, and work directly with stakeholders in detection engineering, red team, blue team, and identity and asset management.

What you'll do

  • Design and build the platform's core APIs, covering context retrieval, risk scoring, entity resolution, data contracts, and coverage queries.
  • Build and run asynchronous data pipelines on a message bus with a governed schema registry.
  • Integrate security data sources including SIEM, identity governance, asset inventory, and our knowledge graph.
  • Own platform workstreams from scoping through delivery, including the cross-team coordination that takes.
  • Write design proposals and review other people's, as part of the platform's RFC process.
  • Review code, mentor engineers on partner teams who contribute to the platform, and keep the technical documentation usable.

  • Expert-level Python: data processing at scale, API development, and real testing discipline in a production codebase.

  • A real cybersecurity background: security operations, detection engineering, threat detection, incident response, or security data engineering. You should know how security telemetry gets produced and consumed, and be comfortable with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Project ownership at a senior IC level. You have taken an initiative from a vague problem statement to a delivered result, worked across team boundaries to do it, and kept engineering leadership informed without needing to be managed through it.

Beneficial qualifications

  • Data science experience: statistical analysis, feature engineering, anomaly detection, or building and evaluating models against noisy operational data.
  • Applied AI or ML experience, particularly LLM-based systems, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, or agentic workflows, along with some interest in the security side of enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience with identity governance or asset inventory platforms.
  • Experience defining data contracts or governance models for internal platform consumers.

By the end of your first year you own one or more of the platform's core APIs, partner teams are building against contracts you wrote, and you are one of the people whose opinion carries weight in architecture and design discussions for the program.

Job Title: Cloud / DevOps Exploitation SpecialistJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Cloud/DevOps Exploitation Specialist to build, secure, assess, and evolve the AWS environment that supports continuous attack-surface operations. This hands-on role combines advanced Terraform and Ansible engineering. The role also validates cloud identity/authorization paths, supply-chain vulnerabilities, and CI/CD exploitation scenarios. The specialist will make assessment infrastructure repeatable, and version controlled while also validating cloud and DevOps attack paths within approved scope.

This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS network, IAM, compute, storage, data, logging, and security services using reusable Terraform modules and Ansible automation.
  • Operate secure version-control, review, testing, state-management, secrets-management, approval, deployment, rollback, and change-audit processes for infrastructure as code.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that deploy assessment infrastructure and integrate IaC, secrets, dependency, container, registry, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Assess AWS, CI/CD, container, registry, Kubernetes, and IaC configurations for exploitable weaknesses; safely validate privilege escalation, lateral movement, supply-chain, and data-exposure paths when authorized.
  • Test Kubernetes/EKS governance, service account privilege escalation, and container breakout vectors.
  • Investigate IaC misconfigurations by exploiting tfsec/Checkov findings to demonstrate realistic attack feasibility.
  • Harden and monitor assessment infrastructure while preserving the flexibility required for scanning, reconnaissance, controlled exploitation, and rapid response.
  • Develop Python, Bash, PowerShell automation, APIs, and operational tooling; maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, module documentation, and recovery procedures.
  • Partner with Attack Surface Testing engineers and customer platform owners to troubleshoot issues, control cost and performance, and deliver secure, repeatable technical capabilities.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • The selected candidate must meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information and be able to obtain a Public Trust fitness determination (High Risk).
  • Ability to work in customer-provided remote environments, use customer-approved tools, and comply with rules of engagement, data-handling requirements, evidence controls, deconfliction procedures, and stop-work criteria.
  • Five or more years of cloud, DevOps, DevSecOps, platform-engineering, or cloud-security experience, including at least three years of hands-on AWS and infrastructure-as-code work.
  • Advanced practical experience with Terraform and Ansiblein version-controlled production environments, including modules, remote state, secrets, testing, approvals, and repeatable deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS IAM, VPC/networking, EC2/compute, S3/storage, KMS, CloudTrail/logging, serverless, container, and data-service security.
  • Hands-on experience withCI/CD and container ecosystems such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and ECR or comparable tools.
  • Experience with security testing tools such as Checkov/tfsec, Trivy/Grype, Prowler/ScoutSuite, Semgrep, SAST/DAST, secrets scanning, and cloud-native security services.
  • Strong Linux, networking, Git, and scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

Desired:

  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect/DevOps Professional, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CKS/CKA, GCSA, or comparable credentials.
  • Experience building short-lived or segmented offensive-security/assessment infrastructure with strong auditability and teardown controls.
  • Experience exploiting IAM, CI/CD, container, registry, Kubernetes, serverless, metadata-service, or IaC weaknesses in authorized assessments.
  • Experience with policy as code, OPA/Conftest, SBOM, software-supply-chain controls, observability, and cost/performance optimization.
  • Federal cloud, FedRAMP, GovCloud, DHS/CISA, or high-assurance environment experience
-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.

Business Development Representative

About the Role

Location: Remote, India

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to join our Channel Sales team and build the pipeline that powers Plooto's Accountant Channel across the US and Canada. Accounting and bookkeeping firms are one of Plooto's most important growth channels, and you'll be on the front line of identifying and engaging the firms best positioned to bring their clients onto Plooto.

You'll run structured outbound prospecting against accounting and bookkeeping firms, qualify their fit as a potential partner, and book meetings for the Partnerships and Channel Sales team to take from there. This is a pure hunting role: your success is measured by the quality and volume of partner conversations you create.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and research accounting and bookkeeping firms across the US and Canada to build a targeted, qualified list of potential channel partners.
  • Execute multi-channel outbound cadences (email, phone, LinkedIn) to engage firm principals and decision-makers, adapting messaging to how accountants actually work.
  • Qualify firms against Plooto's partner ICP (client base size, vertical mix, existing tech stack) before booking a meeting.
  • Book and hand off qualified discovery meetings to the Partnerships and Channel Sales team, with clean context so nothing gets re-asked.
  • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene in Salesforce, with accurate lead stages, timely disposition logging, and quality outreach notes.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Partnerships to refine channel messaging, talk tracks, and target account lists based on what you're hearing in the field.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated for the Accountant Channel.
  • Share objection patterns and market feedback to help sharpen the team's channel prospecting playbook.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 1-3 years of B2B SaaS or fintech business development, SDR, or BDR experience with a consistent track record of hitting outbound pipeline targets.
  • Comfortable with high-volume outbound prospecting; you know how to build a cadence and keep it running.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills; you can quickly assess whether a firm is a real fit before booking a meeting.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM; you keep your outreach pipeline clean and use data to prioritize your list.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; confident on the phone and equally effective in async channels.

Nice-to-Have

  • Prior experience prospecting into accounting, bookkeeping, or professional services firms, or channel/partner sales experience more broadly.
  • Familiarity with the accounting software ecosystem (QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite) and how firms make software decisions for their clients.
  • Experience with sales engagement tools such as outreach sequencing platforms or VoIP tools like Aircall.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth or fast-changing environment where you've had to adapt quickly as the playbook evolved.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We're transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow, and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You'll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We're just getting started, and you'll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Doctorate in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Immunology, or a related field [and relevant post-doc where applicable] and 3 years of scientific/technical industry experience

  • Experience in the transfer of immunogenicity assays to bioanalytical CROs
  • Knowledge of statistical approaches applied to immunogenicity assays

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to build, manage, and optimize automated marketing campaigns, email workflows, lead nurturing programs, and CRM automation.

This is a hands-on marketing operations role focused on turning marketing systems into measurable pipeline and revenue growth.

You’ll work across:

  • Lead scoring and lifecycle automation
  • CRM integration and lead routing
  • Audience segmentation and database management
  • Campaign analytics and optimization

Marketing Automation & Workflows

  • Build, launch, and optimize automated marketing workflows
  • Create:
    • Lead nurture campaigns
    • Drip sequences
    • Trigger-based automations
    • Lifecycle workflows
    • Re-engagement campaigns
  • Develop and maintain lead scoring models
  • Troubleshoot workflow logic, triggers, and automation errors
  • Continuously improve automation performance and reliability

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Pardot (Account Engagement)
    • ActiveCampaign
    • Klaviyo
  • Create and optimize email sequences for different audiences and lifecycle stages
  • Conduct A/B tests across:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • Calls-to-action (CTAs)
    • Send strategies
  • Ensure emails are mobile-responsive, brand-consistent, and conversion-focused
  • Monitor email deliverability and engagement performance

CRM, Lead Management & Sales Alignment

  • Integrate marketing automation platforms with CRMs including:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot CRM
    • Zoho CRM
  • Build and maintain accurate lead routing and handoff workflows
  • Ensure qualified leads reach sales teams quickly and correctly

Lead Scoring & Audience Segmentation

    • Engagement

    • Demographics
    • Lifecycle stage
    • Buying intent
  • Create targeted audience segments based on:
    • Industry
    • Persona
    • Behavior
    • Engagement

  • Maintain clean and organized marketing databases

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track key marketing metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Click-through rates
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
    • Pipeline contribution
    • Revenue impact
  • Build dashboards and reports using HubSpot, Marketo, Power BI, or Tableau
  • Analyze campaign and workflow performance
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data

Marketing Operations & Optimization

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes
  • Test new workflows, messaging, and audience strategies
  • Improve campaign efficiency and scalability
  • Support attribution and revenue reporting
  • Maintain compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CCPA
  • Stay current with marketing automation trends and platform updates

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 2+ years of marketing automation or marketing operations experience
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major marketing automation platform:
    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Pardot (Account Engagement)
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Experience building:
    • Automated workflows
    • Lead nurture campaigns
    • Email campaigns
    • Lead scoring models
    • Audience segments
  • Experience working with CRM systems and lead management workflows
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Email marketing
    • Marketing operations
    • CRM workflows
    • Email deliverability
    • Data management
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • High attention to detail and strong execution skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot CRM, or Zoho CRM
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, or growth marketing
  • Familiarity with:
    • Multi-touch attribution
    • Revenue Operations (RevOps)
    • Marketing analytics
    • Funnel optimization
  • Experience using Zapier, APIs, or third-party integrations
  • Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau

Tools You May Use

  • HubSpot
  • Marketo
  • Pardot / Account Engagement
  • ActiveCampaign
  • Klaviyo
  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot CRM
  • Zoho CRM
  • Zapier
  • Excel / Google Sheets
  • Power BI / Tableau
  • API integrations

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in systems, workflows, and automation
  • You enjoy building processes that scale
  • You understand how marketing automation impacts pipeline and revenue
  • You’re comfortable working across marketing and sales teams
  • You use data to identify what’s working and what needs improvement
  • You catch workflow and data issues quickly
  • You can manage multiple campaigns and automations simultaneously
  • You focus on measurable outcomes, not simply launching campaigns

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing active campaigns, workflow performance, lead routing, and email engagement metrics.

From there, you’ll build or optimize nurture sequences, troubleshoot automation issues, update audience segments, review lead scoring, and ensure qualified leads are routed correctly to sales.

You’ll also analyze campaign performance, clean CRM data, run A/B tests, update reporting dashboards, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer III at Rise8, you will:

  • Assist in automating the provisioning and configuration of IT environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies.

  • Apply cybersecurity concepts across threats, vulnerabilities, encryption, boundary defense, and risk management practices.
  • Support identity and access management initiatives by implementing least-privilege models and cross-account role configurations.
  • Create and maintain security documentation, including network diagrams, data flow diagrams, and operational manuals.

jobs.description:
The Campaign Operations Coordinator plays an essential role in the successful execution of influencer marketing campaigns at NeoReach. This position ensures that campaigns run smoothly from kickoff to completion, with a focus on organization, communication, and delivering measurable results for our clients. Acting as the bridge between internal teams, influencers, and brand partners, the Campaign Operations Coordinator is responsible for managing timelines, coordinating deliverables, reviewing content, and tracking performance metrics. This role requires exceptional attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Campaign Execution & Coordination

  • Oversee and manage the day-to-day operations of influencer marketing campaigns, ensuring timely execution and delivery of all campaign deliverables.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (creative, paid media, account management, etc.) to ensure all deliverables align with the client’s strategy and objectives.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for influencers, ensuring clear communication on campaign objectives, content expectations, timelines, and brand guidelines.

Influencer Identification & Outreach

  • Research and select influencers that align with client goals, campaign strategy, and target audience demographics.
  • Conduct outreach, manage negotiations, and finalize influencer contracts in coordination with the Account Director.
  • Ensure influencers receive all necessary campaign materials, including creative briefs and brand guidelines, to execute content effectively.

Content Review & Approvals

  • Review influencer content to ensure it meets brand messaging, tone, and campaign objectives.
  • Collaborate with Account Directors and clients to approve content before publication.
  • Provide feedback and revisions to influencers to ensure all deliverables meet brand compliance standards.

Tracking & Reporting

  • Monitor campaign performance metrics (reach, impressions, engagement, conversions, etc.) throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Compile and deliver regular campaign performance reports to Account Directors, including KPI tracking, insights, and recommendations for optimization.
  • Maintain detailed records of campaign deliverables, approvals, and timelines to keep campaigns on schedule.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers and creators to foster long-term collaboration opportunities.
  • Act as the liaison between clients, influencers, and internal teams to ensure alignment and transparent communication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly to minimize disruptions to campaign flow.

Post-Campaign Analysis

  • Partner with Account Directors to evaluate campaign success, ROI, and strategic takeaways.
  • Consolidate learnings and provide actionable recommendations for future campaigns.

Issue Resolution & Problem Solving

  • Work closely with Account Directors to address any challenges related to influencer performance, content quality, or platform issues.
  • Identify and implement solutions promptly to keep campaigns on track.

Requirements

Key Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in influencer marketing, campaign coordination, account management, or a related field.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external correspondence.
  • Experience working with influencer management platforms, project management tools, and analytics dashboards is preferred.
  • Ability to analyze performance data and translate it into actionable recommendations.
  • Proactive problem-solver with a collaborative mindset.
  • Passion for influencer marketing, digital media, and emerging social platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with influencers across multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
  • Proficiency in using influencer marketing tools and campaign management software.
  • Familiarity with paid media strategies to amplify influencer content.

Benefits

This role offers a competitive base salary, complemented by a performance-driven commission structure.

jobs.description:
EmploymentFull TimeCompensation$80,000-$105,000, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capabilityTeamTax, with a PracticeDen market specializationReports toLiz Sandstrom, EA, Tax ManagerStart dateFlexible, as early as September 22, 2026 and as late as January 4, 2027LocationRemote within approved U.S. work locationsTravelPossible quarterly all-hands meetings and occasional destination CPE, fully reimbursed within firm policy

Sharp tax work. An accounting brain. A soft spot for better systems.

Job postings are funny

They are often part wish list, part sales pitch, and part collection of phrases no human has ever used in conversation. That does not tell you what the work feels like, who you will work with, or whether you will actually enjoy being here. We would rather be honest, so here is the real story.

About PracticeDen and R.D. Barnett PLLC

PracticeDen grew out of R.D. Barnett PLLC, the tax, accounting, and advisory firm Dean Barnett founded to help entrepreneurs and privately held businesses make smarter financial decisions. Years of sitting beside business owners - not just filing returns for them - made one thing clear: independent veterinary practice owners deserved an advisor who understood both the numbers and the wonderfully complicated business behind them.

That is where PracticeDen comes in. We connect the entire financial picture, from the operating practice and related real estate to the owner's individual tax situation. We work with veterinary owners as they start, buy, operate, grow, and eventually transition their practices. The goal is bigger than accurate filings. We want our clients to understand their numbers, spot opportunities earlier, make confident decisions, and spend less time wondering what their accountant is talking about.

PracticeDen is the veterinary-focused brand of R.D. Barnett PLLC. It is not a separate firm or a tax-only team. This role has a functional home in Tax and works across PracticeDen with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates so the practice, related real estate, and owner return tell one coherent story.

The Role (and Why It's Interesting)

We are looking for an experienced, hard-working, and self-motivated Senior Tax Associate who can prepare a wide variety of returns, hand off thoughtful, reviewer-ready work, and help us make tax season run a little smarter. You will work across entity and individual clients, often following the numbers across a veterinary practice, related real estate, and the owner's personal return.

This role reports to Liz Sandstrom, EA, Tax Manager. Liz leads the tax side of PracticeDen and will be your primary coach, reviewer, supervisor, and escalation point. You will own day-to-day execution, workpaper quality, status visibility, and early issue identification. Liz will set technical direction, approve material positions, and help you grow toward greater independence, planning exposure, client leadership, and review responsibility.

Tax preparation is the main event. You will gather information, build workpapers, prepare calculations and returns, support planning, handle e-filing and delivery, research unusual issues, and help resolve notices or other technical projects. In other words: you will do real tax work from beginning to end, not spend your days moving numbers from one box to another without understanding why.

This is also not a stay-in-your-lane-forever role. While traditional accounting work won’t be your primary responsibility, a strong accounting brain is essential. You should be able to read a trial balance, understand the financial statements, reconcile important accounts, propose adjustments, and recognize when the accounting needs attention before a return can move forward. Recurring bookkeeping is not part of this role unless separately assigned and scoped.

As PracticeDen grows, this role can grow with it. We do not expect you to know every answer. We do expect you to be genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose: ask better questions, trace the issue to its source, and move toward a sensible answer. Prior veterinary-industry experience is welcome but not required. Curiosity about independent veterinary ownership is.

What You'll Actually Do

Make tax work look easy

  • Prepare the returns. All kinds of them. That includes federal, state, and local returns for individuals and closely held entities, with a core mix of Forms 1040, 1065, 1120-S, and 1120. It may also include trusts and estates, related real estate entities, and other returns as assigned.
  • Make review a pleasant experience. Build clean, complete workpapers with clear support, reconciliations, calculations, notes, and tie-outs. Your reviewer should not need detective training to follow your work.
  • Follow the financial trail. Connect practice, real estate, and individual filings so every related return tells the same story.
  • Bring an accounting brain to the return. Reconcile balance-sheet accounts, retained earnings, fixed assets, basis, owner activity, payroll, sales or excise tax, and other book-to-tax items that are part of the engagement.
  • Know what went into the software. Enter and validate tax data, carryforwards, fixed assets, prior-year items, and current-year activity in UltraTax CS or a comparable platform.
  • Raise your hand early. Spot missing information, inconsistencies, unusual issues, capacity concerns, and potential deadline problems before they become deadline-day surprises.
  • See the process through. Help with extensions, estimates, e-filing, secure delivery, tax notices, and the less-glamorous details that still have to be right.
  • Know when the work has changed. Recognize services outside the agreed scope and bring them to Liz before committing to additional work, fees, or timing.
  • Support planning without freelancing. Identify potential planning opportunities, research assigned questions, document the facts and authority, and bring clear recommendations and unresolved questions to Liz.

Use technology like you mean it

  • Make Excel earn its keep. Build traceable workpapers and useful analyses, clean up data, review trial balances, and propose journal entries without turning the workbook into a haunted house.
  • Pick up new tools quickly. Tax software, workflow platforms, portals, collaboration tools-if it makes the work better, you should be comfortable learning it.
  • Use AI thoughtfully, not blindly. Look for responsible ways to improve research, documentation, data handling, and repetitive workflows. Use only firm-approved systems, protect client information, verify every output, and remain accountable for the final work.
  • Notice when a process is clunky, then improve it. Test practical fixes, document what works, and help us scale without trading accuracy for speed.

Be a great human to work with

  • Keep people out of the dark. Communicate about status, open items, scope, risks, and deadlines before someone has to chase you.
  • Write like a person. Draft clear, professional client emails and explain requests without burying the point in tax jargon.
  • Treat review notes as fuel. Ask thoughtful questions, apply the feedback, and make the next engagement better.
  • Help shape the Den. Contribute to documentation, training, and the systems and habits our growing team will rely on.
  • Work across the team. Coordinate with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates when the tax return exposes an accounting issue, planning opportunity, or client need.

What You Bring to the Den

The must-haves

  • Real tax experience. You have at least three years of recent public accounting tax experience, including at least two busy seasons owning returns from client intake through reviewer submission. You can prepare a varied return mix, understand what the numbers mean, and deliver work that is truly ready for review.
  • Individual and entity experience. You have meaningful experience with individual and closely held business returns, not just one narrow slice of a return.
  • A strong accounting brain. You can read financial statements, reconcile accounts, understand journal entries, and trace activity into a tax return without losing the plot.
  • Excel power-user energy. Formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and well-organized workpapers should feel familiar, not frightening.
  • An eye for the tiny things. You catch the transposed number, the missing support, and the line that does not tie before someone else does.
  • AI and automation curiosity. When you see a repetitive process, you naturally wonder whether a robot should be doing the boring part. You are excited to test better ways of working, but you do not hand the robot the keys and walk away. Approved tools, client privacy, professional judgment, and verified outputs are nonnegotiable.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You write well, think before you act, and can receive feedback without turning it into a courtroom drama.
  • Busy-season stamina. You are prepared for 55+ hours during the heaviest filing-deadline stretches, typically February through April 15 and September through October 15. We hope that is reserved for the worst of times, not the regular rhythm. Busy season should be a season, not a year-round personality.
  • Remote-work reliability. You maintain a secure, professional workspace, dependable internet, and availability for Pacific Time collaboration during agreed working hours.
  • Professional references from prior employers, supervisors, or clients.

CPA or Enrolled Agent credential is not required. We value demonstrated capability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continued learning.

Bonus points for:

  • CPA license, EA certification, CPA eligibility, or active progress toward a credential
  • Experience reviewing simpler returns or training less-experienced preparers
  • Tax-tech fluency with UltraTax CS or another professional preparation platform, e-file and portal workflows, or digital delivery tools
  • A useful AI or automation story: something you improved, sped up, or made less painful in a tax or accounting workflow
  • Comfort around the broader accounting stack, such as QuickBooks, Workpapers CS, Practice CS, SurePrep, SafeSend, SharePoint, Notion, Missive, , Gusto, Double, or similar systems
  • Experience with wonderfully complicated owners: closely held businesses, multi-entity structures, real estate, professional practices, or veterinary-industry clients
  • Multistate, pass-through entity tax, basis, fixed asset, owner compensation, or closely held business planning experience

You'll probably thrive here if...

  • You keep the details on a short leash. Projects, files, open questions, and deadlines do not mysteriously disappear on your watch.
  • You communicate before people have to ask. A clear update today is better than a heroic explanation tomorrow.
  • You care about service. You want clients and teammates to have a genuinely good experience, and you are willing to take out the trash - literally or figuratively - when that is what helps.
  • You can be trusted. You use discretion, exercise good judgment, and protect sensitive client information as if it were your own.
  • You are genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose. You ask why, research and test what you do not know, and turn curiosity into a practical next step instead of collecting interesting questions for sport.
  • You own your work. Mistakes happen; hiding them or repeating them is the problem. You speak up, fix the issue, and learn from it.
  • You can handle change. PracticeDen is growing, technology keeps moving, and the perfect process may not exist yet.
  • You take the work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. Public accounting is demanding. A sense of humor makes the hard days better.
  • You build momentum as a form of mutual appreciation. You follow through, communicate early, and move work forward because making teammates chase you is nobody's love language.

How You'll Know You're Crushing It

  • Your reviewer can follow your work without a scavenger hunt. Returns tie, support is clear, and avoidable review notes become rare.
  • There are fewer surprises. Missing information, odd activity, planning ideas, scope changes, and potential problems surface early.
  • People trust your follow-through. Client requests make sense, deadlines stay visible, and projects do not vanish into a status-update black hole.
  • The systems get smarter. You adopt new tools thoughtfully and improve processes without weakening accuracy, controls, or confidentiality.
  • The numbers work too. You meet the production, realization, timekeeping, and project-delivery expectations assigned to your role and portfolio.
  • You get better every cycle. Feedback shows up in the next engagement, and your confidence, judgment, and independence keep growing.

The Practical Stuff: Pay, Benefits, and Where You'll Work

Now, let's talk about the part of the job everyone scrolls for.

  • Compensation: Full-time, exempt position with a base salary of $80,000-$105,000 annually, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capability.
  • Flexible start: The position may begin as early as September 22, 2026 or as late as January 4, 2027.
  • Remote work: This is a remote position within U.S. states and localities approved by the firm. Changes in primary work location or regular work from another state or locality require advance approval.
  • Working hours: The role must maintain dependable availability for Pacific Time collaboration, client needs, training, and scheduled team meetings. The heaviest filing-deadline stretches may require 55+ hours, but that should describe the worst of times, not most of the time.
  • Travel: Travel may be requested for quarterly all-hands firm meetings and occasional destination continuing professional education. The firm will fully reimburse approved business travel in accordance with firm travel and expense policies.
  • Equipment: The firm provides the computer and standard technology equipment needed for the role, including monitors, keyboard, mouse, headset, and related accessories.
  • Medical, dental, and vision: The firm currently pays 100% of the employee premium for its medical plan (BCBS PPO) and dental and vision plans (Delta Dental PPO). Coverage begins on the first day of the month following the employee's start date. Dependents may be added at the employee's cost. Benefits remain subject to plan terms.
  • 401(k): The firm currently matches employee contributions up to 3% of eligible pay. Eligibility begins on the employee's start date, subject to plan terms and the applicable vesting schedule.
  • Paid holidays: Six current firm holidays - New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day - plus four floating holidays. Tax-season blackout dates apply.
  • Vacation: Fifteen vacation days per calendar year, prorated based on the official start date. Vacation is subject to the firm calendar and busy-season blackout periods.
  • Paid sick and safe time: Accrual begins on the first day of employment. The firm uses Seattle's paid sick and safe time requirements as its minimum standard and applies any more protective law required by the employee's work location.
  • Volunteer time: Two paid volunteer days.
  • Professional development: Continuing education and growth opportunities, including reimbursement for approved certification, licensing, professional membership, and destination CPE expenses within firm policy.
  • Optional cell-phone coverage: Participation in the firm's Verizon plan is available under the current cell-phone policy. The firm does not subsidize or reimburse the purchase of the device.
  • Personal tax support: Employees may use firm software to prepare their personal income tax returns and may request reasonable tax guidance from the firm's principals at no charge, subject to firm policy.

Ready to Join the Den?

If you are a strong tax preparer with an accounting mind, a sharp eye, and genuine curiosity about better technology, we would love to hear from you. Bring your judgment, your Excel shortcuts, and your best ideas for making tax work better. We will bring interesting clients, meaningful work, and a team that cares about doing both well!

Come join us in the Den.

How to Apply and How to Stand Out

Apply through the official job posting once it is live. We will consider complete applications in the following order:

  1. Introductory video: Candidates who submit a thoughtful 30-second to 3-minute introductory video will move to the top of the review list. Tell us who you are, why the role caught your attention, and what you would bring to PracticeDen. Production quality is not the point. We want to meet the human behind the resume.
  2. Thoughtful cover letter: Candidates who write a specific, genuine cover letter will be considered next.
  3. Standard application: We will also consider candidates who submit the application without a video or cover letter.

We notice thoughtful follow-up. A respectful LinkedIn message or direct email to a member of our team after applying can help us understand your interest and how you communicate. Please keep it human, specific, and concise.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

R.D. Barnett PLLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will design, build, and operate the systems behind our AI products.

Your work will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

Shape our AI engineering practice

  • Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.

  • Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.

Extra awesome

Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Powering that scale takes engineering talent well beyond our home markets - which is where Kenya comes in.

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live - which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success. We already have a small number of team members in engineering based out of Kenya, who have become central to how we build and run our platform globally.

So, now we are now looking for our Head of Engineering, POS Apps to join us in India.

About the role

More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint - and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.

We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational Kotlin-based engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation - the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.

We currently operate across five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.

And the scope is growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition which just finalized in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its expansion, this is the role.

What you'll get to do

  • Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
  • Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
  • Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
  • Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads - setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
  • Own POS observability end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
  • Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
  • Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
  • Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
  • Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have

  • A minimum of 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi-national or large VC-backed companies.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building software that runs on Point-of-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
  • Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
  • Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer-facing feature products.
  • Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
  • Experience building or maturing platform engineering functions, including establishing engineering processes, tooling strategies, and cross-squad governance structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to scale engineering teams and build the organisational layer beneath you — leaders who can grow into and around the role you are hiring into.
  • Experience at a company processing high volumes of financial transactions in a regulated environment. Fintech background is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with terminal management systems and device observability tooling is a strong advantage.
  • Backend engineering experience in Java or Spring Boot is a strong plus given the breadth of the platform and the integration surface it sits on.
  • Experience working directly with OEM vendors on hardware specification and integration is a bonus.
  • Exposure to C or C++ is a plus — one of our device variants uses C.
  • Experience at Series A or B stage startups alone is unlikely to reflect the scale and complexity required for this role.

Cultural Alignment

We assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Deep empathy for the people depending on the platform — whether that is a merchant in Lagos trying to accept a payment, or a POS engineer blocked by missing tooling. You solve problems quickly and intuitively. You close loops by fixing root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: You have mastered your domain at the fundamentals level. You make trade-offs explicit, reason from first principles, and consistently produce solutions that are better than typical.
  • Systemisation: You convert recurring decisions into repeatable mechanisms. You reduce cognitive load for others. You strengthen institutional memory and improve engineering quality at scale.
  • Urgency: You move with disciplined speed. You act without waiting for permission when you are within scope. You escalate early when risk exceeds your authority. You remove friction and close loops.
  • Ownership: You treat the platform as yours to solve regardless of job description boundaries. You take responsibility without being asked. You follow through on commitments without being reminded.
  • No Ego: You put the mission ahead of personal status. You credit others genuinely, welcome challenge, and never protect your position at the expense of collective outcomes.
  • Candour: You surface reality early, clearly, and completely — especially when it is uncomfortable. You name risks before they become crises. Intelligent failure is acceptable; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Truthfulness and ethical consistency in everything. You adhere to rules and obligations. You never perform under intimidation or corrosive behaviour. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

Some of the technologies you'll work with

  • Android (Kotlin, Java) - primary platform for all POS application development
  • EMV payment standards and PCI/P2PE certification frameworks
  • Multiple POS device types and OEM manufacturers, including Topwise and Telpo
  • Terminal management systems and device observability tooling
  • Java, Spring Boot — backend services and integration layer
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You will receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • Stage 1: A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • Stage 2: Technical Round focused on core technical strengths and depth in Android/Kotlin
  • Stage 3: System Design - You will be asked to solve complex system design problems to assess your technical and architectural skills, with a particular focus on POS and mobile platform architecture and payment systems.
  • Stage 4: Technical and Architectural Leadership - An interview with one Head of Engineering focused on leadership skills and attributes.
  • Stage 5: CTO Interview - A conversation with our CTO assessing first-principles thinking, problem-solving under ambiguity, clarity of thought, and cultural alignment.

How to apply: Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates!

jobs.title: Content Transformation Editor
jobs.excerpt: About Packt Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals.
jobs.description:
About Packt

Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e-books, audiobooks, and video courses. For more details, visit .

Role Overview

As a Content Transformation Editor, you will help turn validated source material - primarily video courses, transcripts, speaker decks and expert assets - into clear, structured, reader-ready products that read naturally, teach clearly and meet Packt standards. You will use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate transformation, but you will be responsible for checking, refining and improving the output so it is accurate to the source, up to date, readable, coherent and valuable for tech professionals.

Success in this role means delivering reliable, well-structured V2B (Video-to-Book) and derived-content outputs on time, identifying issues early and applying feedback quickly.

What You Will Do

V2B and Derived Content Transformation

  • Review source assets such as course videos, transcripts, speaker decks and code repositories.
  • Help shape structure, flow and learning paths based on the source course.
  • Use Packt’s AI tools to convert courses into clear written manuscripts, checking for content quality, flow and repetition while preserving useful expert insight, practical examples and teaching intent.
  • Ensure chapters contain appropriate introductions, transitions, summaries, captions, instructions, examples and reader guidance.
  • Review AI-assembled on-demand video courses for editorial quality, flow and completeness, checking AI-flagged moments and approving the final output for publication.
  • Review and approve ingested expert material to ensure it is converted into clear, attributable and retrievable insight units that improve the quality of AI-generated answers in our corpus product.

Editorial Quality and Reader Value

  • Check and improve grammar, clarity, readability, consistency and flow.
  • Make sure the output reads like a book, not a transcript.
  • Check that explanations follow a logical progression and support the intended learning outcome.
  • Identify areas where source material depends too heavily on visual demonstration or assumed context, and flag where extra explanation is needed.

AI and Workflow Tools

  • Review AI-generated output critically and correct errors, hallucinations, omissions, unsupported claims and tone problems.
  • Provide feedback on AI tools and documentation that can be used to improve processes and output. Document source issues or process bottlenecks so the wider workflow can improve.
  • Escalate missing assets, unclear source material, technical uncertainty, quality concerns, schedule risks or repeated workflow issues early.

Who You Are

  • An early-career editor, graduate or content specialist with excellent English and strong learning agility.
  • Curious about technology and motivated to understand how technical learners think, work and solve problems.
  • Comfortable using AI tools, while being quality-focused in reviewing their output.
  • Detail-oriented, organised and able to manage repeatable tasks without losing sight of reader value

Must-have skills:

  • Excellent written English, with strong grammar, clarity and editing judgement.
  • Good communication skills and ability to share clear feedback to all stakeholders, internal and external.
  • Ability to test code and flag issues.
  • Ability to organise information into logical structures and reader-friendly explanations.
  • Confidence working with long documents, transcripts or source files and maintaining consistency across them.
  • Willingness to learn new technical concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow workflow, style and quality checklists.
  • Ability to work to deadlines, communicate blockers early and respond to feedback.

Good-to-have skills:

  • Degree, internship or early professional experience in publishing, editing, technical writing, instructional design, journalism, education, communications or a related field.
  • Exposure to technical topics such as AI, software development, cloud, data and cybersecurity.
  • Experience editing transcripts, video course material, tutorials, learning content, documentation or structured educational content.
  • Experience using AI tools for drafting, summarisation, editing, research or workflow automation.

Why Work at Packt

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:

  • Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
  • Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
  • Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge-sharing.
  • Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.

We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by: 

  • Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives. 
  • Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility. 
  • Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer-to-peer recognition. 
  • Fostering a culture of self-development. 
  • Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged. 

Benefits: 
You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.

  • Bonus scheme 
  • 5 day working week
  • 25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)
  • Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India
  • Training programs and Certification

Salary Range - INR 25K - 45K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)

Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.
