jobs.title: Vice President Solution Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads.
jobs.description:
Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads. We’re a small but rapidly growing company, which means there’s lots of room for growth and learning opportunities abound!

Apiphani is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all as a fundamental component of our business. Diversity and inclusion are the bedrock of creativity and innovation. Without diversity of experience and thought, we would fail to progress as a company and as a team. Apiphani strives to foster an environment of belonging, where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered. We embrace the unique experiences, perspective, and cultural background, which only you can bring to the table.

VP, Solution Engineering - Job Description

Apiphani is a leading SAP AI and services company helping enterprises modernize, operate, and optimize their SAP environments. Through luumenAI, we lead with AI-enabled capabilities that create measurable business outcomes and expand into long-term SAP Application Management Services (AMS), SAP BTP, cloud, data, and transformation engagements.

We are seeking an exceptional Vice President of Solution Engineering to build and lead the technical pre-sales organization that helps Apiphani win complex, strategic, annuity-based client relationships. This leader will combine deep SAP technical credibility, executive-level communication, commercial acumen, and a relentless growth mindset.

The VP of Solution Engineering will lead Solution Architects who partner with sales, marketing, alliances, and delivery to shape client strategy, develop differentiated solutions, quantify value, and accelerate deal cycles. This role is central to positioning luumenAI as the entry point for durable SAP AMS and BTP relationships.

Role Overview

The VP of Solution Engineering owns Apiphani’s technical solutioning capability across the revenue lifecycle—from early discovery and executive value conversations through solution architecture, proposal development, client presentations, technical validation, and transition to delivery.

This leader will establish the operating model, talent bench, methodologies, tools, and content required to consistently win sophisticated SAP services opportunities. They will be expected to personally engage in high-value pursuits while building a scalable team that improves win rates, deal quality, sales velocity, and long-term contract value.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue and deal leadership

  • Partner with the CRO, Sales Leaders, Account Executives, and Sales Reps to pursue complex SAP AMS, BTP, cloud, AI, data, and transformation opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior technical and commercial leader on priority pursuits, particularly multi-year managed services and strategic platform engagements.
  • Lead discovery sessions that uncover business priorities, SAP estate complexity, operating-model gaps, risk factors, technical requirements, and expansion opportunities.
  • Translate client requirements into compelling, differentiated solution strategies that position luumenAI as a practical, high-value path to SAP modernization and operational excellence.
  • Help shape multi-year annuity proposals, including scope, service model, architecture, delivery approach, commercial assumptions, risk management, governance, implementation roadmap, and expansion strategy.
  • Improve technical win rates, deal velocity, average contract value, recurring revenue mix, and pipeline conversion across strategic opportunities.
  • Bring urgency to opportunities: identify blockers early, mobilize internal resources quickly, and drive high-quality client-facing outputs on demanding timelines.

Solution engineering leadership

  • Recruit, coach, and manage a high-performing team of Solution Architects and technical pre-sales professionals.
  • Create clear role definitions, coverage models, capacity planning, performance expectations, career paths, and professional-development plans for the Solution Engineering function.
  • Establish repeatable solutioning methodologies for discovery, qualification, value engineering, architecture design, proposal creation, executive presentations, demonstrations, and handoffs to delivery.
  • Ensure solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, deliverable, scalable, and aligned with Apiphani’s strategic offerings.
  • Develop standard solution frameworks, reusable architectures, statements of work, service catalogs, assessment approaches, implementation roadmaps, and technical proof points.

SAP, AI, AMS, and BTP expertise

  • Maintain strong executive-level fluency across SAP application managed services, SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, SAP cloud strategy, integration, data, analytics, automation, security, and AI-enabled operations.
  • Lead the technical market narrative for luumenAI, connecting its capabilities to tangible client outcomes such as improved support experience, lower operating cost, reduced risk, faster issue resolution, enhanced adoption, and a more scalable SAP operating model.
  • Position Apiphani’s solutions as long-term, outcome-oriented partnerships rather than project-based staffing or commodity support.
  • Collaborate closely with delivery and practice leaders to ensure market-facing solution designs reflect current capabilities, implementation realities, delivery capacity, and innovation priorities.
  • Identify market, client, and ecosystem trends that can inform new offerings and repeatable packaged solutions.

Executive communication and marketing partnership

  • Deliver compelling presentations to CIOs, CFOs, COOs, SAP leaders, technology executives, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Communicate complex SAP and AI concepts in clear business language tailored to both executive and technical audiences.
  • Partner with Marketing to create technically credible, commercially relevant content, including thought-leadership articles, white papers, solution briefs, customer stories, webinars, presentations, battlecards, and campaign assets.
  • Act as a credible external voice for Apiphani through client events, industry forums, partner engagements, webinars, and executive workshops.
  • Support the development of differentiated messaging that connects luumenAI to SAP AMS and BTP demand-generation campaigns.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise technology services, managed services, solution architecture, pre-sales, or related leadership roles.
  • 5+ years leading solution engineering, pre-sales, architecture, consulting, or technical sales teams in an enterprise technology or professional-services environment.
  • Deep experience designing and selling complex SAP services solutions, ideally including SAP AMS, SAP BTP, S/4HANA, cloud transformation, integration, data, analytics, automation, and AI-related services.
  • Demonstrated success supporting or leading large, multi-stakeholder, multi-year enterprise deals with meaningful recurring-revenue components.
  • Strong understanding of managed-services commercial models, including service scope, SLAs, governance, transition, pricing inputs, risk assumptions, and margin considerations.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence executive buyers and articulate technical concepts in business-outcome terms.
  • Proven ability to produce or materially contribute to technical thought leadership, sales collateral, proposals, solution briefs, and executive-facing content.
  • Experience working with SAP ecosystem partners, hyperscalers, and enterprise technology alliances is strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field preferred; advanced degree, SAP certifications, and cloud certifications are a plus.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

  • Technical and commercial: Able to earn credibility with SAP architects and delivery leaders while also helping executives understand business value, risk reduction, and return on investment.
  • Aggressive and accountable: Comfortable operating in a high-growth environment, pursuing ambitious targets, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Urgent and decisive: Moves quickly, prioritizes effectively, and drives momentum through long sales cycles and complex internal decision-making.
  • Growth-minded: Sees every client interaction as an opportunity to expand strategic value, deepen relationships, and create long-term annuity revenue.
  • Client-centric: Listens carefully, diagnoses the real business problem, and designs solutions that clients can confidently buy and Apiphani can successfully deliver.
  • Collaborative: Brings Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Finance, Partners, and Executive Leadership together around a shared pursuit strategy.
  • Builder-oriented: Enjoys creating the people, process, content, tools, and operating cadence needed to scale a high-performing Solution Engineering organization.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Increase in qualified pipeline conversion and technical win rate.
  • Growth in average contract value, multi-year contract duration, and recurring/annuity revenue.
  • Expansion of luumenAI-led opportunities that convert into SAP AMS and SAP BTP engagements.
  • Sales-cycle acceleration and reduced time to deliver high-quality solution proposals.
  • Improvement in proposal quality, solution consistency, and delivery-readiness of sold work.
  • Development, retention, and productivity of the Solution Architecture team.
  • Creation and adoption of reusable solution assets, technical content, and differentiated go-to-market messaging.
  • Executive and field-sales confidence in the Solution Engineering organization as a strategic growth partner.

Reporting Relationship

This role reports to the Chief Revenue Officer and works closely with the CEO, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Delivery and Practice Leaders, Finance, and strategic alliance partners.

Why Apiphani

This is an opportunity to build a category-defining technical sales organization inside a high-growth SAP AI led services company. The VP of Solution Engineering will play a direct role in shaping how Apiphani takes luumenAI, SAP AMS, and SAP BTP solutions to market—and in building the durable, high-value client relationships that fuel the company’s next stage of growth.

Base Salary
$200,000—$235,000 USD

Company Benefits*

  • Medical/dental/vision - 100% paid for employees, 50% paid for dependents
  • Life and disability - 100% paid for employees
  • 401K - 3% contribution, no employee contribution necessary
  • Education and tuition reimbursement
  • Accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity benefits offered through our providers
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Legal assistance
  • Paid Time Off - up to 6 weeks per year
  • Sick Leave - up to 2 weeks per year
  • Parental Leave - up to 12 weeks

*Benefits listed in the job description apply to employees working in the United States. For international employees, Apiphani partners with an Employer of Record, Deel, and provides all statutory benefits required under local law; certain U.S.-specific programs (such as EAP, legal assistance, etc.) may not be available outside the United States. The specific benefits package will be outlined in the local employment agreement issued through Deel.

This is the CEO's right hand: owning his calendar and inbox, building a reliable system for tracking commitments and deadlines across the entire leadership team, and taking recurring administrative work off the business entirely. This isn't a "book travel and schedule meetings" role — it's about removing the CEO as a bottleneck in decision-making so he and his leadership team can stay focused on strategy and execution.

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Where you'll leave your mark?

    • Own the onboarding journey end-to-end — from contract signature to go-live and the first audit milestone, as the single point of accountability for your customer's success in this phase.
    • Run a structured implementation project for every customer — kickoff, milestone tracking, risk flags, and go-live. You hold the timeline, drive the cadence, and close the gaps.
    • Manage senior stakeholder relationships — your primary contacts are founders, CTOs, and security leads; run executive check-ins, communicate progress and blockers clearly, and build trust that turns customers into advocates.
    • Drive product adoption and setup completion — guide customers through integration setup, control activation, and compliance framework alignment; you don't need to be a security engineer, but you know what good looks like.
    • Own internal escalations — when a customer is stuck, you are the bridge between them and Product, Support, and Compliance, and you follow through until it's resolved.
    • Track and act on customer health signals — setup completion %, time-to-value, CSAT, and days since last contact — surfacing risks proactively, not after a customer goes quiet.
    • Improve the playbooks you use — document what works, flag what doesn't, and make onboarding better for every customer who comes after yours

The kind of builder we're looking for -

    • 2–4 years of experience, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing implementation, onboarding, or technical account management role at a SaaS company — someone who has run onboarding projects, not just supported them.
    • Experience managing VP-level and above relationships, with comfort working towards C-suite engagement.
    • A project runner at heart — you build the plan, set milestones, chase progress, and keep 10–20 concurrent onboardings moving without dropping the ball.
    • A clear communicator — you explain complex concepts simply, write crisp async updates, and hold a confident conversation with a technical founder.
    • A fast learner in new domains — you don't need to be a compliance expert on day one, but you can get there in 60 days.
    • A solid technical baseline — comfortable with cloud tools, SaaS integrations, and basic API behaviour; familiar with tools like Jira, Slack, HubSpot, and genuinely curious about AI productivity tools.
    • Nice to have: exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA), certifications like CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, and experience at a startup where the playbook was still being written.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Product Manager owns product planning and execution across the full product lifecycle — gathering and prioritizing customer and market requirements, defining the product vision, establishing product strategy, and working closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to build and launch successful products and capabilities.
jobs.description:
The Product Manager owns product planning and execution across the full product lifecycle — gathering and prioritizing customer and market requirements, defining the product vision, establishing product strategy, and working closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to build and launch successful products and capabilities.

Modern product management moves faster than it used to. We expect our PMs to work fluently with AI tools and with our design system, using both to compress the distance between an idea and something a customer can actually react to. In practice that means synthesizing research in hours rather than weeks, producing clickable prototypes instead of static wireframes, and pressure-testing hypotheses with working artifacts before committing engineering capacity. The bar is not “uses AI” — it is judgment about where AI accelerates the work and where human verification is non-negotiable.

The Product Manager brings the team a deep knowledge of users, the market, how existing products are actually used, and which outcomes matter most. The PM establishes and tests product hypotheses and ensures investments support the company’s overall strategy and goals. Together, Product Management, Design, and Engineering discover, plan, and build effective solutions that deliver on the product vision.

The Product Manager is the evangelist for their product area — providing transparency into the product development process, building alignment across company stakeholders, and effectively sharing the product vision and strategy.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

  • Develop, validate, and communicate the product vision and strategy for your assigned areas.
  • Own and maintain product roadmaps, communicating status, sequencing, and trade-offs to internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with Product Leadership to prioritize your area within the overall portfolio, and identify and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Participate in product pricing and packaging decisions.

Discovery & Research

  • Conduct user and market research to build a deep understanding of user and buyer personas, critical customer segments, and the competitive landscape.
  • Use AI-assisted research and synthesis — interview transcription and thematic analysis, support-ticket and usage-data mining, competitive teardowns — to shorten time-to-insight, while validating conclusions with real customers rather than trusting model output.
  • Frame explicit hypotheses, define what evidence would disprove them, and run lightweight experiments before large investments.
  • Work directly with product and usage data — query it, chart it, and size opportunities without waiting on an analyst.

Design, Prototyping & Definition

  • Partner with Design on exploratory, interaction, and fit-and-finish work.
  • Build your own low- and mid-fidelity mockups and clickable prototypes using our design system and AI-assisted prototyping tools — enough fidelity to test a concept with customers and align stakeholders, with craft-level design owned by Design.
  • Treat the design system as a shared language: compose from documented components and tokens, reuse established patterns, and surface gaps rather than inventing one-off solutions.
  • Translate user needs into crisp problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Use AI to draft and stress-test these artifacts — and own their final quality and accuracy.

Delivery

  • Participate with Engineering in the agile sprint process, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Lead prioritization and backlog management for your area, serving as the primary point of contact for technical teams.
  • Favor small, frequent releases over big-bang launches — use feature flags, staged rollouts, and internal dogfooding to learn quickly and de-risk delivery.
  • Establish product goals, and set and track the metrics that show whether they were met.

Launch & Adoption

  • Lead the product launch process for new products and capabilities in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success.
  • Equip product launch teams with the positioning, demos, and enablement material they need — and stay accountable for adoption after launch, not just the ship date.
  • Close the loop: monitor post-launch metrics and customer feedback, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years of experience in agile product management.
  • Deep understanding of product management methodologies across discovery, prioritization, and delivery.
  • Demonstrated fluency using AI tools in day-to-day product work — research synthesis, drafting and stress-testing specs, prototyping, data analysis — with sound judgment about where AI output requires human verification.
  • Hands-on ability to produce mockups and interactive prototypes using a design system and modern prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, component libraries, AI prototyping tools). You do not need to be a designer; you do need to be able to show, not just tell.
  • Comfort working with data — able to write or generate queries, read dashboards, and quantify an opportunity independently.
  • Experience conducting user and market research and synthesizing needs and opportunities.
  • Superior communication skills to evangelize your product area and articulate user and business needs.
  • Ability to identify and work with Design and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems.
  • Self-motivated, with strong task and time management skills.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience shipping AI- or ML-powered product capabilities, including the harder parts: evaluation, accuracy thresholds, human-in-the-loop design, and earning user trust.
  • Background in B2B or enterprise SaaS, particularly in logistics, supply chain, or financial operations.
  • Familiarity with feature flagging, A/B testing, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Experience partnering with data or platform teams on API- and integration-heavy products.

Manager, Account Management – US 2026

Position Summary

The Manager, Account Management serves as a primary day-to-day contact for a portfolio of client accounts, supporting client retention, service excellence, and account growth opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Account Managers, Sales, HR, Payroll, Compliance, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure exceptional client experiences and successful delivery of GoGlobal's services across multiple countries.

The ideal candidate is client-focused, commercially aware, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities while building strong relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship & Account Support

  • Support the management of an assigned portfolio of client accounts.
  • Develop strong working relationships with client contacts and stakeholders.
  • Assist in maintaining high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and account stability.
  • Support account reviews and client meetings to identify potential growth opportunities.
  • Help coordinate Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and prepare relevant account insights and reporting.
  • Provide guidance to clients regarding GoGlobal services, onboarding processes, and operational procedures.
  • Escalate complex commercial, compliance, or operational issues to senior stakeholders when required.

Account Management & Service Delivery

  • Coordinate onboarding activities and support smooth implementation of services across HR, Payroll, Finance, Corporate Governance, and Employer of Record solutions.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client communications, responding to inquiries and coordinating issue resolution.
  • Maintain an understanding of each client's business structure, services in scope, countries covered, and operational requirements.
  • Ensure clients have clear visibility of service timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities.
  • Monitor service delivery performance and follow up on outstanding actions with internal teams.
  • Assist with contract renewals, pricing discussions, and scope amendments under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Support invoice reviews to ensure billing accuracy and identify potential out-of-scope service charges.
  • Flag potential scope creep, commercial risks, or delivery challenges to management.

Commercial & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management teams to support renewal and growth initiatives.
  • Assist in gathering information and preparing proposals for client expansion opportunities.
  • Participate in prospect and client meetings to understand business needs and scope requirements.
  • Support cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Entity Solutions, HR Solutions, and Employer of Record services.
  • Contribute to basic pricing reviews and commercial documentation as required.
  • Represent GoGlobal professionally during client-facing interactions and events.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Maintain accurate client records within CRM and internal systems.
  • Ensure client information, onboarding status, renewal dates, and account activities are properly documented.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), and related documentation.
  • Track key account metrics and client health indicators, highlighting potential risks or concerns.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
  • Support resolution of client issues while maintaining service quality standards.
  • Adhere to internal policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
  • Escalate regulatory, compliance, or service risks appropriately.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Development

  • Work closely with Sales, Operations, Legal, Compliance, HR, Payroll, and Finance teams to support client success.
  • Participate in training programs and professional development activities.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance client experience and operational efficiency.
  • Support internal projects and initiatives related to service delivery improvements.
  • Coordinate with regional and global teams to ensure consistent service delivery across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment regarding issue escalation and stakeholder involvement.

Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, International Business, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in Account Management, Client Services, Customer Success, Payroll, HR Services, Professional Services, or Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).
  • Experience managing client relationships in a professional services environment.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting international clients or global service delivery models.
  • Knowledge of HR, Payroll, Corporate Governance, Global Mobility, Employer of Record (EOR), or Entity Management services.
  • Exposure to contract administration, renewals, or commercial account management.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Benefits

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for a revenue marketing leader who has actually built pipeline through a channel or partner motion, not just direct or PLG, who has personally owned a pipeline or revenue number rather than just reported on one, and who brings a PE-grade read on CAC and efficiency to how the engine is run. This person is as comfortable in front of the executive leadership team, translating marketing activity into financial and business impact, as they are inside the martech stack that produces it.

Required Qualifications

This isn't optional, and it isn't just familiarity with the tools.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager (Contractor)
jobs.excerpt: Do you believe that where someone starts in life shouldn't determine how far they can go?
jobs.description:
Do you believe that where someone starts in life shouldn't determine how far they can go? Do you believe AI can be a force for good, and that the social sector has a real opportunity to shift who holds power over it, so these tools can effectively serve people on the margins? Do you think the people whose jobs AI is already reshaping deserve a real say in how it's governed? Are you a systems thinker who would rather change the conditions than patch the symptoms? Are you energized by bringing a cross-sector community together to make that real? If this is checking off boxes for you, please keep reading.

About CareerVillage:

CareerVillage is a global tech nonprofit with a mission to democratize access to career information and advice for underrepresented youth. We do this through Coach, our AI-powered career coaching platform, and through our open-access Q&A platform where anyone can ask any question about any career. Our work has reached more than 11 million learners since 2011. We also founded and convened the AI for Career Development Coalition (AICD), a growing cross-sector coalition of practitioners, institutions, employers, funders, and technology builders working toward responsible AI in career navigation.

About the role:

CareerVillage is looking for a Strategic Partnerships Manager to help build, grow, and sustain AICD, the coalition setting the standard for responsible AI in career navigation. AI could transform how people find and navigate work, opening economic mobility to people who have never had access to good career guidance. It could also do the opposite, hardening the gaps that already exist and leaving the biggest decisions in the hands of a powerful few. What the field is missing is a shared sense of what good looks like, and a way to govern these tools that includes the practitioners closest to learners and the people meant to benefit from them.

Luckily, that work has already begun. >200 diverse institutions have joined AICD, dedicated to setting shared standards and coordinating the field. Growing it well now means becoming more sophisticated in how we operate: stronger systems, deeper partnerships, and a dedicated owner for the coalition's day-to-day.

You'll be the person who keeps AICD organized and its members engaged while building the relationships that help the coalition grow. This is an independent contributor role with real leadership opportunities and a strategic-partnerships mandate. The AICD lead remains the coalition's lead and public face; you build their capacity, make the coalition run, and help it grow. You'll report to the Director of Development, who is the lead AICD facilitator, and work in a highly cross-functional capacity, collaborating regularly with our marketing and partnerships teams.

This is a full-time contractor role (~40 hours/week) with a strong possibility of conversion to a full-time employee position within the first 6-12 months and path to a more senior position in the organization, depending on organizational capacity and fit.

What you'll do:

  • Handle AICD's day-to-day operations and administration: manage member onboarding , own calendaring and convening coordination, and serve as the first line of response for member questions
  • Build and maintain the systems that keep members connected and collaborative over time, such as a shared knowledge hub, and vet other tools worth adopting
  • Nurture the community by planning and executing events, developing member resources, engaging our online member community and the other spaces where members show up
  • Interface with members directly to stay close to what they actually need, and be an extra ear to the ground
  • Project-manage AICD's grant-funded deliverables and help execute against committed timelines, coordinate members and research partners to keep the coalition's benchmarking work on track, and help push in-progress field resources and artifacts to completion
  • Support the AICD lead: build slide decks, take notes, act as a thought partner, handle convening and meeting logistics so they can focus on facilitation, and draft member communications for them to send
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with prospective strategic members, and support our broader field-building strategy
  • Collaborate with our marketing team on member communications, including a newsletter and website, and stay current on developments in the ecosystem relevant to AICD's work

Who we're looking for:

Required:

  • 3+ years of experience in partnerships and/or community building, ideally in workforce or career development
  • Experience operating in small or scrappy organizations. You know how to make things happen without specialized teams around you, and you're energized by building processes as the work grows rather than operating within ones already established
  • A systems thinker, comfortable moving between granular admin and higher-altitude strategy, and okay with the admin work even when it's the less exciting part of the week
  • A track record of running complex, multi-stakeholder coordination to completion, and of managing relationships with senior or powerful stakeholders while holding clear boundaries
  • A temperament for substance over hype. You believe in being additive, not noisy, and you listen closely before making assumptions
  • Open to learning on the job and forming your point of view through the work, rather than arriving with fixed answers about what the field needs
  • Interested in our mission and excited to help democratize career access for the learners who need it most

Preferred:

  • Edtech and/or AI experience
  • Experience building, growing, or sustaining a community, coalition, or membership program
  • Project management experience coordinating cross-organizational initiatives
  • Familiarity with cross-sector or coalition environments where members span practitioners, institutions, employers, funders, and technology builders
  • Interest in learning and using new tools and technologies to keep a community organized and connected

Compensation: $62–$75 per hour, with full-time employee conversion as a possibility, dependent on organizational capacity and demonstrated fit.

Location: CareerVillage has team members around the world, with an HQ in Palo Alto, CA. We are flexible on location within the United States, but must be able to work 9A-5P in Eastern (ET), Central (CT), or Pacific (PT) time zones

Job Type: Full-time contractor (~40 hours/week)

Work authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. CareerVillage is not sponsoring visas or work authorization at this time.

To apply: Please apply through our Greenhouse job posting. Applications require a resume, LinkedIn profile URL, cover letter, and responses to two short prompts (see below). Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. If you have any questions, please email us at with "Strategic Partnerships Manager" in the subject line.

A note on AI: While we welcome AI as a tool, nothing beats a response that is personal and authentic.

CareerVillage is an Equal Opportunity Employer

CareerVillage is an equal opportunity organization that celebrates diversity (for more information about our approach, check out our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Guidelines). Diversity includes race, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, size, religion, sexual orientation, parental status, socioeconomic background, and many other parts of an individual’s identity. We are a fair choice employer: qualified applicants with a history of arrest or conviction are welcome to apply and will be considered for this role. Each team member’s perspective is integral to our success, and fostering an inclusive environment is everyone’s responsibility. At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Who We Are

Chomps is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you’ve been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

*Accepting applications from 9/8 - 9/15/2026 5pm CST

What You Will Do

This role will lead the day-to-day evolution of Chomps' social presence, translating brand strategy into platform-native content, meaningful community engagement and social experiences that build awareness, affinity and advocacy.

Working closely with the Director of Social & Influencer, you'll identify emerging opportunities, exercise strong editorial judgment, test new ideas and translate performance insights into smarter strategies over time.

    • Help shape and execute paid amplification strategies for organic social content, identifying opportunities to boost or spark high-performing content to extend reach, engagement and momentum.

    • Develop and lead Chomps' community strategy, fostering meaningful engagement, cultivating brand advocacy and strengthening relationships with our audience.

    • Turn community insights and conversations into content ideas, storytelling opportunities and broader marketing recommendations.

  • Performance & Innovation
    • Own social performance, using analytics, testing and social listening to translate results into actionable recommendations that improve engagement, efficiency and business impact.

    • Foster a culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement, encouraging the team to bring forward ideas, recommendations, and data-backed perspectives rather than simply reporting on performance or executing requests
    • Partner cross-functionally with IMC, Brand, Creative, PR, Influencer, Ecommerce and Analytics to ensure social is fully integrated into broader marketing initiatives.

Who You Are

  • 5-7+ years of progressive experience in social media strategy, content, community management, or related social disciplines, preferably within CPG, food, lifestyle, or consumer brands
  • Proven experience developing and executing social strategies that drive engagement, brand relevance, and broader marketing objectives

Position: Manager, Social Strategy & Community

jobs.title: Field Merchandiser Lead
jobs.excerpt: Job Family Group: Retail GroupJob Description: The Lead Field Merchandiser serves as the on-site leader of the Field Merchandising team and is responsible for the safe, accurate, efficient, and timely execution of store resets, reflows, cooler resets and refreshes, merchandising projects, and store organization initiatives across TA locations.
jobs.description:
Job Family Group:

Retail Group

Job Description:

The Lead Field Merchandiser serves as the on-site leader of the Field Merchandising team and is responsible for the safe, accurate, efficient, and timely execution of store resets, reflows, cooler resets and refreshes, merchandising projects, and store organization initiatives across TA locations.

This position leads the Field Merchandising team while working alongside team members to physically complete the project. The Lead Field Merchandiser is responsible for understanding the approved store layout and project scope, organizing the work, assigning responsibilities, monitoring progress, resolving field execution issues, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring the location is completed according to approved plans, planograms, merchandising standards, and BP/TA safety requirements.

The Lead Field Merchandiser also serves as the primary on-site point of contact between the Field Merchandising team, store management, and Field Merchandising leadership throughout the project.

This is a highly physical, hands-on leadership role requiring frequent travel, strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to lead a team in a fast-moving retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

On-Site Team Leadership

  • Serve as the day-to-day leader of the Field Merchandising team while on location.

  • Review the project scope, store layout, planograms, timelines, and priorities before work begins.

  • Establish a clear work plan for each day and communicate expectations to the team.

  • Assign team members to specific sections, departments, coolers, fixtures, or other project responsibilities based on project needs.

  • Coordinate the sequence of work to improve productivity while minimizing disruption to store operations and customers.

  • Monitor team progress throughout the day and adjust assignments when necessary to keep the project on schedule.

  • Work alongside the team and actively participate in resets, fixture work, merchandising, cooler resets, product movement, and other physical activities.

  • Set the standard for work ethic, professionalism, urgency, teamwork, safety, and quality.

  • Coach Field Merchandisers on proper execution techniques, merchandising standards, Planogram accuracy, and safe work practices.

  • Identify performance or execution concerns and communicate them appropriately to Field Merchandising leadership.

Safety Leadership

  • Lead the team's compliance with all BP and TA safety policies, procedures, and protocols.

  • Conduct appropriate safety discussions before work begins and when project conditions change.

  • Ensure team members use required personal protective equipment (PPE) and approved tools and equipment.

  • Ensure proper lifting, material-handling, ladder, cooler, equipment, and fixture-installation procedures are followed.

  • Maintain safe and organized work areas throughout the project.

  • Ensure merchandise, fixtures, equipment, tools, packaging, and other materials do not create hazards for customers or store employees.

  • Immediately address unsafe behavior or conditions and call out safety concerns when necessary.

  • Report injuries, incidents, damaged equipment, and other safety concerns according to established procedures.

  • Ensure the store is left safe, clean, and customer-ready at the end of each workday.

Project Planning & Execution

  • Review and understand the complete project package before beginning work, including store layouts, floor plans, planograms, fixture requirements, merchandising instructions, signage requirements, and project timelines.

  • Walk the location before beginning significant work to identify potential execution issues.

  • Verify that required fixtures, supplies, merchandising materials, signage, and other project components are available.

  • Develop an efficient sequence for completing the reset or reflow.

  • Coordinate fixture movement, product staging, Planogram execution, cooler work, backroom organization, and other activities to prevent unnecessary rework.

  • Track progress against the established project schedule.

  • Identify barriers that could affect project completion and communicate them quickly to the appropriate leadership.

  • Make appropriate field-level decisions within established guidelines while calling out changes that require approval.

  • Ensure approved project scope is completed before the team leaves the location.

Store Resets & Fixture Installation

  • Lead and participate in complete and partial store resets, reflows, remodel support, and merchandising refreshes.

  • Direct the tear-down, movement, assembly, rebuilding, leveling, and positioning of retail fixtures and shelving according to approved layouts.

  • Ensure shelves, peg hooks, displays, racks, endcaps, merchandising accessories, and other fixtures are properly installed.

  • Coordinate the safe movement and staging of merchandise and fixtures throughout the store.

  • Verify that fixtures are positioned correctly before merchandising work begins.

  • Identify damaged, missing, or incorrect fixtures and components and determine the appropriate next steps with project leadership.

Planogram & Layout Execution

  • Ensure the team accurately follows approved store layouts, floor plans, planograms, cooler layouts, and merchandising instructions.

  • Verify correct fixture placement, shelf heights, product placement, facings, spacing, sequencing, and presentation.

  • Conduct ongoing quality checks rather than waiting until the end of the project to identify errors.

  • Correct execution issues before sections are considered complete.

  • Identify conditions where the approved plan cannot be properly implemented and call out those issues rather than making unauthorized changes.

  • Provide feedback to Field Merchandising leadership regarding layouts or planograms that create execution challenges in the field.

Cooler Resets & Refreshes

  • Lead and participate in cooler resets, reflows, and merchandising refreshes.

  • Coordinate product removal, staging, organization, and replacement to minimize product exposure and disruption.

  • Ensure cooler shelves, product placement, facings, tags, signage, and merchandising standards match approved plans.

  • Organize work to minimize the amount of time refrigerated merchandise remains outside appropriate temperature-controlled environments.

  • Identify cooler fixture, shelving, signage, or merchandising issues and communicate them to the appropriate project or store leadership.

  • Ensure completed coolers are organized, shopable, properly merchandised, and operationally practical for store teams.

Backroom, Storage & Cooler Organization

  • Lead efforts to improve backroom, storage area, cooler, and merchandising supply organization as part of reset and reflow projects.

  • Establish clear organization expectations for the Field Merchandising team.

  • Help identifying excess, discontinued, obsolete, damaged, misplaced, or non-Planogrammed inventory and ensure established disposition procedures are followed.

  • Organize fixtures, shelving, signage, merchandising supplies, and other materials to improve store-level execution.

  • Focus on creating organization systems that are practical and sustainable for the store team after the project is completed.

  • Ensure backroom, storage, and cooler areas are left clean, organized, safe, and operationally functional.

Deli & Sales Desk Reflow Support

  • Lead and participate in the reflow, reorganization, and remerchandising of deli and sales desk areas according to approved project plans.

  • Coordinate the movement and repositioning of merchandise, displays, shelving, racks, and approved fixtures.

  • Help ensure revised layouts improve product visibility, customer flow, impulse merchandising, shopability, and operational efficiency.

  • Coordinate work with store management and other functional partners to minimize disruption to deli, sales desk, and customer operations.

  • Ensure appropriate signage, shelf tags, promotional materials, and merchandising communication are properly installed.

Product Merchandising & Inventory

  • Direct and participate in the removal, staging, organization, and replacement of merchandise during resets.

  • Ensure merchandise is properly stocked, faced, organized, priced, and presented before sections are considered complete.

  • Ensure discontinued, damaged, excess, misplaced, or non-planogrammed inventory is identified and handled according to established procedures.

  • Verify shelf tags, price labels, promotional signage, displays, endcap materials, and other merchandising communication are correctly installed.

  • Ensure promotional and seasonal programs included within the project scope are executed according to established standards.

Store Management Communication

  • Serve as the primary Field Merchandising contact for store management during the project.

  • Meet with store leadership at the beginning of the project to review the work being completed and discuss potential operational impacts.

  • Maintain regular communication with store management regarding progress, issues, changes, and expected completion.

  • Coordinate work to minimize unnecessary disruption to customers and store operations.

  • Listen to store concerns while ensuring the team continues to implement the approved project scope.

  • Clearly communicate when requested changes fall outside the approved project and require additional authorization.

  • Review completed work with store leadership as appropriate before leaving the location.

Quality Control & Project Completion

The Lead Field Merchandiser is responsible for ensuring the team does not simply finish the work — the work must be completed correctly.

Before a project is considered complete, the Lead Field Merchandiser will:

  • Conduct a final walkthrough of the store and all areas included within the project.

  • Verify fixtures are positioned according to the approved layout.

  • Verify planograms and cooler sets have been accurately implemented.

  • Confirm merchandise is properly stocked, faced, priced, and presented.

  • Confirm required signage and promotional materials are installed.

  • Confirm backrooms, storage areas, coolers, deli areas, sales desk areas, and other areas included in the project are organized appropriately.

  • Ensure unused materials, tools, packaging, fixtures, and debris are properly removed or stored.

  • Identify and document outstanding issues that could not be resolved before departure.

  • Ensure appropriate project completion documentation, photographs, or other required reporting is completed.

  • Leave the location safe, clean, organized, operational, and customer-ready.

Physical Requirements

This is a working leadership position. The Lead Field Merchandiser must be capable of performing the same physical work expected of Field Merchandisers, including:

  • Regularly lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling merchandise, fixtures, shelving, equipment, and supplies.

  • Lifting and moving heavy objects, including items weighing up to 50 pounds independently, and heavier items with appropriate assistance or equipment.

  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, reaching, climbing, and working at varying heights.

  • Safely using ladders and approved material-handling equipment.

  • Standing and walking for extended periods, including the majority of a work shift.

  • Performing repetitive lifting, stocking, fixture assembly, cooler resets, and merchandising activities.

  • Working for reasonable periods in refrigerated cooler environments.

  • Working safely in active retail environments involving customers, deliveries, contractors, vendors, and ongoing store operations.

Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law.

Travel & Scheduling Requirements

  • Frequent travel is required, potentially including weekly and overnight travel.

  • Must be able to travel by automobile and commercial airline as business needs require.

  • Must be able to work at TA locations across the United States.

  • Must maintain scheduling flexibility based on project and store requirements.

  • Work schedules may include early mornings, evenings, overnight work, and occasional weekends depending on project needs.

  • Help coordinate team travel, arrival times, transportation, and other field logistics as directed to improve efficiency and control project costs.

Qualifications

  • Previous retail merchandising, store operations, field merchandising, reset, fixture installation, warehouse, or related experience required.

  • Previous experience leading teams, projects, store resets, or field execution activities strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with planograms, store layouts, floor plans, and fixture plans.

  • Experience with cooler resets, inventory organization, or convenience/travel center merchandising preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to organize work, establish priorities, and keep a team focused on deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to execution standards.

  • Strong communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving field environment.

  • Ability to recognize when an issue can be resolved in the field and when it should be called out.

  • Ability and willingness to perform physically demanding work alongside the team.

  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet applicable company travel requirements.

Measures of Success

Success in the Lead Field Merchandiser role will be measured by:

  • Safety – Leads the team in consistently meeting BP/TA safety requirements.

  • Leadership – Provides clear direction, accountability, coaching, and support to the Field Merchandising team.

  • Accuracy – Store layouts, planograms, cooler sets, fixtures, pricing, and signage are implemented correctly.

  • Quality – Completed stores consistently meet established merchandising and presentation standards.

  • Productivity – Keeps the team organized and projects moving at the expected pace.

  • Timeliness – Projects are completed within established schedules.

  • Problem Solving – Identifies barriers early and resolves or escalates them quickly.

  • Organization – Stores, coolers, backrooms, storage areas, and merchandising supplies are left organized and operationally practical.

  • Communication – Maintains effective communication with store management, Field Merchandising leadership, and other project partners.

  • Team Development – Coaches team members and improves their ability to safely and independently execute future projects.

  • Cost Awareness – Uses labor, travel, fixtures, supplies, and other company resources responsibly.

  • Store Readiness – Leaves every location safe, clean, organized, properly merchandised, and ready to serve customers.

Role Expectations

The Lead Field Merchandiser is the owner of execution while the Field Merchandising team is in the store.

This is not a supervisory position where the leader simply directs others. The Lead Field Merchandiser is expected to work alongside the team, set the pace, solve problems, coach team members, communicate with store leadership, and personally verify the quality of the completed work.

The Lead Field Merchandiser should understand both what needs to be done and why it is being done, allowing the individual to make good field decisions while protecting the integrity of the approved merchandising strategy.

The objective is not simply to finish the project and move to the next location. The objective is to leave each store safer, easier to shop, easier to replenish, better organized, easier for the store team to operate, and fully aligned with the approved merchandising strategy.

jobs.description:
• Job Title: Materials Science Expert
  • Job Type: Contractor
  • Location: Remote

About the hiring company:

Our client is a rapidly growing, venture-backed AI company helping shape the next generation of intelligent systems. By combining world-class human expertise with advanced machine learning workflows, they enable leading AI organizations to build, evaluate, and improve cutting-edge models used across a wide range of industries.

The company works with highly accomplished professionals in fields such as software engineering, finance, healthcare, legal, operations, research, and other specialized domains. These experts contribute directly to the development of advanced AI systems by providing real-world knowledge, evaluations, feedback, and domain-specific judgment that help models reason more accurately and perform more effectively.

Leveraging a proprietary AI-driven talent assessment and matching platform, the organization identifies exceptional professionals globally and connects them with high-impact projects at the forefront of artificial intelligence.

Backed by more than $40 million in funding and supported by a rapidly expanding international network of experts, the company is building critical human intelligence infrastructure for the AI economy and creating meaningful opportunities for professionals to apply their expertise in entirely new ways.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency withPython.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

A very attractive and competitive package is offered.
