jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Preferred Experience

The role leads individual engagements. This SME role includes cradle‑to‑grave engagement ownership, ensuring operational safety, evidence integrity, and measurable defensive improvement outcomes.

This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.

Responsibilities:

Desired:

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Restoration Account Coordinator to serve as a key financial and administrative resource for the Restoration department of a national multifamily renovation and restoration contractor. You will support projects from setup through closeout, partnering with Project Managers, Operations, Accounting, subcontractors, and clients to keep project budgets, billing, change orders, receivables, and financial reporting accurate and moving efficiently.

This role requires strong knowledge of restoration insurance processes, Xactimate, Sage, project margins, and construction accounting. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable owning financial coordination across a high volume of active projects, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • Work inside a nationally recognized, award-winning renovation and restoration contractor
  • High-ownership role with direct impact on project cash flow and financial performance

What You'll Work On

Project Budget and Cost Management

  • Create and maintain project budgets and takeoffs in Sage using appropriate cost codes, cost types, and project margins
  • Accurately translate Xactimate estimates and Operations-provided budgets into the system
  • Monitor project costs, contract values, committed work, and available budget
  • Identify discrepancies and complete budget modifications when needed
  • Review project financial activity with Project Managers and Operations to ensure projects remain within budget and margin expectations

Subcontractor and Vendor Billing

  • Coordinate subcontractor and vendor billing and payments including invoices, lien waivers, ACH information, approvals, corrections, and required documentation
  • Monitor payment status and resolve billing issues that may delay payment
  • Communicate with subcontractors and Accounts Payable regarding outstanding items, accruals, or payment exceptions

Change Order Management

  • Process subcontractor change orders for accuracy, completeness, coding, and approval
  • Maintain current change order logs and supporting documentation
  • Prepare and enter prime contract change orders in Sage, verify pricing and margins, and route client documents for execution through DocuSign

Accounts Receivable and Collections

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for accounts receivable on assigned Restoration projects
  • Handle client follow-up, payment status, outstanding balances, and collection activity
  • Monitor project-specific and state-specific lien deadlines and communicate upcoming deadlines
  • Escalate high-risk receivables or payment issues to management promptly

WIP Reporting and Insurance Billing

  • Gather, review, and maintain project financial information required for WIP reporting including costs, contract values, change orders, billings, and margins
  • Work toward independently managing the Restoration WIP process over time
  • Review and support MRP billing including proper classification and processing of Type 1 and Type 2 jobs
  • Support client and lender communication related to supplements, owner change orders, insurance billing, and ACV/RCV processes

Financial Support and Administration

  • Serve as a finance resource for the Restoration department responding to questions on budgets, billing, change orders, project costs, and margins
  • Assist with MIT project bonus tracking and supporting documentation as assigned
  • Maintain organized project records and proactively identify and communicate financial or administrative issues that could impact project execution or cash flow

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in construction accounting, restoration, project administration, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of construction financial concepts including project budgets, cost codes, margins, change orders, subcontractor billing, accounts receivable, and WIP reporting
  • Experience with Sage and Xactimate strongly preferred
  • Knowledge of restoration insurance processes including ACV/RCV and insurance estimating preferred
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy when working with financial and project data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, subcontractors, Project Managers, Operations, and Accounting
  • Ability to identify issues, research solutions, and proactively follow through to resolution while managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to handle sensitive financial and project information with professionalism and discretion

Nice to Have

  • Experience with QuickBooks, Smartsheet, Acumatica, SAP, or similar systems
  • Additional education or training in accounting, construction, or business
  • Background in multifamily property restoration or insurance-related construction billing

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience with construction accounting or restoration billing, and walking through how you have managed project budgets and accounts receivable across multiple active projects

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a detail-oriented construction accounting professional who understands how restoration projects work financially and wants ownership over a complex, high-volume project portfolio inside a nationally recognized contractor, this role gives you the scope and the accountability to do your best work.

Role Overview

This position is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic assessment and performance management of end market recycling facilities with a primary focus on plastics and fiber. Working at the intersection of policy and operations, the Director will evaluate opportunities to develop and expand end markets and ensure viability of funded facilities. This role is critical to achieving our diversion targets and fulfilling our obligations under EPR regulations.

The Director of End Market Development is a position on the End Markets team within the Material Services department of Program Planning and Operations (PPO), which also includes Compliance & Regulatory Affairs (CRA), Data & Analytics (D&A) and Emerging States. This position will need to actively collaborate with other departments both functionally within PPO (especially with the Collection & Processing team also within Material Services) and cross-functionally with Finance to ensure the end market development strategies align with CAA overall strategies.

The ideal candidate must combine strong operational background within the recycling industry, as well as strategic thinking and results-oriented skills to develop and maintain a successful relationship with end market entities.

This role will report to the VP of End Markets at CAA.

KPIs

  • Recycling capacity growth: year over years added recycling capacities for targeted materials
  • Development pipeline execution: number and value of projects advanced through diligence to approval, and percent of multi-year investment/intervention plan delivered on schedule.
  • Partner/investor engagement: number of strategic partnerships (MOUs/SOWs/offtake-related agreements) executed and maintained in good standing.
  • Cross-functional delivery: interest holder satisfaction and on-time delivery of agreed end-market work products to state/national teams (e.g., strategy, investment plan, reporting mechanisms).
  • Team performance: annual goals achieved, SOW coverage for planned work, and retention/development of direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning for End Markets Support

  • Develop and implement a multi-year recycling infrastructure development and support strategy, clearly defining CAA spend vs. outside third party spend, aligned with organizational EPR targets and material-specific goals.
  • Identify companies that are ideal partners and lead engagement activities to drive expansion and development activity.
  • Analyze business cases, feasibility studies, and capital plans submitted by facility operators and service providers.
  • Support the VP End Markets in establishing and maintaining relationships with recycling facilities’ executive teams
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure collection and analysis of existing end market capacities data
  • Oversee third-party technical audits and environmental assessments as required.

Portfolio Management & Opportunity Tracking

  • Structure and negotiate funding agreements, grants, and performance-based contracts with recycling facility operators (in collaboration with the National Reimbursement Office and the Finance department).
  • Review and assess facility performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) as established in agreement
  • Identify underperforming investments and develop remediation plans or exit strategies in collaboration with program plan operation and legal teams.
  • Continuously assess the recycling infrastructure landscape for gaps and opportunities.

Interest Holder Engagement & Partnerships

  • Map and identify key partners as well as potential investors for new applications, new plants to take recycled materials, and new expansion opportunities of existing facilities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with organizations providing funding, partnership opportunities, and with industry trade associations
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Compliance & Regulatory Affairs, Data & Analytics, Finance, and Legal to ensure development decisions are well-informed and coordinated.
  • Represent the organization at industry conferences and government working groups, where applicable
  • Perform other duties, as assigned

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of EPR regulatory frameworks across U.S. jurisdictions
  • Strength in business case analysis and risk assessment
  • Technical knowledge of recycling end-market dynamics and process technology
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical, financial, and regulatory information
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills
  • Experience with developing end markets recycling solutions for materials
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with interest holders at all levels of the organization
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and compliance.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment for rapid pace and flexibility. Ideally understand and adapt to the startup nature of CAA

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field required.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Materials Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Public Policy, or a related field preferred
  • 10+ years of operational experience in business development and expansion, ideally in recycling facilities or similar
  • 3+ years of eadership experience required
  • Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Driver's License with clean driving history

Compensation & Other Information

  • Location: Fully Remote
  • Pay Rate: Based on a variety of factors in accordance with applicable law including the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, knowledge and experience.
  • Reports To: VP End Markets

Role Overview

The HR & AI Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for shaping and evolving Fortive’s HR technology ecosystem. Reporting to the Director of HR Technology (Engineering & Platform), this position sits at the intersection of HR systems, enterprise integration, and AI innovation, leading architecture decisions across Oracle HCM Cloud, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, LMS platforms, and the broader IT landscape.

This role is the primary technical authority for HR platform architecture — defining how systems connect, how AI augments HR workflows, and how data flows reliably across the enterprise. The architect partners closely with HR Product Owners, IT/Enterprise Architecture, and vendor teams to deliver scalable, future-ready solutions that support Fortive’s operating companies and HR functions globally.

Core Technology Landscape

  • Oracle HCM Suite
  • Boomi Middleware
  • ServiceNow HRSD
  • Eightfold AI Platform
  • LMS Solutions
  • Integration APIs
  • Power BI Reporting
  • Oracle Analytics

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Systems & Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end architectural design of Fortive’s HR technology landscape, including Oracle HCM Cloud (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, Benefits), ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, and LMS platforms.
  • Develop and maintain architectural blueprints, data flow diagrams, and modernization roadmaps aligned to cloud-native, API-first principles.
  • Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the HR tech portfolio.
  • Partner with IT’s Azure-based infrastructure teams to ensure HR systems align with enterprise architecture standards and security posture.

2. Integration Architecture & Engineering

  • Define and drive integration strategy across HR systems, moving from point-to-point patterns toward reusable, API-first services.
  • Lead architecture and hands-on implementation using Boomi (atoms, molecules, connectors, process routing) as the primary middleware platform.
  • Design scalable integration patterns — real-time APIs, event-driven integrations, and batch/file-based flows — connecting Oracle HCM to Eightfold, LMS, payroll, benefits, and IT/ERP systems.
  • Maintain data integrity, auditability, and compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) across all integration flows.
  • Supervise and guide integration developers through the full development lifecycle, including code reviews, design reviews, and documentation standards.

3. AI Solutions & Automation

  • Identify and deliver high-value AI and automation use cases across the HR lifecycle — intelligent onboarding, workflow automation, AI-assisted case triage, talent insights, and conversational self-service.
  • Architect and implement AI capabilities within Oracle HCM Cloud, Eightfold’s talent intelligence platform, and ServiceNow HRSD.
  • Build and prototype solutions leveraging HR-specific AI platforms, taking ideas from POC to production.
  • Embed AI/ML, NLP, and chatbot capabilities into HR workflows and digital employee experience channels, aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
  • Establish AI performance monitoring and responsible AI frameworks for HR use cases.

4. Data Architecture & Governance

  • Design HR data models, master data management (MDM) strategies, and data lineage documentation in partnership with Data Engineering and BI teams.
  • Enable secure, governed access to HR data for analytics (Power BI, Oracle Analytics).
  • Define and enforce HR data contracts, quality standards, and privacy controls across all systems and integration points.

5. Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to HR leadership, Product Owners, and IT on HR technology architecture, AI strategy, and platform decisions.
  • Translate complex architecture and AI concepts into clear business outcomes tied to KPIs and strategic priorities.
  • Provide technical guidance on vendor selection and partnership for Oracle, ServiceNow, Eightfold, and integration tooling.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L&D, Total Rewards) to embed AI capabilities within HR programs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10–12 years of progressive experience in HR technology and enterprise systems architecture.
  • Must be available to work full U.S. Eastern Time (EST) hours each day.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud, including integrations, HCM Extracts, Security, and configuration across at least three functional modules.
  • Proven experience with Boomi or a similar enterprise integration platform (Dell Boomi preferred), including building and supporting production integrations.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, synchronous and asynchronous processing, and data transformation.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI/ML and automation solutions within HR or other enterprise business systems.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML and automation solutions within HR systems.
  • Experience with digital assistants or AI-driven employee experience platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceNow HRSD, including case management, virtual agent, and HR service delivery configuration.
  • Experience leading or mentoring small technical teams, including integration engineers and developers.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Eightfold AI or comparable talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience with LMS platform architecture (e.g., Absorb, Cornerstone, or similar).
  • Background in Agile/SAFe delivery, DevOps practices, and CI/CD for integration pipelines.
  • Experience with RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or enterprise BI architecture for HR data products.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will have mapped the current HR architecture landscape, identified integration gaps and technical debt, and proposed a prioritized modernization roadmap. Within the first year, you will have elevated integration maturity toward API-first and reusable services, shipped at least two meaningful AI-powered HR use cases into production, and established architectural standards that guide the broader HR engineering team.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Resource Planning & Operations Analytics provides enterprise leadership for the integrated resource management function, encompassing Workforce Management and Operations Analytics. Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in workforce management, resource planning, operations analytics, business intelligence, or a related operational discipline.
  • 8+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers and multiple teams or disciplines.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Expert knowledge of workforce management principles, including demand forecasting, capacity planning, staffing models, scheduling, intraday management, queue and backlog management, and resource optimization.
  • Advanced understanding of operations analytics, business intelligence, performance measurement, predictive modeling, scenario analysis, and data storytelling.
  • Strong command of both short-term operational forecasting and long-range planning, with the ability to link forecast accuracy, capacity risk, staffing actions, and financial outcomes.

Our Account Managers are the business owners of their portfolio. This is a quota-carrying role where you will own Customer Retention and Portfolio Expansion and, at a smaller scale, Onboarding. You will be a trusted strategic partner to your clients, accountable for their success metrics and the health of your book of business.

Run regular Executive Business Reviews that tie CloudTalk performance directly to your clients' KPIs. Position yourself as a trusted advisor — not just a vendor contact — and build durable relationships with decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

Lead the full renewal cycle across your portfolio — forecast risk, build proactive save strategies, and consistently hit retention targets quarter over quarter. Churn on your accounts should never come as a surprise.

Identify and close organic growth opportunities within your portfolio — whether that's increased seat count, platform adoption, or premium add-ons. You should know your accounts well enough to see expansion plays before clients do.

Build and maintain customer health frameworks for your book of business. Define the leading indicators that matter, track them in HubSpot and your analytics stack, and intervene early — before issues become escalations.

Be the voice of your clients inside CloudTalk. Partner closely with Product, Support, and Customer Engineering to resolve issues, surface feedback, and influence the roadmap — while confidently representing CloudTalk's direction back to your accounts.

  • Familiarity with CS/AM tooling: HubSpot, Gainsight, Planhat, or similar
  • Business fluency in English.

Why you’ll love being a CloudTalker

Unlimited PTO that people actually take. Fully remote with four European hubs. A coach you can book, a career path in writing, and equity when you deliver. Here's the full package.

Get better, faster

  • 💬 A coach you can actually book. Recurring 1-on-1 sessions with our resident coach. A real conversation about your career, on company time.

Rest like you mean it

People worth staying for

The Clinical Data Coder will also participate in various clinical data management activities required to ensure that data captured are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Indero standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines.

  • Define, document, and manage coding conventions, synonym lists and ensure consistent application across studies.

  • Act as the Lead Coder, coordinating coding activities across multiple studies simultaneously.
  • Manage coding priorities, balancing workload across timelines and studies.
  • Provide input to the Coding section of Data Management Plans.
  • Oversee and perform dictionary up-versioning and related upgrade activities.
  • Validate and test coding setups, programming of coding reports, and related database checks.
  • Support data review activities and resolve data clarifications in a timely manner.
  • Maintain effective communication with Data Management Leads, CRAs, and other stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or educational equivalence in pharmacy, life sciences or related field or medical, nursing qualification with 2 years relevant experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience;
  • Thorough knowledge of Medical Terminology and Medical Dictionaries used for coding (e.g. MedDRA, WHODD etc.);
  • Experience working with clinical trials or within the pharmaceutical environment is preferred;

Our company

﻿

﻿The work environment

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader in Dermatology and rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

Our Ascend® platform represents the next generation of our delivery capability — a standardized, scalable implementation model that enables faster, higher-quality client onboarding across our specialty pharmacy data ecosystem.

The Business Analyst is the primary technical executor of the Ascend platform configuration. The top expectation of this role is the ability to lead and manage spec negotiations with data partners — ensuring that inbound and outbound data file specifications are aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration work begins. This requires both deep technical fluency in specialty pharmacy data structures and the communication skills to drive data partners toward compliant, complete specifications without compromising go-live timelines.

Working from the Configuration Blueprint produced by the Delivery Director, the BA owns all data mapping, platform configuration, and internal quality assurance before any client-facing testing begins. The BA operates as a critical resource within the Ascend implementation team — interfacing with Engagement Managers, Delivery Directors, and Customer Engineering — and is expected to communicate capacity constraints proactively given the demands of a multi-client portfolio.

As a member of the Delivery and Operations team, the BA is responsible for executing implementation configuration work, conducting rigorous internal QA, and ensuring that nothing advances to UAT without sign-off. The BA is the standard-vs-custom decision support layer for data: identifying when client requests require escalation to Product or Customer Engineering versus when they can be addressed within the standard data model. Role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Data Partner Spec Negotiation ★ Primary Accountability

  • Lead spec negotiations with specialty pharmacy and other data partners to ensure inbound and outbound file specifications are fully aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration begins — this is the single most critical function of the role
  • Review partner-submitted data specifications for completeness, field-level accuracy, and model alignment; document gaps and drive resolution directly with the data partner
  • Negotiate field mappings, list-of-values (LOVs), file formats, and delivery cadences with data partners, escalating to the Engagement Manager only when partner alignment cannot be achieved at the working level
  • Validate test files against finalized specifications and flag discrepancies before data enters the pipeline; maintain a clear record of spec versions and sign-off status across all active partners
  • Translate data partner constraints into actionable decisions for the implementation team — identifying what can be resolved through configuration, what requires a spec exception, and what must route to Customer Engineering

Platform Configuration & Data Mapping

  • Own all platform configuration work: data mapping, configuration tooling, business logic implementation, and front-end reporting setup — all driven by the Configuration Blueprint received from the Delivery Director
  • Review data specifications produced in collaboration with the Engagement Manager; proactively flag data model mismatches or gaps prior to configuration work beginning
  • Load data into the pipeline using configuration tooling once specifications are finalized and signed off by relevant stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Customer Engineering on the handoff of data mapping for standard data model onboarding; provide CE with the context needed for custom build workstreams

Internal QA & Quality Standards

  • Conduct internal QA testing of all configuration work prior to partner or client-facing testing — nothing advances to UAT without BA sign-off
  • Track and resolve defects identified during internal QA and UAT for all configuration-related issues
  • Perform quality control procedures to assure configurations and data quality meet acceptance criteria prior to go-live
  • Develop and maintain QA documentation, test case frameworks, and checklists that support repeatable, auditable testing across implementations

Escalation & Non-Standard Request Routing

  • Identify whether client requests fall within the standard Ascend data model, require configuration adjustment, or require escalation — to Product for roadmap consideration or to Customer Engineering for custom build
  • Document and route non-standard requests with clear business need descriptions and technical context so that Product and CE can act without re-scoping
  • Conduct change impact analysis to assess how updates or non-standard requests may affect system performance and configuration decisions

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Consult with Engagement Managers on data partner specs, testing timelines, and UAT scheduling to ensure internal readiness gates are met
  • Coordinate with Delivery Director on receipt and interpretation of the Configuration Blueprint — the primary work input for each implementation
  • Report blockers, capacity constraints, and escalations to the Engagement Manager proactively; given a typical 1-BA-to-many implementations ratio, early communication of bandwidth risks is a core accountability
  • Support the Delivery Director and Customer Success with UAT business validation for configuration-related questions

Process, Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate schema normalization of system databases; maintain data dictionaries and file inventories across customer applications
  • Consults with cross-functional teams to document business requirements, operating procedures, issue resolution processes, and platform configurations that enable efficient implementation
  • Develop and maintain an operating playbook that details best practices for configuration sequencing, data partner onboarding, and documentation requirements
  • Write clear, detailed procedures for internal training and be able to train other Business Analysts as the team scales
  • Support creation and ongoing maintenance of standard UAT test script templates for core Ascend use cases in partnership with the Delivery Director

Who You Are

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Demonstrated ability to lead data partner spec negotiations — driving alignment on file specifications, field mappings, and LOVs across multiple external partners simultaneously
  • Excellent written and oral communication — able to document complex data relationships clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks simultaneously with rigorous attention to detail across a high-volume implementation portfolio
  • A creative approach to operational problem solving and a relentless passion for quality
  • Deep knowledge of data management in specialty biotech and/or operations in reimbursement call centers or specialty pharmacies
  • Familiarity with healthcare data sources — transactional, clinical, and behavioral — including specialty pharmacy data file types (patient demographics, dispense, status, inventory)
  • Understanding of standard implementation lifecycle frameworks: UAT facilitation, defect triage, QA gating, and go-live readiness
  • Ability to exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies when selecting methods and techniques for configuration decisions

Education & Experience

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree from a 4-year university
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an operations role at a biopharmaceutical manufacturer, reimbursement call center, specialty pharmacy, or data management company
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other analytic tools — specifically data comparison, conditional formulas, data summary, and conversion
  • Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Background and experience with the Business Analysis toolkit including systems development lifecycles, problem solving and root cause analysis methods, and the ability to document business process models
  • Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables across multiple concurrent implementations or client programs

Preferred:

  • Experience with specialty pharmacy data file specifications, SFTP workflows, and data onboarding processes
  • Academic training in public health, business administration, and/or operations research
  • Case management experience in a reimbursement call center or specialty pharmacy
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, JIRA, or Confluence
  • Familiarity with Google Docs, workflow diagram tools, web-based software systems, and relational databases
  • Experience working within a structured RACI model or implementation team framework

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.

We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $115,000 to $125,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote)

Job Description

Join our award-winning One Concentrix team as a Senior Partner Success Manager (Remote) supporting one of the world's most innovative AI-native technology companies. This role operates at the intersection of AI, customer outcomes, partner performance, and business transformation in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where speed, ownership, and execution matter.
The Senior Partner Success Manager owns a defined portfolio of partner-led customer engagements and serves as the accountable business owner for customer outcomes, engagement health, risk mitigation, adoption, and value realization across that book of business. This individual is accountable for delivery quality, customer adoption, engagement health, partner performance, customer value realization, and overall portfolio success. They are expected to independently assess situations, establish priorities, make informed business decisions, and take proactive action to improve outcomes across their portfolio.

Success in this role requires maintaining detailed visibility into every active engagement, including customer objectives, implementation progress, adoption trends, delivery risks, milestones, partner performance, blockers, and business outcomes. The Senior Partner Success Manager proactively identifies stalled or at-risk engagements, diagnoses root causes, coordinates resolution across internal and external stakeholders, and drives successful customer outcomes.

This role serves as the operational leader across partner-delivered customer engagements, balancing customer success, partner accountability, delivery excellence, AI solution adoption, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with business acumen, program management discipline, customer success expertise, and technical fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, and enterprise software solutions. Candidates should have practical experience leveraging AI-driven business solutions and automation as part of their daily work.

ABOUT CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Partner Success Manager to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.

Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Portfolio Ownership & Customer Engagement Success

  • Own and actively manage a book of business consisting of multiple concurrent partner-led customer engagements, balancing priorities, allocating attention based on business impact, and ensuring successful outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Maintain weekly visibility into each engagement's scope, timeline, milestones, blockers, implementation status, customer health, and adoption trends.
  • Act as the accountable owner for engagement success, making judgment calls regarding prioritization, escalation, intervention strategies, and risk mitigation activities when challenges emerge.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer goals, solution objectives, operational requirements, and success criteria.
  • Coordinate seamless transitions from sales, implementation, deployment, and ongoing customer adoption phases.

Delivery Excellence & Engagement Management

  • Conduct weekly engagement reviews across the portfolio, identifying stalled, delayed, deteriorating, or at-risk engagements and implementing intervention strategies designed to restore momentum and improve customer outcomes.
  • Assess delivery plans, implementation approaches, project governance models, resource allocations, and customer readiness to identify risks before they impact outcomes.
  • Continuously prioritize resources, actions, and stakeholder engagement efforts across the portfolio based on customer impact, business value, risk exposure, and strategic importance.
  • Track engagement progression against milestones, timelines, adoption metrics, and business objectives.
  • Ensure customer deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned to agreed success measures.
  • Maintain a structured operating rhythm that promotes accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.
  • Maintain and execute a self-built weekly engagement review cadence that ensures timely identification, prioritization, and resolution of delivery, adoption, and customer outcome risks across the portfolio.

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

  • Diagnose and remove barriers to successful delivery, including partner capacity constraints, implementation delays, resource challenges, scope changes, customer readiness issues, technical dependencies, adoption risks, and change management obstacles.
  • Exercise independent judgment to determine when intervention is required, when risks should be escalated, and what recovery actions are necessary to protect customer outcomes.
  • Evaluate competing priorities, incomplete information, and complex stakeholder dynamics to make sound business decisions in fast-moving situations.
  • Lead structured recovery efforts for red, escalated, or strategically important customer accounts, driving accountability across all involved stakeholders.
  • Manage escalations involving delivery quality, customer satisfaction, implementation performance, partner accountability, adoption concerns, or operational execution.
  • Bring forward clear diagnoses, accountable owners, remediation plans, and timelines for resolution rather than simply reporting status.
  • Drive issues through resolution by coordinating efforts across customers, partners, delivery teams, product teams, alliance organizations, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop recovery plans for stalled, underperforming, or at-risk engagements.

Customer Adoption, Consumption & Business Outcomes

  • Own customer adoption, utilization, consumption growth, retention indicators, and business value realization across the portfolio.
  • Identify customers showing declining adoption, stalled progress, or realization gaps and proactively design intervention plans to improve engagement health and business outcomes.
  • Monitor customer engagement metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Develop and execute action plans to improve customer adoption, operational effectiveness, and solution utilization.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to maximize customer value and expansion opportunities.
  • Track and report on metrics related to adoption growth, business outcomes, engagement completion, and customer success.
  • Demonstrate accountability for measurable outcomes tied to completed delivery, customer adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, time-to-value achievement, and realization of documented customer business outcomes.

Partner Leadership & Accountability

  • Build trusted executive-level relationships with partner practice leaders, delivery leaders, alliance executives, architects, engagement managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence, challenge, and hold partners accountable for delivery performance, staffing decisions, operational execution, customer commitments, and business outcomes.
  • Hold partners accountable for engagement execution, customer outcomes, adoption targets, and delivery performance.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations and constructive challenge when partner decisions, delivery approaches, or resource allocations may negatively impact customer success.
  • Drive difficult conversations when necessary, using sound judgment and business rationale to align partners around corrective actions and improved performance.
  • Lead quarterly partner practice reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partner alliance and delivery leaders, establishing and monitoring joint goals for completed customer engagements, customer adoption, certified practitioner capacity, customer references, repeatable offerings, and industry positioning.
  • Help partners strengthen their AI delivery capability, grow certified AI expertise, develop repeatable AI solutions, and create customer success stories that can be used to support future client engagements.
  • Steward partner co-investment and program funding requests by assessing each request against a defined customer or business outcome, recommending approval or rejection, and reconciling investment against agreed milestones and achieved results.

Practice Development & Operational Excellence

  • Create scalable operating models, governance frameworks, review methodologies, engagement health assessments, escalation processes, success plans, and delivery playbooks.
  • Transform successful engagement practices into repeatable methodologies that improve consistency, scalability, and operational performance.
  • Document and institutionalize best practices, engagement review frameworks, risk management processes, and adoption strategies.
  • Continuously improve operational effectiveness through process optimization and performance analysis.
  • Help shape the long-term Partner Success operating model for Concentrix AI-enabled service offerings.

AI, LLM & Technology Enablement

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency using AI, LLMs, automation platforms, and emerging agentic AI technologies as a core component of daily work.
  • Regularly utilize agentic AI tools and AI-powered assistants to analyze portfolio health, identify risks, generate recommendations, uncover trends, automate workflows, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Leverage AI to increase scale, efficiency, and effectiveness while applying independent business judgment to validate recommendations and determine appropriate actions.
  • Apply AI tools to analyze customer data, identify risks, generate recommendations, streamline workflows, and improve decision-making.
  • Utilize AI-generated insights while applying sound business judgment and operational expertise.
  • Leverage customer telemetry, engagement metrics, adoption data, and operational reporting to drive actions and recommendations.
  • Stay informed on advancements in AI, LLMs, automation, SaaS platforms, and enterprise technologies impacting customers and partners.
  • Champion AI-first ways of working and identify opportunities to embed AI-driven processes into customer, partner, and operational workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Professional Services, Operations, Support, Solution Design, Alliance, and Executive Leadership teams to drive alignment and successful customer outcomes.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities, ensuring decisions are made and actions are executed in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate successful handoffs between customer acquisition, implementation, delivery, and adoption activities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor regarding customer health, partner performance, operational risks, and engagement status.
  • Present recommendations, performance updates, escalation plans, and business reviews to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE WILL BE MEASURED BY

  • Customer adoption and utilization growth
  • Customer satisfaction and retention
  • Engagement completion within scope and timeline commitments
  • Time from engagement assignment to successful completion
  • AI solution adoption and consumption growth
  • Partner performance and relationship strength
  • At-risk engagement identification and recovery effectiveness
  • Time from an engagement being identified as stalled or at risk to successful resolution and restoration of forward progress.
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness and speed
  • Portfolio health and risk reduction
  • Customer business outcome achievement
  • Executive stakeholder trust and engagement
  • Operational scalability and process improvement
  • Adherence to and effectiveness of a structured, self-built weekly portfolio review rhythm that consistently identifies risks, drives accountability, and improves engagement outcomes.
  • Development and adoption of repeatable playbooks, methodologies, and governance frameworks
  • Effective use of AI-enabled solutions and automation to improve business outcomes

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Partner Success, Customer Success, Delivery Management, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, Program Management, or related fields.
  • Experience owning a high-volume portfolio of concurrent customer engagements, projects, implementations, or accounts (typically 10-30 simultaneously) from initiation through successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success managing metrics tied to customer behavior and business outcomes, including adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, customer success, or expansion.
  • Demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes, customer adoption, utilization, retention, consumption growth, time-to-value, or business value realization, with the ability to quantify impact and results achieved.
  • Experience reviewing implementation plans, delivery approaches, project scope, and customer readiness to identify execution risk and drive successful outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret statements of work (SOWs), delivery commitments, implementation plans, governance models, and documented success criteria, and identify gaps between contracted outcomes, partner execution, and actual customer experience.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex delivery, adoption, operational, and stakeholder challenges.
  • Ability to describe, in specific and personal terms, at least one stalled or at-risk customer engagement they individually diagnosed, led, and successfully unblocked, distinct from activities primarily executed by a broader team.
  • Strong experience managing escalations and recovering at-risk customer engagements.
  • Deep understanding of customer success within usage-based, subscription-based, SaaS, AI, cloud, or technology-driven businesses.
  • Experience designing operational processes, governance models, frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, or review structures that scale across teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across customer, partner, executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to lead delivery reviews, evaluate implementation plans, participate in solution discussions, and engage credibly with technical stakeholders.
  • Proven hands-on experience leveraging AI, LLMs, agentic AI tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, or AI-driven business solutions as part of daily operations. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how AI has been used to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, productivity, or business results.
  • Proven hands-on experience using an LLM to build or materially improve a business workflow, analytical deliverable, operating process, or customer solution. Candidates must be able to demonstrate a real artifact or workflow, explain the problem addressed, describe how prompts or instructions were refined, identify limitations or unsupported outputs, and articulate the resulting business impact.

Preferred

  • Experience in roles with direct accountability for delivery execution, customer outcomes, implementation success, adoption, utilization, and value realization. Candidates whose background is primarily limited to relationship management, account stewardship, sales, or account growth without ownership of delivery outcomes may not be successful in this role.
  • Experience leading red account reviews, executive escalations, customer recovery programs, and structured intervention planning for at-risk accounts.
  • 5 to 8+ years supporting systems integrators, consulting firms, alliance partners, or partner-led delivery organizations.
  • Experience working with organizations such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, or similar consulting and integration partners.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, AI, cloud, enterprise software, professional services, or digital transformation environments.
  • Experience managing offshore, contract, or shared services delivery resources.
  • Experience administering co-investment funding, innovation initiatives, partner enablement programs, or market development funds.
  • Experience leading executive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Industry expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, Technology, or Public Sector markets.
  • Experience supporting enterprise and strategic customer accounts.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Gainsight, HubSpot, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent CRM and customer success platforms.
  • Must reside in the United States and have a valid U.S. residential address.

The salary for this position is $105,000 to 110,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.

WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.

Finalists should expect to participate in a live, unscripted walkthrough of an actual deliverable, workflow, or solution they personally created using an LLM. This discussion will focus on the business problem addressed, implementation approach, prompt refinement, limitations encountered, lessons learned, and measurable business impact. Prepared demonstrations or hypothetical examples are not preferred.

We’re looking for an Implementation Manager to lead our growing segment of mid-market employers through the transition to Thatch – from initial planning through a successful transition to account management.

It requires employers and plan administrators to adopt a new mindset, new processes, and a new way of communicating about benefits. You’ll serve as a trusted guide throughout that change, helping customers make informed decisions, prepare their teams, and deliver a smooth enrollment experience for employees.

This role is ideal for someone who runs exceptionally sharp processes, communicates clearly, and can bring order to complex, cross-functional work. You should be technically curious and comfortable working with data integrations, but you do not need to be an engineer. You’ll also develop deep expertise in health benefits and ICHRA, also known as CHOICE, – and will become a trusted advisor to your new customers.

What you'll do

  • Own implementations from pre-sale planning through launch and post-implementation handoff.
  • Build and manage clear project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and escalation paths.
  • Lead customers through the operational and organizational changes required to adopt an ICHRA.
  • Educate and train employers and plan administrators, giving them the knowledge and confidence to manage their new benefits model.
  • Develop enrollment strategies and employee communication plans tailored to each employer’s workforce.
  • Coordinate enrollment readiness, including eligibility data, payroll inputs, integrations, testing, and issue resolution.
  • Partner closely with Field Account Managers to deliver a coordinated, high-touch implementation experience.
  • Collaborate with Sales before handoff to validate scope, surface risks, and set clear expectations.
  • Work with Account Management after launch to ensure a seamless transition into the ongoing customer relationship.
  • Coordinate across internal teams, including Product, Operations, Support, and Compliance, to keep implementations moving.
  • Identify recurring friction points and turn what you learn into stronger, more scalable implementation processes.

Background we're looking for

  • Experience leading customer implementations, onboarding programs, change-management initiatives, or similarly complex projects.
  • Strong project and process management skills, with a record of keeping multiple stakeholders aligned and accountable.
  • Excellent customer communication, facilitation, education, and training skills.
  • The ability to translate unfamiliar or technical concepts into clear, practical guidance.
  • Comfort working with customer data, file transfers, system integrations, and technical partners.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to anticipate risks, manage competing priorities, and escalate issues early.
  • Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing people without direct authority.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

  • Curiosity and the motivation to develop deep expertise in ICHRA, also known as CHOICE, and the broader benefits industry.
  • Benefits, HR technology, payroll, or healthcare experience is helpful but not required.

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

The IQVIA Product Organization is looking for a strategic and execution-driven Sr. Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to lead positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for our healthcare-oriented media platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing, translating complex healthcare and AdTech capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with healthcare brands, agencies, and partners.

The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of healthcare marketing regulations and dynamics (HIPAA, data privacy, patient engagement) with proven experience in AdTech, MarTech, and/or digital media. This position will help support a multitude of IQVIA Digital products.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and execute GTM plans for new and existing healthcare AdTech products, including audience solutions, media activation, and measurement capabilities.
  • Positioning & Messaging: Craft clear, differentiated product positioning and customer-focused messaging tailored to healthcare marketers, payers, providers, and life sciences.
  • Product Marketing Strategic Planning: Partner with marketing on strategic marketing planning and integrated campaigns that drive product adoption, customer engagement, and pipeline growth; leverage performance data to optimize messaging and GTM strategies.
  • Sales Enablement: Partner with commercial strategy, product, marketing and sales to create materials that drive pipeline and revenue, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, and playbooks.
  • Market Research & Insights: Conduct market analysis to understand healthcare marketing trends, regulatory considerations, and competitor offerings; translate insights into product and marketing strategy.
  • Customer Advocacy & Voice of Customer: Develop customer insight-gathering initiatives (e.g., customer advocacy program) and integrate feedback loops into product strategy.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with product leaders to influence roadmaps, ensuring customer needs, compliance requirements, and market opportunities are prioritized.
  • Thought Leadership: Collaborate with marketing to develop expert-led content (e.g., speaking sessions, whitepapers, webinars, conference materials) that positions the company as a trusted leader in healthcare advertising innovation.
  • Metrics & Optimization: Set KPIs for launches and campaigns, monitor results, and refine strategy to boost adoption and revenue.

Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of product marketing and/or strategy experience, preferably in Digital marketing, AdTech, or Digital media, with exposure to healthcare/life sciences marketing.
  • Proven track record of building GTM strategies and delivering successful product launches.
  • Ability to tailor positioning and collateral to specific advertiser segments (brands, agencies, endemic vs. non-endemic categories).
  • Exceptional communication skills — able to distill complex technical concepts into simple, impactful messaging.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales teams with enablement tools and competitive insights.
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in financial modeling, pricing analysis, and adoption/usage metrics.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field (MBA a plus).

Position Overview:

The Senior Director, Agile Delivery is a senior practitioner and organizational leader responsible for scaling and standardizing agile delivery practices across Vibrant’s Tech division. This role serves as the connective tissue between product, engineering, and data teams—ensuring that cross-functional pods operate with clarity, cadence, and continuous improvement. The Director will establish and sustain delivery infrastructure (ceremonies, tooling, metrics, coaching) that enables Vibrant’s Tech organization to execute reliably against program commitments.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Design and steward a Tech-wide agile operating model that works across Engineering, Product, Data, and Enterprise IT pods; establish consistent sprint rhythms, definition-of-done standards, backlog hygiene practices, and release planning cadences.

  • Strategically design the organization's approach to Agile, scaling methodologies across departments to align org-wide goals with execution.

  • Adapt agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe elements) to fit Vibrant’s hybrid program/product context, including grant-funded deliverable timelines with external reporting obligations.

  • Partner with pod leads and VPs to track delivery velocity, surface blockers, and facilitate impediment resolution across TECH’s program portfolio.

  • Own cross-pod dependency management and integrated release planning; maintain a rolling TECH delivery roadmap updated on a regular cadence.

  • Build and maintain delivery dashboards (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) providing real-time visibility to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Manage budget for multiple agile teams, monitoring actual spend against budgeted forecast.

  • Coach and mentor embedded scrum masters, product owners, and technical leads on agile principles and practices; design and facilitate agile training programs and communities of practice across Tech.

  • Serve as the primary liaison on delivery governance questions from the CTO office, program leadership and external partners.

  • Translate delivery metrics into executive-ready narratives; present delivery status, risk, and trend data at departmental meetings, executive check-ins and board touchpoints as needed.

  • Champion a culture of psychological safety, retrospection, and iterative improvement across all Tech pods.

  • Lead complex, cross-domain delivery engagements and establish delivery patterns that can be repeated across future programs and grant cycles.

  • Additional duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep hands-on fluency with Scrum and Kanban; demonstrated success adapting agile frameworks to distributed, mission-driven, or grant-funded environments.

  • Strong executive communication skills; comfortable presenting delivery risk, velocity, and status to C-suite and board audiences in plain language.

  • Proficiency with delivery tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, or equivalent; experience building delivery dashboards and KPI frameworks for cross-functional organizations.

  • Demonstrated success leading delivery transformation across multi-team or multi-program organizations, including navigating organizational change.

  • Ability to work fully independently and lead delivery teams with a high degree of accountability for output quality.

  • Strong facilitation and conflict resolution skills; experience coaching teams across power and role differences.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in agile delivery, program management, or related roles; 5+ years in a leadership or coaching capacity.

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), or equivalent practitioner certification preferred.

  • Experience in nonprofit, public sector, health tech, or crisis services contexts strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with federal grant reporting environments preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.

  • Will frequently communicate over video calls with internal and external stakeholders to provide status updates and potential roadblocks.

Design, develop, and deploy Golang-based microservices on Cloud providers, following best practices for scalability, performance, and security.

Advanced English skills, both written and verbal, to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

In-depth knowledge of Cloud services, particularly Azure, and experience with deploying and managing applications on cloud infrastructure.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Strong experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for setting up build pipelines and infrastructure as code.
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.

Experience with Ruby would be a plus!
