jobs.description:
Principal AI Engineer — Velsera

AI Platform & Enablement · Reports to the CTO · Senior individual contributor

About the role

Velsera builds software and infrastructure for precision medicine — research platforms, clinical and diagnostic applications, and the systems that keep them running in regulated environments. We are adding AI capability across that portfolio and inside our own operations: governed model access, self-hosted and managed LLM serving, evaluation and audit, and integration into the products and business processes people already depend on.

This is a deliberately broad role. You will be deployed where the highest-value AI work is at the time — a customer-facing product capability in one quarter, an internal enterprise workflow in the next, a strategic account or funded program after that. The mandate stays the same wherever you land: design and ship production AI systems that hold up under real compliance requirements, work across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and leave behind reusable patterns rather than one-off builds.

You will set technical direction for what is expected to grow into an AI platform and enablement team.

What you'll work on

  • Build a governed model access layer — self-hosted open-weight models, cloud-managed models (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI), and customer- or partner-supplied models — designed to be consumed by more than one product or business function.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into product experiences and enterprise workflows across batch, interactive, and agentic patterns.
  • Establish the patterns everyone else reuses: evaluation, versioning, approvals, audit trails, cost control, guardrails, and safe rollout and rollback.
  • Partner with product, engineering, security, QARA/compliance, IT, and scientific and commercial teams to introduce AI-native architectures that people can actually adopt.
  • Move between assignments as business priorities shift, and make what you build in one part of the business usable in the next.

What you'll deliver (first 6–12 months)

  • A production-ready, compliant AI/LLM serving and invocation layer that at least two products or business functions adopt — multi-tenant, auditable, and secure.
  • A model governance workflow (intake, evaluation, approval, versioning, deprecation) that satisfies both regulated customers and our own quality system.
  • Two or three AI capabilities shipped end to end in different parts of the business — for example a customer-facing product feature, an internal process automation, and assisted validation or compliance tooling.
  • Integration patterns that preserve reproducibility, traceability, and standards alignment wherever the work lands.
  • Operational readiness: monitoring, evaluation harnesses, incident playbooks, cost visibility, and measurable SLOs for key AI services.
  • A defensible internal point of view on where we should build, buy, or not use AI at all — backed by what you shipped.

How we build (and what we'll expect you to optimize for)

You will make trade-offs in an environment that is multi-product, multi-cloud, standards-driven, and compliance-heavy. A few things matter a lot here:

  • Reusability over one-offs. Design the second and third use case into the first one. A solution that only works for one product or one team is a partial solution.
  • Standards and clean interfaces. Prefer open standards and well-defined boundaries over bespoke integrations.
  • Multi-cloud, multi-deployment reality. AWS, Azure, and GCP are all in play, alongside customer-managed and self-hosted environments. Avoid hard dependencies on a single provider's AI stack.
  • Security and auditability by default. Access control, logging, traceability, and data governance are part of the design, not add-ons.
  • Reproducibility. AI features have to fit into workflows and processes that need to be repeatable and explainable, sometimes years later.
  • Proportion. Ship the smallest thing that genuinely works, then harden it. Governance that makes a workflow unusable has failed.

Requirements

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years shipping AI/ML systems to production.
  • Strong Python, plus one of Java, Go, or TypeScript; comfortable in a polyglot codebase and in production code review.
  • Hands-on experience with secure cloud architecture on at least one major cloud — network isolation, IAM boundaries, private connectivity, audit logging — and readiness to work in the others.
  • Experience operating or integrating model serving across delivery modes: self-hosted open-weight models, managed model APIs, and customer-provided models.
  • MLOps/LLMOps experience with tooling such as AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or equivalent.
  • Built governance for ML/LLM systems: evaluation, versioning, approvals, rollout and rollback, deprecation.
  • Comfortable designing for regulated or audited environments (HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, FedRAMP, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar).
  • Experience with RAG and LLM tool-use/agentic patterns beyond prototypes, including how you evaluated them.
  • Track record integrating with systems you don't own — existing products, third-party SaaS, enterprise data sources — without breaking them.
  • Clear written communication for mixed audiences: engineering, product, security and compliance, business stakeholders, and scientists.
  • Comfort switching context across problem domains and starting from ambiguous requirements.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in genomics, biomedical data, or life sciences platforms.
  • Software built under a quality management system (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IVDR) or in clinical/diagnostic contexts.
  • Integrating AI capabilities into workflow or orchestration engines (CWL/WDL/Nextflow or similar).
  • Familiarity with GA4GH standards (WES/DRS/TRS) and/or clinical data models (FHIR, OMOP).
  • Enterprise systems integration: CRM, ERP, ITSM, document and quality management, collaboration suites.
  • Production experience on more than one cloud, with pragmatic multi-cloud trade-off judgment.
  • Experience on customer-funded or grant-funded engagements alongside product and services teams.

This role is a fit if…

  • You want to build the platform layer and the capabilities on top of it — not model research or prompt engineering alone.
  • You would rather solve four different problems well across a business than the same problem for three years.
  • You are energized rather than frustrated by environments where auditability, access control, and traceability are hard requirements.
  • You like improving live production systems without breaking what customers and colleagues rely on.
  • You are willing to say no to AI when it is not the right tool, and to say so in writing.

Why join

You'll shape how AI gets built across Velsera — in the products our customers run sensitive biomedical data through, and in the way we operate as a company. The constraints are real, the users are close, and the scope of ownership is unusually broad for a single role.

Benefits

Our core values

People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.

Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.

Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. We are thoughtful and intentional with every customer interaction understanding the overall impact on human health.

Curious. We ask questions and actively listen in order to learn and continuously improve. We embrace change and the opportunities it presents to make each other better. We strive to be on the cutting edge of science and technology innovation by encouraging creativity.

Impactful. We take our social responsibility with the seriousness it deserves and hold ourselves to a high standard. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.

Velsera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Senior Support Engineer as a founding member of our Identity Customer Success organization. You'll be the technical lifeline for our most strategic enterprise accounts and help architect how the support function operates from day one.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, identity security, and AI-driven workflow design. You'll diagnose the most complex issues across our customers' environments, help build the systems and processes the support team will run on for years, and partner with Product and Engineering as a trusted technical resource.

You’re a builder, not just a ticket-taker. If you want to inherit a mature support org and operate inside it, this may not be the right fit. But if you are excited about building a support function from the ground up, we’d love to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the end-to-end resolution of complex issues across our enterprise customer base - driving everything from initial triage and bug reproduction to root-cause analysis, technical fixes, and client-facing communication.
  • Resolve complex issues across customer identity stacks in both SaaS and on-premise environments.
  • Investigate distributed systems and data pipeline issues across our platform - debugging NXLog collectors, S3 ingestion pipelines, MongoDB query behaviors, asynchronous jobs, and Datadog logs.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal stakeholder. Reproduce bugs cleanly, file high-quality, detailed engineering tickets, and quantify customer health signals to prioritize the right fixes.
  • Build the support knowledge base from scratch - customer-facing troubleshooting guides, internal runbooks, and integration playbooks. Own critical escalations so customers leave a Sev-1 with more confidence in us than they had going in.
  • You’ll get to build AI agents using Claude, Gemini, and MCP servers that automate L1/L2 triage, log analysis, and case routing across Slack, Linear, and Pylon.
  • Define SLAs, support KPI’s, escalation paths, on-call rotation, and internal workflows with TAMs, Solution Architects, and Engineering.

Who You Are

  • You possess excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with a proven track record of remaining calm, articulate, and methodical during severe technical escalations or system outages.
  • Attention to detail is a part of your MO. Nothing slips through the cracks with you, even under pressure. Sev-1s, escalations, fast-paced environments, and changing priorities don't phase you.
  • You listen before you troubleshoot, solving for the customer rather than just trying to close a ticket.
  • Cross-collaboration across different teams and stakeholders comes naturally to you, keeping customer success at the center of everything.
  • Grounded in deep identity expertise, but always willing to learn what’s next.
  • You are relentlessly results-oriented, working hand-in-hand to align customer success with company goals while maintaining the drive to deliver your best work when the stakes are high.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 6+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering within cybersecurity.
  • Direct background in identity security — IAM, PAM, IGA, or non-human identity — is required.
  • Deep, hands-on experience working with core identity stacks (like Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory), identity governance platforms (like SailPoint), and PAM solutions (like CyberArk or BeyondTrust).
  • Working knowledge of AWS, GCP, and Azure IAM. Strong fluency in SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and mTLS — you can read a SAML response and tell me why it's failing.
  • Practical experience with cloud security models across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including configured role policies, trust relationships, Azure Service Principals/Enterprise Applications, and GCP Service Accounts.
  • Working knowledge of service accounts, API keys, tokens, certificates, secrets rotation, ephemeral credentials, and JIT access. Hands-on with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or GCP Secret Manager.
  • Strong observability instincts with hands-on experience utilizing enterprise logging and SIEM solutions (such as Datadog or Splunk). Fluent in SQL, JSON, YAML, and HCL.
  • Advanced troubleshooting with HTTP debugging, analyzing HAR traces, and reading Go or TypeScript stack traces.
  • Comfortable integrating AI tools directly into your daily support workflow. You know how to build effective prompts and collaborate with AI agents to constantly improve and speed up how we handle cases.
  • A genuine passion for advocating for customer success within a complex, fast-paced technical environment. Exceptional relationship management and multi-channel communication skills, with the ability to represent Cyera confidently and clearly under pressure to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

This 100% property focused role is ideal for a technically strong, mechanically inclined engineer with expertise in complex manufacturing operations and fire protection systems. The consultant will independently conduct on site property risk assessments, identify key loss drivers, and partner with insureds to deliver practical risk improvement recommendations. Experience evaluating high hazard occupancies—such as plastics manufacturing, aerosols, perfumes, sawmills, and other combustible or sprinkler dependent operations—is required. Strong sprinkler system knowledge is essential, as is experience in the standard and middle market property space with modern manufacturing risks. This role requires excellent technical judgment, time management, and consultative skills, along with the ability to assess evolving industrial processes. This full-time, exempt position is fully remote and open to candidates based in Illinois with the ability to travel within region. The level is flexible, and professionals with proven high hazard property experience are encouraged to apply.

At The Hanover, we value diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard.

THIS IS A FULL-TIME, EXEMPT ROLE.

Operates semi-autonomously regarding core competencies including day-to-day risk engineering and insured support activities. WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

As Senior Compensation Analyst, you own the day-to-day technical execution of Boldr's global compensation programmes and serve as the primary backup point of contact for the Senior Manager, Total Rewards on compensation operations. You are the team's deepest technical expert on job evaluation, market benchmarking, job architecture, and salary banding, and the first point of contact for compensation matters when the Senior Manager is unavailable.

You will help maintain our compensation structures, conduct job evaluations, and market benchmarking activities that keep Boldr's pay practices internally equitable and externally competitive.

You bring rigour and consistency to how Boldr levels roles and builds pay structures globally, lead cross-functional compensation projects end to end, and act as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact pay decisions. You also help modernize how the Total Rewards team works, including introducing AI-enabled workflows to improve speed and consistency, and mentor other members of the team on compensation methodology.

You will also work closely with colleagues across People Business Partners, Finance, and People Operations to provide accurate, well-organised compensation data and analysis that supports decision-making and help maintain fairness, competitiveness, and compliance across all regions.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Compensation Strategy & Design

  • Shape Boldr's global compensation strategy alongside the Senior Manager, weighing in on how it should evolve as the business changes, and help maintain continuity of in-flight strategic initiatives when the Senior Manager is unavailable.
  • Own job leveling frameworks and salary structures day to day, and lead market benchmarking (e.g., Mercer, Radford), including scoping methodology and validating results.
  • Turn compensation data into inputs for financial planning, pay equity audits, and total rewards forecasting, and flag where the numbers suggest a change in approach.

Job Architecture & Leveling

  • Drive clarity and consistency in job architecture, levelling frameworks, and compensation bands globally, and build the levelling guides, career ladders, and job description standards that keep it consistent across regions and business units.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders on new and evolving roles to make sure they're scoped and levelled consistently with existing architecture.

Operational Excellence & Program Management

  • Conduct job evaluations, analysis, salary benchmarking and job scoping for the business.
  • Co-lead the annual compensation review cycle and related meetings, and lead compensation projects end to end (timelines, stakeholder coordination, status reporting) across People Operations, People Business Partners, Finance, and external comp tool vendors; strong project management skills are essential to this role.
  • Design and maintain the dashboards, data models, reports and analytics the Total Rewards team relies on, and set the standards for data integrity across HRIS and compensation systems (e.g., PayScale, Payfactors).
  • Champion process improvement, including piloting and rolling out AI-enabled workflows to improve speed and consistency, and serve as a key technical advisor to People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on complex or high-stakes pay decisions and global offer strategies.

Governance & Compliance

  • Track local regulatory requirements (e.g., pay equity, wage transparency, labour laws) across regions and flag risk areas before they become problems.
  • Design and run internal audits and reviews, tightening compensation policies and documentation standards where gaps turn up, and build out related communications and training materials for People Leaders.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Serve as the primary backup point of contact for compensation matters when the Senior Manager is out or unavailable, and serve as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact pay decisions.
  • Prepare compensation findings, trends, and recommendations to People leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Mentor other Total Rewards team members on compensation methodology and best practices.

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • A strong technical and analytical thinker who can also step back and advise at a strategic level
  • Team-oriented with a customer-service approach and a willingness to mentor others

YOU HAVE…

  • A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in compensation analysis or total rewards, including experience in a global or multi-country environment.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in job evaluation, market benchmarking, job description creation, compensation analysis, and building salary bands.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with experience leading compensation projects from scoping through delivery.
  • Experience managing compensation systems (e.g., PayScale, Payfactors) and survey platforms (e.g., Mercer, Radford).
  • Deep understanding of global compensation frameworks, pay equity, and compliance standards.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise leaders on complex pay decisions.
  • Experience or strong interest in applying AI tools to compensation workflows to improve speed and consistency.
  • Solid working proficiency with HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) software and CRM systems.
  • Prior compensation experience in a BPO or staffing environment is a plus.
  • Professional certifications such as CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or GRP (Global Remuneration Professional) are strongly preferred.

About Sciene
At Sciene, the mission is to empower professional services firms with cutting-edge, customized AI solutions — enhancing automation, analytics, and optimization across industries while prioritizing security, cost efficiency, and state-of-the-art technology.
Our flagship product, the Sciene AI Companion, is an autonomous customer success platform deployed across Quartile — the world's largest retail media optimization platform, managing performance marketing for 1,000+ brands. It automates relationship-heavy enterprise workflows end to end: generating personalized email replies in the CSM's own voice (8x faster), building full presentation decks for client meetings (12x faster), and detecting and diagnosing account fluctuations before anyone has to ask (6x faster). None of this replaces human judgment — it removes the work that was getting in the way of it.
Read more about how we built it: Sciene AI Companion: Building an Autonomous Customer Success Platform on Databricks

OVERVIEW:

Sciene runs a production agentic AI platform: a config-driven engine where every product is an agent with its own identity, skills, tools, and quality gates, executing ReAct loops against real business data across multiple LLM providers. The platform is built; what it needs now is deeper machine learning judgment behind every model decision it makes.
The Senior ML Specialist is the team's authority on how these models actually work and how to measure them. You will decide which models run which tasks and prove it with statistically sound benchmarks, design the evaluation methodology the whole team relies on, build classifiers and fine-tuned models where they beat prompting, and diagnose model behavior from first principles rather than by trial and error. You will do this inside a production codebase — shipping, operating, and monitoring what you design.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR:
This is a machine learning role first and a software engineering role second. We are looking for someone whose core professional background is in machine learning and statistics — not a software engineer who adopted LLM APIs in the last few years. You should be able to explain from first principles how a large language model is trained and why it behaves the way it does, reason about model outputs as probabilistic objects, and tell whether a difference between two models on a benchmark is real or noise.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of applied machine learning experience, with a substantial part predating the current generative AI wave — training, evaluating, and deploying models, not only integrating LLM APIs
  • Strong foundation in statistics and probability: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sampling and sample-size reasoning, bias/variance, calibration, and the ability to state when a measured difference is statistically meaningful
  • Deep understanding of LLM and generative AI theory: transformer architecture and attention, tokenization, embeddings, the training pipeline (pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF/DPO), decoding strategies (temperature, top-p, sampling vs. greedy), scaling behavior, and the known failure modes — hallucination, sycophancy, long-context degradation, prompt sensitivity — and why they occur
  • Hands-on classical ML and NLP: classification, clustering, feature engineering, text classification, embeddings and semantic similarity — and the judgment to know when a small trained model outperforms an LLM on cost, latency, or accuracy
  • Experience fine-tuning models (LoRA/PEFT, supervised fine-tuning, or full fine-tuning) and building the datasets for it — and equally, knowing when prompting or retrieval is the better answer
  • Experience designing evaluation methodology for AI systems: building offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and its known biases, inter-rater agreement, regression benchmarks, and significance testing on results
  • Production-grade Python: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, and modern async Python; comfortable shipping into a FastAPI/Pydantic codebase with tests and CI — this role ships code, not only notebooks
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), including structured outputs and tool/function calling, and an understanding of the trade-offs between models and providers
  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent demonstrated depth (publications, competition results, released models or research code)
  • The autonomy expected of a senior: you own a problem end to end — from framing to shipped, measured outcome — and are accountable for the result

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Publications, research, or open-source contributions in NLP or machine learning; strong Kaggle or equivalent competition record
  • Experience with retrieval systems: embedding model selection, chunking strategies, reranking, and retrieval quality evaluation
  • Experience with agent evaluation: trajectory analysis, tool-use accuracy, multi-step task success metrics
  • Experience with model cost and latency optimization: model routing, distillation, prompt caching, quantization
  • Experience with Databricks (MLflow, model serving, Delta Sharing) and with Azure (Container Apps, Key Vault) and Docker
  • Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, structured logging
  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-integration standards
  • Track record of shipping something from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift often

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

jobs.description:
OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.

Our core product suite includes:

● Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow-ups.
● Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena.
● AI-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis).
Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text-to-speech (TTS) — fine-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first AI + nurse hybrid workforce, improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.

About the Role

    The Clinical Testing Manager will lead the clinical testing and validation of our AI-enabled healthcare solutions. This role brings frontline nursing expertise into the product development process, helping ensure our solutions adhere to real-world nursing workflows, and high standards of clinical performance.

    The Clinical Testing Manager will oversee testing activities, synthesize clinical findings, and partner closely with QA and Product teams to translate clinical insights into meaningful product improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage clinical testing of AI-enabled healthcare solutions.

  • Coordinate clinical testers and ensure consistency in testing and documentation.

  • Evaluate AI interactions for clinical appropriateness, accuracy, escalation, disposition, workflow alignment, and patient communication.

  • Aggregate testing findings to identify trends, patterns, strengths, and opportunities for optimization.

  • Translate clinical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.

  • Develop and maintain clinical test cases, rubrics, reference standards, and testing documentation.

  • Partner cross-functionally to support continuous improvement and clinical validation of new features and workflows.

  • Serve as a clinical subject-matter expert and advocate for real-world nursing practice throughout product development.

Why Join Us?

    You’ll have the opportunity to help shape how AI is evaluated and improved for real clinical use. This role has direct influence on product decisions, clinical quality, and how our solutions support nurses, patients, and healthcare organizations.

    You’ll work closely with Clinical, Product, and Engineering teams in a fast-moving environment where your nursing expertise will have a meaningful impact on how healthcare AI is built and brought to market.

    We also value flexibility and trust our team to work in ways that support both strong performance and balance. You’ll have the autonomy to manage your work while staying connected to a highly collaborative team.

Requirements

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) required; master’s degree in nursing, informatics, healthcare, or a related field preferred.

  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience.

  • Nurse triage experience highly recommended

  • If no nurse triage experience then applicants must have Acute-care experience in emergency nursing, ED triage, or critical care to be considered.

  • Strong clinical judgment, assessment, escalation, and disposition decision-making skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate clinical findings for clinical and technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical and pattern-recognition skills.

  • Experience with clinical quality, validation, informatics, healthcare technology, or AI is preferred.

  • Familiarity with generative AI, conversational AI, or large language models is preferred.

Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement benefits, and a flexible work environment.

jobs.description:
Director of Paid Social

Sociallyin | Atlanta, GA (Remote-friendly) | $80,000–$95,000

We're hiring a Director of Paid Social to own and grow our paid media department. This is a senior leadership role for someone who's ready to build something, not just maintain it.

About the role

Sociallyin is a social media marketing agency, and only a social media marketing agency. We've been operating for 15 years, we're 50 people strong, and we're actively investing in how AI changes the way agencies work.

Our paid media department runs over $200K+ in monthly ad spend across 30+ client accounts, spanning Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, YouTube, and more. Clients range from SMB to mid-market to enterprise. The function is solid, but the ceiling is significantly higher than where we are today, and we need a leader who can take it there.

We want someone who can manage a team of 5 (mid-level and junior buyers), elevate performance across the board, build the systems and playbooks we've been operating without, move the department upmarket, and develop the next generation of leaders inside it.

This isn't a seat-warmer role. You'll report directly to the founders, you'll have full authority over how the department runs, and you'll have real influence on where the agency goes next.

What you'll own

  • Team leadership and development. Managing a team of 5+ paid media specialists (middle and junior). Coaching them, growing their skills, and building a culture where people want to do their best work.
  • Department performance. Owning the results across every client in the paid book. Defining what good looks like, holding the team to it, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Strategy across platforms. Setting the strategic direction for paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, and YouTube. Knowing when to push budget, when to pull back, and when to test something new.
  • Client relationships. Acting as the senior paid voice in strategic client conversations. Building trust with marketing leaders at SMB through enterprise clients. Being the person clients want in the room when paid comes up.
  • Systems and playbooks. Formalizing what's currently tribal knowledge into repeatable processes. Building the operating system that lets the department scale without sacrificing quality.
  • Hiring and growth. Full authority to hire, restructure, and grow the team as the department scales. You'll be building the seat above yours and the seats below.
  • AI and tooling. Identifying where AI can sharpen our work, evaluating new tools, and making the calls on what we adopt. We want a leader who's curious about where this is going, not defensive about it.
  • Upmarket expansion. Helping us win and retain bigger, more sophisticated paid accounts. Being the kind of operator that enterprise clients trust.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Working closely with Account Management, Creative, and Strategy to make sure paid is integrated into the bigger picture, not running in a silo.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • The team is operating at a higher standard than when you arrived, and they know why.
  • You've put systems and playbooks in place that didn't exist before, and the team is actually using them.
  • Client retention in the paid book is up, and at least one account has expanded scope because of work you led.
  • Performance metrics across the department are trending in the right direction, with the data to prove it.
  • You've built a clear point of view on where the department is going and how we get there, and the leadership team is bought in.

Where this role can go

This is a department-building role at an agency that's actively scaling. As the paid book grows, so does the department, which means new roles emerge underneath you and broader influence for you over time. You'll have real say in what that path looks like, because you're building it.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of paid social experience, with at least 2-3 of those years in agency.
  • Direct team leadership experience. You've managed people, not just projects. You know how to coach a mid-level buyer and develop a junior one.
  • Real depth on these platforms: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, YouTube, X. Comfortable across the rest, even if you'd lean on the team for the ones you know less.
  • Strategic thinking beyond the platform. You don't just optimize toward CPA. You understand the client's business, the funnel they live inside, and what paid actually needs to do for them.
  • A track record of building something. Systems, playbooks, training programs, hiring frameworks, reporting structures — something you put in place that outlasted you.
  • Strong client communication. You can hold your own in a room with a VP of Marketing or a CMO and walk out with their trust.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and where this work is headed. You experiment with new tools. You ask "could AI do this part?" before grinding through manual work.
  • An operator's instinct. You can read a P&L, think about margin, and understand why department profitability matters as much as performance.

What we offer

  • Salary: $75,000–$90,000 DOE
  • Remote-friendly with daily morning team standups
  • Direct exposure to founders and senior leadership
  • Full authority over how your department runs
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Uncapped PTO, parental leave, paid volunteer time
  • Home office allowance
  • A fast-moving, experimentation-friendly environment where the right ideas actually ship
  • And more! (See our careers page)

Votre rôle en tant que Spécialiste en santé mentale - Nuit

Relevant d'Annabel Tremblay, gestionnaire de l'équipe des spécialistes en santé mentale, la mission du spécialiste en santé mentale - nuit est de surveiller, trier et gérer la file d'attente de nuit au sein de la plateforme Dialogue. Combinant les fonctions des équipes d'urgence (ER) et de répartition (Dispatch), ce rôle constitue le premier point de contact clinique pour les membres qui font une demande pendant la nuit — allant de simples demandes de soutien jusqu'aux crises aiguës et aux idées suicidaires — afin d'assurer des trajectoires de soins sécuritaires, rapides et appropriées.

Ce que vous feriez

  • Surveillance de la file d'attente et triage : Évaluer activement les cas entrants durant la nuit afin de prioriser les soins en fonction de l'urgence, des besoins cliniques et du niveau de risque.
  • Évaluation du risque suicidaire et de crise : Effectuer des évaluations du risque en temps réel (incluant l'échelle C-SSRS et d'autres outils cliniques), offrir un soutien immédiat de désamorçage, élaborer des plans de sécurité et intervenir en situation de crise.
  • Appels de triage et orientation des soins : Effectuer les appels d'évaluation initiale/tri pour les membres cherchant du soutien pendant la nuit et les guider vers les ressources internes ou les trajectoires cliniques externes appropriées.
  • Escalade d'urgence : Coordonner directement avec les services d'urgence externes, les lignes de crise et les ressources communautaires lorsque des interventions de sécurité immédiates sont requises.
  • Collaboration multidisciplinaire : Collaborer avec les professionnels médicaux, infirmiers et de soins primaires de nuit pour assurer la continuité des soins et effectuer les transferts aux équipes du matin.
  • Documentation clinique : Maintenir une documentation claire, précise et rigoureuse sur le plan clinique pour chaque interaction et évaluation de la file d'attente.
  • Optimisation des protocoles : Contribuer à l'amélioration des flux de travail de tri nocturne, des procédures de répartition et des protocoles de réponse aux crises.

Nous aimerions vous rencontrer si vous avez/êtes

  • Bilingue en anglais et en français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine lié à la santé mentale ou aux relations humaines.
  • 2 ans ou plus d'expérience en intervention (p. ex., travailleur·se social·e ou rôle similaire) auprès d'une clientèle présentant des défis en santé mentale, avec une grande aisance à réaliser des évaluations psychosociales.
  • Disponibilité pour travailler de nuit (minimum de 21 heures par semaine), incluant une couverture récurrente les fins de semaine.
  • Très bonne connaissance des ressources communautaires et institutionnelles.
  • Fort esprit critique et aptitudes avancées en tri pour naviguer de façon autonome dans des cas complexes et à haut risque au sein d'un environnement dynamique.
  • Aisance avec les flux de travail technologiques et capacité d'adaptation rapide aux plateformes de santé numérique.

Chez Dialogue, votre bien-être est notre priorité.
Prendre soin des autres, c’est aussi prendre soin de notre équipe! Selon votre rôle et votre statutd’emploi, vous pourriez avoir accès aux avantages suivants :

  • Accès à l’application Dialogue et au soutien virtuel en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille
  • Assurance entièrement couverte, compte de dépenses pour la santé, couverture dentaire et remboursement de bien-être
  • 4 semaines de vacances, 9 journées de bien-être et 1 journée de bénévolat
  • 100% Télétravail
  • Programmes d'incitation, primes de référencement et cotisation équivalente au REER
  • Apprentissage via Coursera, budget de formation externe et programme de mentorat
  • Prestation facultative pour le congé parental

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Sr. Director, Marketing Operations

Role Purpose Statement: The Senior Director of Marketing Operations leads the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of marketing processes, technology, and analytics. This role bridges marketing strategy and operational execution, driving efficient lead-to-revenue workflows, robust MarTech integration, and tight alignment with Sales Operations, Finance, and Legal to accelerate company growth.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Alignment: Collaborate with the SVP of Marketing and marketing leaders to develop marketing strategy, track objectives, and improve cross-functional coordination across the organization. Includes publishing scorecards, running QBRs, delivering on BoD requirements, and other rhythm-of-the-business cadences.
  • Pipeline Leadership & Optimization: Co-lead the Pipeline Council, track critical workstreams, and optimize both the overall lead experience and pipeline progression opportunities in close partnership with Sales Operations.
  • MarTech Innovation & Integration: Drive marketing systems integration and continuous technology innovation, establishing the long-term vision, selection, architecture, and upkeep of the global MarTech stack.
  • Automation & Lead Management: Oversee marketing automation systems, including scalable campaign execution, automated lead scoring, nurture programs, and lead routing algorithms. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Ops and IT to enable intent-based Sales Development lead prioritization capabilities
  • Funnel Tracking & Attribution: Partner with Sales Operations to track and optimize the lead funnel and pipeline progression; establish multi-touch attribution models to measure channel performance, ROI, and marketing's impact on revenue.
  • Account-Based Operations (MQA): Lead the strategy and implementation of a Marketing Qualified Account (MQA) mechanism in collaboration with Sales Operations to drive aligned account-based growth.
  • Budget & Financial Planning: Lead the annual budget planning process and quarterly calibrations in close alignment with marketing budget owners and Finance business partners.
  • Governance & Data Privacy: Develop, manage, and execute operational processes to ensure marketing complies with global data privacy laws while maintaining high data hygiene standards.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of marketing operations and analytics professionals,

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue, marketing, or business operations with a focus on B2B go-to-market strategies.
  • Experience designing and operationalizing target account strategies, specifically Marketing Qualified Account (MQA) models and account scoring frameworks.
  • Deep experience working cross functionally to ensure sales-marketing alignment, pipeline velocity, and lead flow.
  • Proven track record managing enterprise MarTech architectures, deep marketing systems integrations, advanced automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Qualified, 6sense), and CRMs (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Hands-on expertise with lead scoring, multi-touch attribution platforms, and end-to-end funnel analytics.
  • Experience managing budgeting in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated capability in developing processes to comply with global data privacy laws.
  • Seasoned people manager with strong project management capabilities and a track record of hiring, managing, and developing top talent.

$156,000 to $224,000 Plus Bonus

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager
jobs.excerpt: Stratos Wealth Enterprises | Reports to: Lou Camacho, President | Flexible location | Travel up to 50% Position summaryAt Stratos Wealth Enterprises, we are building a scaled, high-performing, advisor-centric enterprise.
jobs.description:
Stratos Wealth Enterprises | Reports to: Lou Camacho, President | Flexible location | Travel up to 50%

Position summary

At Stratos Wealth Enterprises, we are building a scaled, high-performing, advisor-centric enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Relationship Manager who will serve as the strategic partner to advisory firms where Stratos Wealth Enterprises holds either an outright, majority, or minority ownership interest. The role will manage our most complex enterprise relationships, sitting at the intersection of consulting, operations, and leadership.

This role carries real accountability. You will own retention, expansion, integration, and operating performance across a portfolio of strategic, acquired, high-value, and unusually complex firms. You will engage founders, chief executives, senior advisors, and operating leaders to set multi-year direction, then convert that direction into measurable outcomes with clear owners and dates.

Success demands the gravitas, judgment, and business acumen to sit across the table from an owner-operator, earn trust quickly, and still challenge them to elevate performance. You will lead through influence rather than authority, align stakeholders across Stratos and our parent company, SEI, and translate enterprise strategy into practical plans that partner firms actually adopt. The role is flexible in location and expects travel up to 50 percent.

Key responsibilities

Strategic relationship leadership

  • Own executive-level relationships for an assigned portfolio of strategic, enterprise, acquired, and integration-intensive firms.
  • Build deep, durable relationships with founders, partners, and senior leadership teams, reducing key-person dependency and broadening sponsorship on both sides of the partnership.
  • Establish multi-year relationship strategies that align firm priorities, Stratos capabilities, commercial objectives, service commitments, and risk considerations.
  • Lead executive business reviews with founders, CEOs, and operating leaders, using data to frame decisions, surface risk, and create accountability.
  • Anticipate retention risk, competitive threats, succession events, leadership change, and service or integration issues, and mobilize a response before value is at risk.
  • Coordinate with Stratos’ Corporate Development and M&A teams to onboard, integrate, and support new firms joining Stratos Wealth Enterprises.

Practice integration and assimilation

  • Lead post-acquisition integration efforts and ensure seamless onboarding into the Stratos ecosystem.
  • Partner with firm leadership to align business models, processes, technology, talent, and culture with enterprise standards while protecting what makes each practice distinctive.
  • Identify integration risk early and implement solutions that accelerate time to value.
  • Connect integration milestones to relationship goals so onboarding, adoption, and growth advance together rather than sequentially.

Commercial growth, value creation, and negotiation

  • Work directly with partners to develop and execute growth strategies, both organic and inorganic.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation, advisor productivity, and client experience across the portfolio.
  • Serve as a thought partner on succession planning, talent development, market expansion, and practice economics.
  • Lead or coordinate complex commercial discussions, scope of decisions, service commitments, and negotiations, partnering with finance, legal, compliance, sales, product, and executive leadership as required.
  • Balance growth objectives against fiduciary, suitability, conflict-management, compliance, and client-interest considerations, and maintain a clear, data-supported view of relationship economics, pipeline, and forecast.

Operational excellence and process optimization

  • Evaluate and improve operational workflows to increase efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
  • Implement best practices across finance, technology, compliance, and client service.
  • Promote enterprise-wide adoption of standardized processes while preserving entrepreneurial flexibility where it creates advantage.
  • Identify effective practices in one firm and scale them across the network.

Accountability and performance management

  • Establish clear performance metrics and KPIs tied to growth, profitability, and efficiency.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partner firms and deliver actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Act as a coach and advisor: challenge assumptions, hold leaders accountable to agreed goals and enterprise standards, and drive performance.
  • Maintain disciplined records of plans, commitments, opportunities, risk indicators, and forecasts in our CRM and reporting tools.

Cross-enterprise leadership and escalations

  • Serve as the key connector between partner firms and internal Stratos and SEI resources.
  • Direct coordinated responses across investment management, operations, service, product, technology, compliance, legal, finance, marketing, onboarding, practice management, and sales.
  • Own major escalations from diagnosis through resolution, establishing decision rights, communications, timelines, and executive visibility.
  • Represent Stratos’ perspective in enterprise prioritization and strategy credibly with partner-firm executives.
  • Mentor other relationship managers, lead selected enterprise initiatives, and strengthen the discipline of segmentation, relationship planning, business reviews, and escalation management.

How success will be measured:

Performance in this role is evaluated across growth, integration, operating, and relationship outcomes:

  • Revenue and earnings growth: expansion of top-line revenue and improvement in EBITDA margins across partner firms.
  • Retention and relationship health across strategic and enterprise accounts, including executive sponsorship and trust, and overall relationship health as measured by Net Promoter Score
  • Operational efficiency: reduced redundancy, improved workflows, and increased scalability.
  • Expense management: optimization of cost structures without compromising growth.
  • Enterprise scale: adoption of shared systems, processes, and strategic initiatives across the network including utilization of Stratos, SIM, and SEI capabilities
  • Integration, transformation, and major-initiative milestones where assigned.
  • Quality and speed of major issue resolution, negotiation, cross-functional execution, mentoring, forecast accuracy, and control discipline.

Compensation consists of a competitive base salary plus performance-based incentive compensation tied to these outcomes.

Core competencies

• Strategic thinking and execution

• Leadership and influence

  • Relationship management and executive presence

• Commercial and financial judgment

• Operational excellence

• Change management

  • Accountability, collaboration, and enterprise mindset

Why this role matters

This role is central to realizing the Stratos vision of a unified, scalable, high-performing enterprise that still preserves the entrepreneurial spirit of our partner firms. The leader who takes it will shape the trajectory of our growth, strengthen our culture, and elevate the performance of the entire network. If you want to build something at scale rather than administer something already built, this is the seat.

Benefits and rewards

To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits through our parent company, SEI, including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, a flexible working environment, support for working parents, and Flexible Time Off so you can relax, recharge, and be there for the people you care about.

Equal employment opportunity

Stratos Wealth Enterprises and SEI are equal opportunity and affirmative action employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,

religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Requirements

What we need from you

  • Ten to fifteen or more years of senior experience in wealth management, registered investment advisers, advisor platforms, custody, asset management, broker-dealer services, financial services consulting, or comparable strategic client coverage.
  • A proven track record of working directly with founders, business owners, and executive teams, and of owning complex, high-value business relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex integrations, transformations, or scaling initiatives, and to carry major negotiations and escalations to resolution.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience driving P&L performance and operational improvement, and deep knowledge of advisor and wealth-firm economics and operating models.
  • Working command of investment and custody concepts, platform technology, and the regulatory environment supporting RIAs and hybrid firms.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with executive presence, credibility, and the ability to deliver constructive challenge.
  • Experience influencing without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders around a common vision, along with a high level of emotional intelligence, adaptability, and resilience.
  • FINRA Series 65 or Series 66 registration, active.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, and willingness to travel up to 50 percent.

What we would like from you

  • Experience with enterprise RIAs, acquired practices, national advisor platforms, multi-custody firms, or complex hybrid organizations.
  • Experience leading post-acquisition integration, transformation, succession planning, practice growth, or executive-level business planning.
  • FINRA Series 7 registration, and a CFP, CIMA, CRPC, CFA, or MBA credential.
  • Fluency with CRM, portfolio accounting, financial planning, and custodial platforms.
  • Experience mentoring relationship professionals or leading relationship management practice without necessarily having direct reports.
  • Consulting or advisory experience serving owner-led businesses through periods of rapid growth or change.
  • Someone who will embody our values of People First, Empower Entrepreneurs, Positive Can-Do Attitude, Embrace Collaboration, and Do the Right Thing.

Travel: None
Benefits: Eligible for standard W-2 employee benefits, subject to plan terms and eligibility

Job Description

Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC is seeking a motivated Recovery Services Sales Specialist to serve as the primary point of contact for prospective clients and convert qualified leads into signed, complete, and Operations-approved client files.

This is a remote, U.S.-based sales role focused on contacting company-provided leads, explaining our recovery services, building trust with potential clients, answering questions, overcoming objections, and converting qualified prospects into signed clients. The role also requires consistent follow-up, accurate CRM documentation, and coordination with the operations team to ensure complete client files move forward for claims processing. You will not be responsible for processing claims—your primary responsibility is converting assigned leads into signed, Operations-approved client files.

Key Responsibilities

  • The Recovery Services Sales Specialist will contact assigned prospective clients using approved communication methods and explain recovery services, fee structure, claims processes, and next steps in a clear and professional manner. This role will build trust with prospective clients through ethical, transparent, and customer-focused communication.
  • This position will address client questions and objections using approved sales practices, obtain signed agreements and authorizations, collect onboarding documentation, and coordinate review of client records and supporting documents.
  • The role will maintain accurate CRM records, sales activities, follow-up notes, and client communication documentation. The Recovery Services Sales Specialist will also conduct timely follow-up to maximize lead conversion opportunities and ensure prospective clients remain engaged throughout the process.
  • This position will coordinate with Operations, Research, Document, and Claims Processing teams to support complete file handoff, workflow accuracy, and client service quality. The specialist will also support productivity goals, conversion expectations, quality assurance standards, confidentiality requirements, and company policies.

Qualifications

  • A high school diploma, GED, or equivalent is required. An Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to pass required background and reference checks.
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in sales, customer service, client relations, call center operations, or lead generation is required. Experience using CRM systems and customer management platforms is preferred.
  • Experience in outbound sales, lead conversion, intake services, financial services, insurance, legal intake, recovery services, or remote performance-based work is also preferred.

Skills

  • The ideal candidate will have strong sales, lead conversion, client relationship-building, verbal communication, written communication, and customer service skills. This role requires the ability to overcome objections, explain services clearly, and maintain professionalism throughout the client conversation.
  • The candidate should be organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple follow-ups, CRM updates, documentation tasks, and client communication deadlines. Strong time management, multitasking, problem-solving, decision-making, and remote work discipline are required.
  • The role also requires confidentiality, ethical conduct, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement and performance excellence.

What We Offer

Eligible employees may receive standard W-2 employee benefits, including paid time off, family and medical leave, health and dental insurance, supplemental health and disability insurance, retirement savings plan options, performance-based incentives and commissions, and professional development and training opportunities.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Before applying, make sure you have a clear understanding of the role and its compensation structure to ensure it aligns with your expectations.

This position offers multiple ways to earn:

  • Hourly Base Pay: Paid at the applicable minimum wage based on your work location.
  • Signed File Commission: Earn $100 for every signed, complete, and Operations-approved client file.
  • Backend Recovery Commission: Earn 5% of the company fee actually collected on successful claim recoveries resulting from your approved client files.
    • Example: If a client recovers $10,000 and the company earns a 30% fee ($3,000), your backend commission would be $150 (5% of the $3,000 company fee).
  • Monthly Performance Bonus: Eligible to earn $250–$750 per month, based on overall performance. Bonus eligibility may be determined by:
    • Signed client conversion rate
    • Quality and completeness of submitted client files
    • Accuracy of CRM documentation
    • Timely follow-up with prospects
    • Compliance with company policies and approved sales scripts
    • Professionalism and complaint-free performance
    • Teamwork and cooperation
    • Overall quality review results
    • Revenue-producing claims successfully moved into processing

Please note that commissions are earned only on complete, valid, and Operations-approved client files, and backend commissions are paid only after the company successfully collects its fee from a completed recovery. Monthly bonuses are performance-based and discretionary, meaning they are not guaranteed and may be withheld if performance or compliance standards are not met.

Dedicated Corporate Travel Consultant - Truist Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

jobs.description:
As we continue our SAP transformation journey, we're looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Developer to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing and enhancing functionality within our SAP PRO environment, supporting the migration away from our SAP UKP system while delivering innovative solutions that improve business efficiency.
Working closely with both technical and functional teams, you'll be responsible for designing, developing and optimising ABAP solutions, translating business requirements into effective system enhancements, and ensuring high-quality, reliable outcomes. This role is ideal for a proactive problem-solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and making a tangible impact through technology.
If you have strong ABAP development experience, a solid understanding of SAP modules, and a passion for delivering business-focused solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

This role is based remotely within the UK only.

Key Responsibilities

  • SAP System Migration: Oversee the technical aspects of migrating a substantial portion of the business from one SAP system to another. This includes mapping and migrating data, customizing and adjusting ABAP code to fit the new system's requirements, and ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
  • Custom Development and Performance Optimization: Develop and modify custom ABAP programs to support new system functionalities and project requirements. Optimize the performance of SAP applications to accommodate changes brought by the system migrations and enhancements.
  • Technical Support and Troubleshooting: Provide ongoing technical support throughout the migrations and enhancement implementations. Address and resolve issues to ensure stability and performance of the SAP systems.
  • Collaboration with Stakeholders: Collaborate closely with the ERP team, functional teams, and other key stakeholders. Ensure technical solutions are aligned with business goals and project timelines, and effectively communicate progress and challenges.
  • Quality Assurance and Testing: Lead the testing efforts, including unit, integration, and regression testing, to guarantee the success of the migrations and the enhancement pack application. Ensure that new implementations meet quality standards and new and existing features are well documented.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Document technical procedures, changes, and system configurations. Facilitate knowledge transfer to ensure smooth transition and support by internal teams after project completion.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Qualifications:
  • SAP ABAP certification is highly desirable.
  • Experience:
  • Proven experience in SAP ABAP development, including reports, interfaces, extensions, forms, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with SAP system migrations and managing large-scale SAP upgrade projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and optimize ABAP code for performance and functionality.
Technical Skills:
  • Strong proficiency in ABAP programming and SAP Data Dictionary.
  • Knowledge of SAP modules relevant to the business and integration points.
  • Experience with SAP migration tools and methodologies.
  • Understanding of SAP architecture and the implications of Enhancement Packs on custom developments.
Personal Attributes:
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong planning and project management abilities, with a track record of delivering projects on time.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Other Requirements:
  • Willingness to engage in continuous learning and skill development.
  • A commitment to quality and a thorough approach to documentation and knowledge transfer.
  • Availability to work full-time on a 12-month fixed-term contract, with potential for extended hours as project demands dictate.

Voici un poste à distance.

Prêt.e à piloter des projets d’envergure dans un environnement nordique unique et stimulant? En tant que Gérant.e de projet, vous serez au cœur de la réalisation d’infrastructures essentielles en milieu isolé. Véritable chef d’orchestre, vous coordonnerez les équipes de chantier, les fournisseurs et les sous‑traitants pour assurer la réussite de chaque phase du projet — de l’estimation initiale jusqu’à la livraison finale. Votre rigueur, votre sens de l’organisation et votre capacité à anticiper les imprévus seront vos meilleurs alliés pour mener à terme des mandats exigeants où chaque décision compte. Si vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise à contribution dans un contexte où les défis sont aussi stimulants que les résultats sont concrets, ce rôle est fait pour vous.
*Nous souhaitons combler deux postes, dont l’un pour un projet minier et l'autre pour un projet d'envergure. L’attribution de l’un et l’autre de ces postes se basera sur les compétences des candidats rencontrés*

VOTRE MANDAT
La personne qui occupe le rôle de gérant.e de projet sera responsable de mener à bien les projets auxquels il sera assigné. Il aura à travailler en étroite collaboration avec le directeur de projet, l’équipe de chantier, les fournisseurs ainsi que les sous-traitants.
  • Coordonner et planifier les travaux en cours de contrat;
  • Participer au processus d’estimation et d’avant-projet;
  • Effectuer un suivi rigoureux de l’avancement des travaux et s’assurer du respect des orientations du projet;
  • Faire des suivis de coûts et de main-d’œuvre;
  • Négocier, préparer et octroyer des contrats avec différents sous-traitants;
  • Préparer les échéanciers et faire le suivi de toutes les activités d’exécution de projet;
  • Compiler et traiter les travaux réalisés en dépenses contrôlées;
  • Fournir l’information nécessaire à la préparation de factures aux personnes concernées;
  • Gérer les risques et les imprévus d’un projet et élaborer des plans d’action;
  • Participer au processus d’achat de matériaux et de location d’équipements spécifiques.
DES AVANTAGES IDENTIFIÉS PAR NOS EMPLOYÉS
  • Un minimum de 4 semaines de vacances par année;
  • Véhicule fourni;
  • Allocation téléphone cellulaire;
  • Accès à la télémédecine 24hres sur 24, 7jrs sur 7;
  • Assurances et REER collectifs;
  • Remboursement d’activité sportive;
  • Allocation pour l’achat de vêtements corporatifs via notre boutique en ligne;
  • L’opportunité de contribuer à des projets d’envergure à travers le Québec;
  • Un programme de formation pour vous faire évoluer dans l’entreprise;
  • L’occasion de vous développer et d’évoluer dans une entreprise familiale et de proximité;
  • Travailler dans les plus beaux paysages de la construction.
  • Horaire en rotation (ex. 14 jours de travail / 7 jours de congé, 7 jours de travail hybride de la maison).
  • Hébergement et repas fournis
  • Transport fourni (selon le point de départ)
VOS COMPÉTENCES ET VOS TALENTS QUI VOUS PERMETTRONT DE VOUS RÉALISER PLEINEMENT
Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne ayant une solide expérience en gestion de projets sur les chantiers de construction dans le domaine du génie civil.
  • Détenir un minimum d’expériences pertinentes à la fonction;
  • Être de niveau avancé en anglais car des interactions avec des fournisseurs unilingues anglophones sont possibles (atout);
  • Posséder une formation technique ou universitaire;
  • Posséder de l’expérience dans le milieu minier;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance de l’informatique;
  • Avoir une grande aptitude au travail d’équipe;
  • Détenir un sens de l’analyse, de la planification et de l’organisation;
  • Avoir une ou plusieurs expériences de travail sur des projets civilsde coffrage bétonnage;
  • Bonnes connaissances de CCDG (un ajout)
  • Être responsable et autonome.

Chez CRT Construction, nous valorisons l’audace, l’innovation et l’excellence. Si vous êtes passionné.e par les défis stimulants des structures complexes et que vous aspirez à marquer l’industrie à votre façon, nous vous invitons à venir découvrir un nouveau monde de possibilités et déposer votre candidature!

Au plaisir de vous rencontrer!

The Senior Enterprise Architect translates business needs into technical systems solutions and architectural roadmaps. The Senior Enterprise Architect work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

You will report to the Director of Enterprise Architecture.

As a Senior Enterprise Architect, you play a pivotal role in the alignment of the business vision, technology strategy and framing enterprise standards. You will be an integral part of the delivery of critical business outcomes, as well as the creation of technology strategies to leverage the IT. Additionally, as a Senior Enterprise Architect, you will provide mentorship and guidance to other enterprise, solution, technology, and system architects across Humana.

  • Mentor pattern-based development with a strong focus on resource & cost optimization.

Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Application Security Specialist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets by implementing and maintaining robust security measures for our applications. The Application Security Specialist will be responsible for identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and contributing to the overall security posture of our applications.

What you’ll get to do

- Security Assessment:

- Conduct thorough security assessments of applications through manual and automated testing.
- Identify and evaluate vulnerabilities in web and mobile applications.

Security Architecture:

- Collaborate with development teams to integrate security best practices into the application development lifecycle.
- Design and implement security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of applications.

Penetration Testing:
- Perform penetration testing on applications to simulate real-world cyber-attacks and identify potential weaknesses.
- Provide detailed reports on findings, including recommended remediation strategies.

Incident Response:
- Act as a key contributor in incident response activities related to application security incidents.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve security incidents.

Compliance:
- Ensure applications comply with relevant security standards, regulations, and industry best practices.
- Stay abreast of emerging security threats and industry trends to proactively address potential risks.

Training and Awareness:
- Develop and deliver security training programs for development teams to enhance awareness of secure coding practices.
- Keep stakeholders informed about the latest security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

Security Tools:
- Manage and configure security tools for continuous monitoring and analysis of application security.
- Stay current with advancements in security technologies and integrate them into the security framework.

To succeed in this role,you should have

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
- Proven experience as an Application Security Specialist or in a similar role.
- In-depth knowledge of application security principles, practices, and common vulnerabilities.
- Hands-on experience with security testing tools and methodologies.
- Familiarity with secure coding practices and application security frameworks.
- Strong understanding of web application architecture and cloud-based environments.
- Certifications such as OSCP, CEH, LPT, GPEN, CISSP or equivalent are a plus.

Advantage if you have;- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
- Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality results.
- Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to application security.

What we can offer you

  • Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance,, Employee Stock Options, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A take home assessment
  • A technical interview with a Lead in our Engineering Team
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.
